```kotlin
     * A tool-use ID with only the characters of [chars] (a regex character class without its brackets, which must hold
     * `_`) and 1 to 64 characters: Anthropic's `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$` ([ANTHROPIC_ID_CHARS]), which Copilot's Claude models
     * take too (design D12), as OpenClaw's `normalizeAnthropicToolCallId` makes it, or Converse's `[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+`
     * ([CONVERSE_ID_CHARS], AWS's `ToolUseBlock` reference). An ID that already fits stays as it is; any other becomes its
     * allowed characters (each other character as `_`), cut so that `_` and the first 8 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the
     * original ID fit in 64 characters. The result depends only on the ID, so a call and its result always pair up, and a
     * history whose old turns are trimmed keeps each surviving ID's rewrite; the hash keeps two IDs with the same allowed
     * characters apart.
     */
    fun toolUseId(id: String, chars: String = ANTHROPIC_ID_CHARS): String {
        if (Regex("^[$chars]{1,64}$").matches(id)) return id
        val hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(id.encodeToByteArray())
            .take(4).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }
        return id.replace(Regex("[^$chars]"), "_").take(64 - 1 - hash.length) + "_" + hash
    }
```

```kotlin
    /**
     * Consecutive tool results and the user message after them become one user turn, results first. The last block of
     * message `cacheAfter` gets a cache mark, never a thinking block (design D5 of sub-project 5).
     */
    private fun messages(request: ChatRequest, target: ModelTarget, tools: Boolean): JsonArray = buildJsonArray {
        val pending = mutableListOf<JsonObject>()
        val markAt = request.cacheAfter.takeIf { request.cacheFields.anthropicMarks }
        fun flush() {
            if (pending.isEmpty()) return
            addJsonObject {
                put("role", "user")
                put("content", JsonArray(pending.toList()))
            }
            pending.clear()
        }
        for ((index, message) in request.messages.withIndex()) {
            val mark = index == markAt
            when (message) {
                is ChatMessage.ToolResult -> {
                    val block = if (tools) buildJsonObject {
                        put("type", "tool_result")
                        put("tool_use_id", Wire.toolUseId(message.callId))
                        put("content", message.text)
                        if (message.failed) put("is_error", true)
                    } else text(Wire.resultText(message))
                    pending += if (mark) marked(block) else block
                }
                is ChatMessage.User -> {
                    val before = pending.size
                    for (part in message.parts) pending += when (part) {
                        is Part.Text -> if (part.text.isBlank()) continue else text(part.text)
                        is Part.Image -> buildJsonObject {
                            put("type", "image")
                            putJsonObject("source") {
                                put("type", "base64")
                                put("media_type", part.type.mime)
                                put("data", Wire.base64(part.bytes))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (mark && pending.size > before) pending[pending.lastIndex] = marked(pending.last())
                    flush()
                }
                is ChatMessage.Assistant -> {
                    flush()
                    assistant(message, target, tools, mark)
                }
            }
        }
        flush()
    }
```

```kotlin
    /**
     * The system prompt, the per-task context and the messages (design D5 of sub-project 5). OpenAI's own models take
     * the context as a `developer` item, and from GPT-5.6 on the system prompt too, because their top-level
     * `instructions` are billed uncached (research r51); the ChatGPT plan keeps `instructions` for the system prompt, and
     * the other targets get `system` items. In Copilot's explicit mode the system prompt, the context and message
     * `cacheAfter` carry `prompt_cache_breakpoint`, in the shape that VS Code's client sends: OpenAI writes cache entries
     * only at breakpoints, so the one on the system prompt lets every task read the tools and the system prompt from the
     * cache, whatever its context.
     */
    private fun input(request: ChatRequest, target: ModelTarget, tools: Boolean): JsonArray = buildJsonArray {
        val plan = target.options.chatgptPlan
        val own = ownModel(target)
        val explicit = explicit(request, target)
        val context = request.context?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        if (!plan && request.system.isNotEmpty()) {
            add(instruction(if (own && newer(target)) "developer" else "system", request.system, explicit))
        }
        if (context != null) add(instruction(if (own) "developer" else "system", context, explicit))
        val markAt = request.cacheAfter.takeIf { explicit }
        for ((index, message) in request.messages.withIndex()) {
            val mark = index == markAt
            when (message) {
                is ChatMessage.User -> addJsonObject {
                    put("role", "user")
                    putJsonArray("content") {
                        message.parts.forEachIndexed { position, part ->
                            addJsonObject {
                                when (part) {
                                    is Part.Text -> {
                                        put("type", "input_text")
                                        put("text", part.text)
                                    }
                                    is Part.Image -> {
                                        put("type", "input_image")
                                        put("image_url", "data:${part.type.mime};base64,${Wire.base64(part.bytes)}")
                                    }
                                }
                                if (mark && position == message.parts.lastIndex) put("prompt_cache_breakpoint", BREAKPOINT)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                is ChatMessage.Assistant -> assistant(message, target, tools)
                is ChatMessage.ToolResult -> if (tools) {
                    addJsonObject {
                        put("type", "function_call_output")
                        put("call_id", callId(message.callId))
                        if (mark) put("output", breakpointText(message.text)) else put("output", message.text)
                    }
                } else {
                    addJsonObject {
                        put("role", "user")
                        put("content", if (mark) breakpointText(Wire.resultText(message)) else plainText(Wire.resultText(message)))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** A system or developer item; with [breakpoint], its text is a content block that carries the breakpoint. */
    private fun instruction(role: String, text: String, breakpoint: Boolean): JsonObject = buildJsonObject {
        put("role", role)
        if (breakpoint) put("content", breakpointText(text)) else put("content", text)
    }

    private fun plainText(text: String): JsonArray = buildJsonArray {
        addJsonObject {
            put("type", "input_text")
            put("text", text)
        }
    }

    private fun breakpointText(text: String): JsonArray = buildJsonArray {
        addJsonObject {
            put("type", "input_text")
            put("text", text)
            put("prompt_cache_breakpoint", BREAKPOINT)
        }
    }

    /** OpenAI's own models, which take `developer` items: the ChatGPT plan, OpenAI's API, Azure OpenAI and Copilot. */
    private fun ownModel(target: ModelTarget): Boolean =
        target.options.chatgptPlan || azure || target.providerId == "openai" || target.providerId == CatalogLoader.COPILOT

    /** GPT-5.6 and later, by the sent ID or the catalog's ID (an Azure deployment's name can differ). */
    private fun newer(target: ModelTarget): Boolean = listOf(target.sentModelId, target.model.id).any { id ->
        val match = GPT_VERSION.find(id.lowercase()) ?: return@any false
        val major = match.groupValues[1].toInt()
        val minor = match.groupValues[2].toIntOrNull() ?: 0
        major > 5 || (major == 5 && minor >= 6)
    }

    /** Copilot's explicit cache mode, for the models that VS Code's client gives it (research r51) and while switched on. */
    private fun explicit(request: ChatRequest, target: ModelTarget): Boolean =
        request.cacheFields.responsesExplicit && target.providerId == CatalogLoader.COPILOT &&
            EXPLICIT_MODELS.containsMatchIn(target.sentModelId.lowercase())
```

```kotlin
    /**
     * One system message holds the system prompt and the per-task context, because some servers and Copilot's route to
     * Gemini keep only one (design D5 of sub-project 5), and adjacent user messages go as one ([Wire.mergeUsers]). On
     * Copilot, the system message and the message that holds message `cacheAfter` carry `copilot_cache_control`, as VS
     * Code's client sends it (research r51). On OpenAI's and Azure's own hosts, tool-call IDs keep at most 40 characters.
     */
    private fun messages(request: ChatRequest, target: ModelTarget, compat: CompatFlags, tools: Boolean): JsonArray = buildJsonArray {
        val copilotMarks = target.providerId == CatalogLoader.COPILOT && request.cacheFields.chatCopilotMarks
        val own = ownEndpoint(target)
        val system = Wire.systemAndContext(request)
        if (system.isNotEmpty()) add(withMark(buildJsonObject {
            put("role", if (compat.supportsDeveloperRole == true && target.model.reasoning) "developer" else "system")
            if (compat.cacheControlFormat == "anthropic") {
                // Two blocks, each with its own mark, so that the system prompt's cache entry does not change with the
                // task's context; still one system message.
                putJsonArray("content") {
                    for (text in listOf(request.system, request.context.orEmpty()).filter { it.isNotBlank() }) {
                        addJsonObject {
                            put("type", "text")
                            put("text", text)
                            putJsonObject("cache_control") { put("type", "ephemeral") }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                put("content", system)
            }

        val cacheAfter = request.cacheAfter
        for ((position, entry) in list.withIndex()) {
            val (message, indices) = entry
            val mark = copilotMarks && cacheAfter != null && cacheAfter in indices
            when (message) {
                is ChatMessage.User -> add(withMark(user(message, compat), mark))
                is ChatMessage.Assistant -> add(withMark(assistant(message, target, compat, tools, own), mark))
                is ChatMessage.ToolResult -> {
                    if (tools) {
                        add(withMark(buildJsonObject {
                            put("role", "tool")
                            put("tool_call_id", wireId(message.callId, own))
                            if (compat.requiresToolResultName == true) put("name", message.name)
                            put("content", message.text)
                        }, mark))
                        if (compat.requiresAssistantAfterToolResult == true && list.getOrNull(position + 1)?.first is ChatMessage.User) addJsonObject {
                            put("role", "assistant")
                            put("content", "OK.")
                        }
                    } else {
                        add(withMark(buildJsonObject {
                            put("role", "user")
                            put("content", Wire.resultText(message))
                        }, mark))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun withMark(message: JsonObject, mark: Boolean): JsonObject =
        if (mark) JsonObject(message + ("copilot_cache_control" to buildJsonObject { put("type", "ephemeral") })) else message

    /** OpenAI's and Azure's own endpoints, where OpenClaw applies its OpenAI rules. */
    private fun ownEndpoint(target: ModelTarget): Boolean {
        val host = target.baseUrl.host
        return CompatDefaults.endpointClass(target.baseUrl) in setOf("openai-public", "azure-openai") ||
            host.endsWith(".services.ai.azure.com") || host.endsWith(".cognitiveservices.azure.com")
    }

    /**
     * A call's ID as OpenAI's and Azure's own Chat Completions take it: at most 40 characters, as OpenClaw cuts them
     * (design D32 item 38 of sub-project 5), rewritten by [Wire.toolUseId], so that a call and its result keep one ID.
     */
    private fun wireId(id: String, own: Boolean): String = if (!own || id.length <= MAX_OPENAI_ID) id else Wire.toolUseId(id, Wire.OPENAI_ID_CHARS, MAX_OPENAI_ID)
```

```markdown
- The agent's requests (section 11.2) keep one fixed prefix for the providers' prompt caches: the tools and the system prompt never change, and the per-task text follows in a field of its own, `context`: Anthropic's second system block (also on Vertex and Foundry) and Bedrock's, Gemini's second part of `systemInstruction`, one system message with the separator line `----` on Chat Completions and Ollama, and on Responses a `developer` item for the ChatGPT plan and OpenAI's own models (OpenAI's API, Azure OpenAI and Copilot), whose system prompt also goes as a `developer` item from GPT-5.6 on, and a second `system` item for the other targets. `cacheAfter` names the last message that never changes again: Anthropic marks the last tool, the system prompt, the context and that message (four marks), Claude on Bedrock gets cache points in the same places, Copilot's `/responses` for GPT-5.6 and the GPT-6 family gets OpenAI's explicit mode with breakpoints on the system prompt, the context and that message, Copilot's `/chat/completions` gets `copilot_cache_control` on the system message and on the message that holds it, as VS Code's client sends them, and a Chat Completions route with Anthropic's marks gets the system prompt and the context as two marked blocks of its one system message, although no Copilot document promises them; each of Copilot's three can be switched off on its own for a model whose cache stays empty. Chat Completions and Gemini merge adjacent user messages, because some local servers refuse two user turns in a row. A 400 whose error names the tool choice sets a flag that keeps none of the error's words, and the agent sends the request once more with `auto`. A tool result whose call is not in the request is refused before it is sent, and on OpenAI's and Azure's own Chat Completions a tool-call ID of more than 40 characters is rewritten in the same way, so that a history from Responses survives an escalation.
```

Tasks 4 and 5 add the vault, agent-free apps, test mode and the recipients; writer B's loop calls `SafetyCheck.assess` before every action, `SafetyCheck.afterAction` after it (with the text that was typed, the vault's values revealed), and records `Assessment` in the activity log's `SAFETY` entry.

Design D13 (with D11's links and D14's confirmations), D32 items 12 and 17, review A C3 and C4 and review B C1, C2, I1 to I3, I7, M2 to M4 and their rounds 2 and 3. `SafetyCheck` is a pure function of the proposal, the fresh snapshot, the task's state and the settings, so its tests are spec 16.2's decision table on fixture snapshots, with a hostile model that declares `reading` for every tap. The category is the highest row that any source suggests: the declared category of the five tools that take one, or the tool's fixed one; the words of the labels that the action reaches (and of their clickable ancestors, and for a `TapAt` the OCR line and the elements under the point), folded so that both scripts count; and the context rules: a field that composes a message makes the unlabelled buttons in its row and the bars beside it `SENDING`, and a search, URL or address field does not; every action in a phone or contacts app is `CALLS`; in a share flow every tap in the list of the picker's rows is `SENDING`, whatever its label, also in a list that does not scroll, while the picker's own search, back, close and tabs outside the list only read; a row is named by its first text, so that a row that Android names by all its texts still ends the flow at its chat (review 2 I1); opening something or going home ends the flow (review 2 C1); each flow has a serial number (review 4 C2); Android's share sheet is the intent resolver or the `android` package's chooser, never an ANR dialog (review 2 M1); an action that sends and deletes is asked about as a send and needs the allowance to send (review 2 I2); clearing a field is typing the request (review 2 M6); the permission controller, the installers, Google Play's install and purchase pages and a protected trail in Settings are `PROTECTED`, while an app's permission dialog (a smaller window, or one with the grant dialog's view IDs; review 2 M11) is handed over; credentials fields, biometric prompts, autofill pickers and password pages are `CREDENTIALS`, and Credential Manager is handed over; a checkout screen makes its buttons `PAYMENTS`; a "Clear" that only empties a field is typing. The mode then decides per row; payments and credentials are handed over and protected actions blocked in every mode; every call of the agent is handed over (D13 closes the service-code case, review A C4), and `tel:` links open only numbers that the emergency guard lets Kestrel dial; an action outside the task's allowance, which `TaskAllowance` reads from the owner's verbs alone, is confirmed in every mode; typing a placeholder is confirmed in every mode. `ConfirmationBuilder` gets the forms that need no recipient in this task (deleting, typing, a share flow's start, the allowance's questions); Task 5 adds the recipients. The guard's pure parts move from `:app` into `:core:safety` so that the instant commands and the agent share them; `:app`'s guard calls them, and its tests stay as they are.

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ElementAction
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenElement
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScrollAxis
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowKind
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowSummary

/**
 * Builds the safety tests' snapshots: an app window of 1000 × 2000 pixels (ID 1, layer 1, active) and its elements in the
 * order of [add], each 100 pixels high and as wide as the window unless the test says otherwise. [add] returns the
 * element's key, and [index] its position, for proposals and the tree's questions.
 */
internal class TestScreen(val packageName: String = "com.example.chat", title: String? = null) {
    private val windows = mutableListOf(WindowSummary(1, WindowKind.APPLICATION, packageName, title, IntRect(0, 0, 1000, 2000), layer = 1, active = true))
    private val elements = mutableListOf<ScreenElement>()

    fun add(
        top: Int,
        label: String? = null,
        id: String? = null,
        parent: String? = null,
        className: String = "android.widget.Button",
        left: Int = 0,
        right: Int = 1000,
        height: Int = 100,
        clickable: Boolean = true,
        editable: Boolean = false,
        password: Boolean = false,
        focused: Boolean = false,
        checkable: Boolean = false,
        checked: Boolean = false,
        scrollable: Boolean = false,
        text: String? = label,
        hint: String? = null,
        description: String? = null,
        axis: ScrollAxis? = null,
        window: Int = 1,
        packageName: String = windows.first { it.id == window }.packageName.orEmpty(),
    ): String {
        val key = "$packageName|${elements.size}|${label.orEmpty()}"
        elements += ScreenElement(
            key = key,
            windowId = window,
            parent = parent?.let { index(it) },
            packageName = packageName,
            className = className,
            text = text,
            contentDescription = description,
            hint = hint,
            viewId = id?.let { "$packageName:id/$it" },
            label = label ?: description ?: hint,
            bounds = IntRect(left, top, right, top + height),
            actions = if (scrollable) setOf(ElementAction.SCROLL_FORWARD) else emptySet(),
            clickable = clickable,
            editable = editable,
            checkable = checkable,
            checked = checked,
            scrollable = scrollable,
            focused = focused,
            password = password,
            scrollAxis = axis,
        )
        return key
    }

    /** A window above the app's, such as the keyboard (layer 2) or a permission dialog. */
    fun window(id: Int, packageName: String, bounds: IntRect, kind: WindowKind = WindowKind.APPLICATION, layer: Int = 2, active: Boolean = false) {
        if (active) windows.replaceAll { it.copy(active = false) }
        windows += WindowSummary(id, kind, packageName, null, bounds, layer, active)
    }

    fun index(key: String): Int = elements.indexOfFirst { it.key == key }

    fun snapshot(): ScreenSnapshot = ScreenSnapshot(0, windows.toList(), elements.toList())
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Test

class SafetySettingsTest {
    @Test
    fun settingsSavedWithoutTestModeKeepTestModeOn() {
        assertEquals(SafetySettings(testMode = true), Json.decodeFromString(SafetySettings.serializer(), "{}"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testModeOffSurvivesSaving() {
        val json = Json.encodeToString(SafetySettings.serializer(), SafetySettings(testMode = false))

        assertEquals(SafetySettings(testMode = false), Json.decodeFromString(SafetySettings.serializer(), json))
    }

    @Test
    fun theModeAndTheOwnersNamesHaveDefaultsAndSurviveSaving() {
        val defaults = Json.decodeFromString(SafetySettings.serializer(), """{"testMode": true}""")
        assertEquals(Mode.STANDARD, defaults.mode)
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), defaults.ownerEmails)
        assertEquals("My Notes", defaults.viberSelfChatName)

        val owner = SafetySettings(mode = Mode.RELAXED, ownerEmails = listOf("owner@example.com"), whatsappOwnName = "Aleksa")
        assertEquals(owner, Json.decodeFromString(SafetySettings.serializer(), Json.encodeToString(SafetySettings.serializer(), owner)))
    }

    @Test
    fun theTextFormHoldsNoAddressOrName() {
        val printed = SafetySettings(ownerEmails = listOf("owner@example.com"), viberSelfChatName = "Secret notes", whatsappOwnName = "Aleksa").toString()

        assertFalse(printed, printed.contains("owner@") || printed.contains("Secret") || printed.contains("Aleksa"))
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** D13's allowance by verbs in a command position (decision 6; research r52), with the requests that allow nothing. */
class TaskAllowanceTest {
    private fun allowed(request: String, knownNames: Set<String> = emptySet()) = TaskAllowance.from(request, knownNames).categories

    @Test
    fun theSixTasksOfTheDesign() {
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING), allowed("Send Ana a Viber message that I'm 10 minutes late"))
        assertEquals(emptySet<Category>(), allowed("Turn on hotspot"))
        assertEquals(emptySet<Category>(), allowed("Start Waze navigation to home"))
        assertEquals(emptySet<Category>(), allowed("Open a web page via Firefox and interact with it"))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING), allowed("Send yesterday's photos to John on Telegram"))
        assertEquals(emptySet<Category>(), allowed("Read my latest email back to me"))
    }

    @Test
    fun nounsAndWordsOutsideACommandPositionAllowNothing() {
        for (request in listOf(
            "Read my latest message", "What did Ana text me?", "Tell me my next meeting", "Who was my last call?",
            "Answer the quiz", "Text size bigger", "Forward 30 seconds", "Fast forward the song", "Message the group",
        )) {
            assertEquals(request, emptySet<Category>(), allowed(request))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun aNameCountsWithAMessageAfterItOrWhenMemoryOrTheContactsKnowIt() {
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING), allowed("Message Ana that I'm late"))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING), allowed("Text Marko: running late"))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING), allowed("Javi Ani da kasnim"))
        assertEquals(emptySet<Category>(), allowed("Call mom"))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.CALLS), allowed("Call mom", setOf("Mom")))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING), allowed("E-mail Ana Petrović about the plan"))
    }

    @Test
    fun severalVerbsAfterAndThenPleaseOrKestrel() {
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING, Category.DELETING), allowed("Kestrel, delete the draft and then reply to Ana"))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.CALLS), allowed("Please dial the office"))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.DELETING), allowed("Clear history"))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING), allowed("Pošalji Ani poruku"))
        assertEquals(setOf(Category.SENDING), allowed("Post a photo of the sunset"))
    }

    @Test
    fun readingTypingAndSettingsAreAlwaysAllowedAndScreenTextOnlyWithSending() {
        val none = TaskAllowance.NONE
        assertTrue(none.allows(Category.READING) && none.allows(Category.TYPING_REQUEST) && none.allows(Category.ORDINARY_SETTINGS))
        assertFalse(none.allows(Category.TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT))
        assertTrue(TaskAllowance(setOf(Category.SENDING)).allows(Category.TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT))
        assertFalse(TaskAllowance(setOf(Category.SENDING, Category.DELETING)).allows(Category.PAYMENTS))
        assertEquals("This task may send messages and delete things after the owner confirms.", TaskAllowance(setOf(Category.SENDING, Category.DELETING)).describe())
        assertEquals("This task may not send, call or delete anything without asking the owner.", none.describe())
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

/** Design D11 and D32 item 12 of sub-project 5: every link is checked before Kestrel opens it. */
class LinkCheckTest {
    private val agentFree = { packageName: String? -> packageName == "dev.kestrel" || packageName == "rs.bank.app" }
    private val emergency = EmergencyNumbers { digits -> if (digits == "999") null else digits in setOf("112", "192", "194") }

    private fun check(link: String, kind: ActionKind = ActionKind.OPEN_DEEP_LINK, fromOwner: Boolean = true, target: String? = null) =
        LinkCheck.check(link, kind, fromOwner, target, agentFree, emergency)

    private fun refused(verdict: LinkVerdict) = verdict is LinkVerdict.Refused

    @Test
    fun openUrlTakesOnlyHttpsAndDeepLinksOnlyTheSpecsSchemes() {
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Allowed(Category.READING), check("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kestrel", ActionKind.OPEN_URL))
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Refused("Only https links."), check("http://example.com", ActionKind.OPEN_URL))
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Refused("Only https links."), check("waze://?favorite=home", ActionKind.OPEN_URL))
        for (link in listOf("viber://chat", "whatsapp://send", "tg://resolve?domain=x", "waze://?favorite=home&navigate=yes", "geo:44.8,20.4", "sms:+12025550143", "mailto:ana@example.com")) {
            assertEquals(link, LinkVerdict.Allowed(Category.READING), check(link))
        }
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Refused("Kestrel opens no market links."), check("market://details?id=x"))
    }

    @Test
    fun dangerousSchemesAndProtectedTargetsAreRefused() {
        for (link in listOf("intent://x#Intent;end", "file:///sdcard/a.txt", "content://media/1", "javascript:alert(1)", "android-app://dev.kestrel")) {
            assertEquals(link, true, refused(check(link)))
        }
        assertEquals(true, refused(check("https://kestrel.example/settings", ActionKind.OPEN_URL, target = "dev.kestrel")))
        assertEquals(true, refused(check("https://bank.example/pay", ActionKind.OPEN_URL, target = "rs.bank.app")))
        assertEquals(true, refused(check("https://accounts.google.com", ActionKind.OPEN_URL, target = "com.google.android.gms")))
        assertEquals(true, refused(check("https:///no-host", ActionKind.OPEN_URL)))
    }

    @Test
    fun aTelLinkOpensOnlyANumberThatKestrelMayDial() {
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Allowed(Category.READING), check("tel:+12025550143"))
        for (link in listOf("tel:112", "tel:999", "tel:1234", "tel:**21*0601234567#", "tel:%23%2306%23")) {
            assertEquals(link, true, refused(check(link)))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun aLinkFromTheScreenWithAQueryOrAFragmentSendsItsData() {
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Allowed(Category.SENDING), check("https://evil.example/collect?code=483920", ActionKind.OPEN_URL, fromOwner = false))
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Allowed(Category.SENDING), check("https://evil.example/#Ana-0601234567", ActionKind.OPEN_URL, fromOwner = false))
        // A section anchor is a word, not data (review 2-2 New 5).
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Allowed(Category.READING), check("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kestrel#History", ActionKind.OPEN_URL, fromOwner = false))
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Allowed(Category.READING), check("https://evil.example/collect?code=483920", ActionKind.OPEN_URL, fromOwner = true))
        assertEquals(LinkVerdict.Allowed(Category.READING), check("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kestrel", ActionKind.OPEN_URL, fromOwner = false))
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** The pure parts of the emergency guard, which `:app`'s instant commands and the agent share (design D13 of sub-project 5). */
class EmergencyGuardTest {
    @Test
    fun r1NamesEmergencyAndSosButNeverKestrelsOwnWindows() {
        val screen = TestScreen("com.android.systemui")
        screen.add(1800, "Emergency call")
        screen.add(1700, null, id = "sosButton", description = null)
        screen.add(1600, "Emergency", packageName = "dev.kestrel")
        screen.add(1500, "Emergent design")
        val snapshot = screen.snapshot()

        assertTrue(EmergencyGuard.emergencyNamed(snapshot, 0))
        assertTrue(EmergencyGuard.emergencyNamed(snapshot, 1))
        assertFalse(EmergencyGuard.emergencyNamed(snapshot, 2))
        assertFalse(EmergencyGuard.emergencyNamed(snapshot, 3))
    }

    @Test
    fun aNumberFieldAndItsDeleteKey() {
        val screen = TestScreen("com.google.android.dialer")
        screen.add(200, null, id = "digits", editable = false, clickable = false, text = "112")
        screen.add(200, null, editable = true, hint = "Search contacts", text = "Ana")
        screen.add(1800, "Delete", clickable = true)
        val snapshot = screen.snapshot()

        assertTrue(EmergencyGuard.isNumberField(snapshot.elements[0]))
        assertTrue(EmergencyGuard.showsNumber(snapshot.elements[0], "112"))
        assertFalse(EmergencyGuard.showsNumber(snapshot.elements[1], "Ana"))
        assertTrue(EmergencyGuard.isDeleteKey(snapshot.elements[2]))
        assertTrue(EmergencyGuard.showsEmergencyNumber(snapshot.elements[0]) { it == "112" })
    }

    @Test
    fun onlyALongNumberThatAndroidCallsNoEmergencyMayBeDialled() {
        val emergency = EmergencyNumbers { digits -> if (digits == "0601234567") false else if (digits == "999") null else true }

        assertTrue(EmergencyGuard.telAllowed("060 123 4567", emergency))
        assertFalse(EmergencyGuard.telAllowed("112", emergency))
        assertFalse(EmergencyGuard.telAllowed("999", emergency))
        assertFalse(EmergencyGuard.telAllowed("*#06#", emergency))
        assertFalse(EmergencyGuard.telAllowed("Ana", emergency))
        assertTrue(EmergencyGuard.mayCall("0601234567", false))
        assertFalse(EmergencyGuard.mayCall("0601234567", null))
    }
}
```

Create `core/safety/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/safety/SafetyCheckTest.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScrollAxis
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowKind
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** Spec 16.2's decision table (design D13 of sub-project 5), with a hostile model that declares `reading` for every tap. */
class SafetyCheckTest {
    private val everything = TaskSafety(TaskAllowance(setOf(Category.SENDING, Category.CALLS, Category.DELETING)))
    private val nothing = TaskSafety(TaskAllowance.NONE)
    private val standard = SafetySettings(testMode = false)

    private fun tap(key: String, declared: Category = Category.READING) = Proposal("tap", ActionKind.TAP, declared, targetKey = key, frontAppLabel = "Chat")

    private fun kind(decision: Decision): String = when (decision) {
        Decision.Run -> "run"
        is Decision.Confirm -> "confirm"
        is Decision.HandOver -> "handover:${decision.handOver.kind}"
        is Decision.Block -> "block"
    }

    private fun decide(proposal: Proposal, screen: TestScreen, task: TaskSafety = everything, mode: Mode = Mode.STANDARD, env: SafetyEnvironment = SafetyEnvironment()) =
        kind(SafetyCheck.decide(proposal, screen.snapshot(), task, standard.copy(mode = mode), env))

    /**
     * A chat whose toolbar names it and whose message field holds text, so that a question can name what a delete
     * removes and where a send goes.
     */
    private fun titled(): TestScreen = TestScreen().apply {
        val bar = add(80, null, id = "toolbar", clickable = false)
        add(90, "Shopping list", parent = bar, clickable = false)
        add(1800, null, editable = true, hint = "Message", text = "Hello", right = 850)
    }

    @Test
    fun everyRowRunsConfirmsHandsOverOrBlocksAsItsModeSays() {
        val screen = titled()
        val next = screen.add(1000, "Next")
        val expected = mapOf(
            Category.READING to listOf("run", "run", "run"),
            Category.TYPING_REQUEST to listOf("run", "run", "run"),
            Category.ORDINARY_SETTINGS to listOf("run", "run", "run"),
            Category.TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT to listOf("confirm", "run", "run"),
            Category.SENDING to listOf("confirm", "confirm", "run"),
            Category.CALLS to listOf("handover:CALL", "handover:CALL", "handover:CALL"),
            Category.DELETING to listOf("confirm", "confirm", "run"),
            Category.PAYMENTS to listOf("handover:PAYMENT", "handover:PAYMENT", "handover:PAYMENT"),
            Category.CREDENTIALS to listOf("handover:CREDENTIALS", "handover:CREDENTIALS", "handover:CREDENTIALS"),
            Category.PROTECTED to listOf("block", "block", "block"),
        )
        for ((category, decisions) in expected) {
            assertEquals(category.name, decisions, Mode.entries.map { decide(tap(next, category), screen, mode = it) })
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun aHostileModelThatDeclaresReadingStillMeetsTheLabelsWords() {
        val screen = titled()
        val keys = listOf("Send", "Delete chat", "Pay now", "Install", "Pošalji", "Пошаљи", "Video call").map { screen.add(100 + it.length * 50, it) }

        assertEquals(
            listOf("confirm", "confirm", "handover:PAYMENT", "block", "confirm", "confirm", "handover:CALL"),
            keys.map { decide(tap(it), screen) },
        )
        val assessment = SafetyCheck.assess(tap(keys[0]), screen.snapshot(), everything, standard)
        assertEquals(Category.SENDING, assessment.category)
        assertEquals(setOf(Source.DECLARED, Source.LABEL_WORDS), assessment.sources)
        assertEquals(assessment.decision, assessment.beforeTestMode)
        val deleted = SafetyCheck.decide(tap(keys[1]), screen.snapshot(), everything, standard) as Decision.Confirm
        assertEquals("Delete 'Shopping list' in Chat? Say confirm or cancel.", deleted.confirmation.question)
        // Without a title or a selection, Kestrel cannot say what a delete removes, so it hands over.
        val untitled = TestScreen()
        assertEquals("handover:RECIPIENT", decide(tap(untitled.add(500, "Delete")), untitled))
    }

    @Test
    fun clearBesideAFieldOnlyEmptiesItAndClearChatDeletes() {
        val screen = TestScreen()
        val field = screen.add(100, null, editable = true, hint = "Search", text = "Ana")
        val clear = screen.add(100, "Clear", parent = field, left = 900, className = "android.widget.ImageButton")
        val clearSearch = screen.add(100, "Clear search", left = 800, right = 900)
        val clearChat = screen.add(1500, "Clear chat")

        assertEquals(Category.TYPING_REQUEST, SafetyCheck.assess(tap(clear), screen.snapshot(), nothing, standard).category)
        assertEquals("run", decide(tap(clearSearch), screen, nothing))
        assertEquals(Category.DELETING, SafetyCheck.assess(tap(clearChat), screen.snapshot(), everything, standard).category)
    }

    @Test
    fun anUnlabelledButtonBesideAComposedMessageSends() {
        val chat = TestScreen(title = "Ana")
        chat.add(1800, null, editable = true, focused = true, hint = "Message", text = "I'm late", right = 850)
        val arrow = chat.add(1800, null, className = "android.widget.ImageButton", left = 850)
        val search = TestScreen()
        search.add(100, null, editable = true, focused = true, hint = "Search", text = "Ana", right = 850)
        val lens = search.add(100, null, className = "android.widget.ImageButton", left = 850)
        val browser = TestScreen("com.android.chrome")
        browser.add(100, null, id = "url_bar", editable = true, focused = true, text = "example.com", right = 850)
        val menu = browser.add(100, null, className = "android.widget.ImageButton", left = 850)

        assertEquals("confirm", decide(tap(arrow), chat, nothing))
        assertEquals(Category.SENDING, SafetyCheck.assess(tap(arrow), chat.snapshot(), everything, standard).category)
        assertEquals("run", decide(tap(lens), search, nothing))
        assertEquals("run", decide(tap(menu), browser, nothing))
    }

    @Test
    fun everyActionInAPhoneOrContactsAppIsACallThatIsHandedOver() {
        val dialer = TestScreen("com.google.android.dialer")
        val one = dialer.add(1200, "1")
        val list = dialer.add(200, null, scrollable = true, height = 800, clickable = false)
        val contacts = TestScreen("com.google.android.contacts")
        val row = contacts.add(300, "Ana Petrović")
        val other = TestScreen("com.example.phone")
        val key = other.add(1200, "5")

        assertEquals("handover:CALL", decide(tap(one), dialer, nothing))
        assertEquals("run", decide(Proposal("scroll", ActionKind.SCROLL, Category.READING, targetKey = list), dialer, nothing))
        assertEquals("handover:CALL", decide(tap(row), contacts, nothing))
        assertEquals("run", decide(tap(key), other, nothing))
        val withDefault = SafetyEnvironment(phonePackages = EmergencyGuard.PHONE_PACKAGES + "com.example.phone")
        assertEquals("handover:CALL", decide(tap(key), other, nothing, Mode.FULL_AUTO, withDefault))
    }

    @Test
    fun anEmergencyButtonAnywhereIsACall() {
        val lock = TestScreen("com.android.systemui")
        val sos = lock.add(1800, "Emergency call")

        assertEquals("handover:CALL", decide(tap(sos), lock, everything, Mode.FULL_AUTO))
    }

    @Test
    fun everyRowOfASharePickerSendsWhateverItsLabelAndItsControlsOnlyRead() {
        val picker = TestScreen("org.telegram.messenger")
        val bar = picker.add(0, null, id = "toolbar", clickable = false, height = 150)
        val search = picker.add(20, "Search", parent = bar, left = 850, className = "android.widget.ImageButton")
        val tab = picker.add(160, "Chats", className = "com.google.android.material.tabs.TabLayout\$TabView", right = 300)
        val list = picker.add(300, null, scrollable = true, axis = ScrollAxis.VERTICAL, height = 1600, clickable = false)
        val rows = listOf("Close friends", "Back to school", "Search party", "Ana").mapIndexed { i, name -> picker.add(300 + i * 120, name, parent = list) }
        val flow = everything.copy(shareFlow = ShareFlow("org.telegram.messenger", emptyList(), ShareCount(3, 0)))

        assertEquals("run", decide(tap(search), picker, flow))
        assertEquals("run", decide(tap(tab), picker, flow))
        for (row in rows) {
            assertEquals(Category.SENDING, SafetyCheck.assess(tap(row), picker.snapshot(), flow, standard).category)
            assertEquals("confirm", decide(tap(row), picker, flow, Mode.RELAXED))
        }
        // Without a flow, a row named "Ana" only opens her chat.
        assertEquals("run", decide(tap(rows[3]), picker, everything))
    }

    @Test
    fun shareMediaAndComposeSmsNeedTheAllowanceToSend() {
        val screen = TestScreen()
        val share = Proposal(
            "share_media", ActionKind.SHARE_MEDIA, receivingPackage = "org.telegram.messenger", shareCount = ShareCount(3, 0),
            frontAppLabel = "Gallery", receivingAppLabel = "Telegram",
        )
        val sms = Proposal("compose_sms", ActionKind.COMPOSE_SMS, receivingPackage = "com.google.android.apps.messaging")

        val asked = SafetyCheck.decide(share, screen.snapshot(), nothing, standard) as Decision.Confirm
        assertEquals("You didn't ask me to share anything. Open Telegram's share screen with 3 photos? Say confirm or cancel.", asked.confirmation.question)
        assertEquals("confirm", decide(sms, screen, nothing))
        assertEquals("run", decide(share, screen, everything))
    }

    @Test
    fun protectedScreensBlockAndAnAppsPermissionDialogIsHandedOver() {
        val controller = TestScreen("com.google.android.permissioncontroller")
        val allow = controller.add(1500, "Allow")
        val dialog = TestScreen()
        dialog.window(2, "com.google.android.permissioncontroller", IntRect(50, 700, 950, 1300), active = true)
        val dialogAllow = dialog.add(1200, "While using the app", window = 2)
        val settings = TestScreen("com.android.settings")
        val bar = settings.add(80, null, id = "action_bar", clickable = false)
        settings.add(90, "Accessibility", parent = bar, clickable = false)
        val service = settings.add(400, "Kestrel")
        val list = settings.add(300, null, scrollable = true, height = 1500, clickable = false)
        val page = TestScreen("com.android.settings")
        val toggle = page.add(400, "Use Kestrel")

        assertEquals("block", decide(tap(allow), controller, everything, Mode.FULL_AUTO))
        assertEquals("handover:PERMISSION_DIALOG", decide(tap(dialogAllow), dialog))
        assertEquals("block", decide(tap(service), settings))
        assertEquals("run", decide(Proposal("scroll", ActionKind.SCROLL, Category.READING, targetKey = list), settings))
        assertEquals("block", decide(tap(toggle), page, everything.copy(trail = ProtectedTrail("Accessibility"))))
        assertEquals("run", decide(tap(toggle), page))
    }

    @Test
    fun credentialsAndPaymentsAreHandedOver() {
        val login = TestScreen()
        val password = login.add(600, null, editable = true, password = true, hint = "Password")
        val code = login.add(800, null, editable = true, hint = "Verification code")
        val manager = TestScreen("com.android.credentialmanager")
        val account = manager.add(1500, "ana@example.com")
        val shop = TestScreen(title = "Shop")
        val bar = shop.add(80, null, id = "toolbar", clickable = false)
        shop.add(90, "Checkout", parent = bar, clickable = false)
        val next = shop.add(1800, "Continue")

        assertEquals("handover:CREDENTIALS", decide(Proposal("type_text", ActionKind.TYPE, Category.TYPING_REQUEST, targetKey = password, text = "secret"), login))
        assertEquals("handover:CREDENTIALS", decide(Proposal("type_text", ActionKind.TYPE, Category.TYPING_REQUEST, targetKey = code, text = "1234"), login))
        assertEquals("handover:CREDENTIALS", decide(tap(account), manager))
        assertEquals("handover:PAYMENT", decide(tap(next), shop, everything, Mode.FULL_AUTO))
    }

    @Test
    fun typingTheRequestRunsAndTypingScreenTextOrAPlaceholderAsks() {
        val screen = TestScreen()
        val field = screen.add(1800, null, editable = true, focused = true, hint = "Message")

        val task = TaskSafety.start("Send Ana a message that I'm 10 minutes late")
        fun type(text: String, key: String = field) = Proposal("type_text", ActionKind.TYPE, Category.TYPING_REQUEST, targetKey = key, text = text, frontAppLabel = "Chat")

        assertEquals("run", decide(type("I'm 10 minutes late"), screen, task))
        val screenText = SafetyCheck.decide(type("Meet at 5"), screen.snapshot(), task, standard) as Decision.Confirm
        assertEquals("Type 'Meet at 5' into 'Message' in Chat? Say confirm or cancel.", screenText.confirmation.question)
        val code = SafetyCheck.decide(type("[OTP_1]"), screen.snapshot(), task, standard.copy(mode = Mode.FULL_AUTO)) as Decision.Confirm
        assertEquals("Type 'your one-time code' into 'Message' in Chat? Say confirm or cancel.", code.confirmation.question)
        assertEquals("handover:CREDENTIALS", decide(type("[OTP_1]", password), screen, task, Mode.FULL_AUTO))
    }

    @Test

        val screen = titled()
        val send = screen.add(1800, "Send", left = 850)

        val asked = SafetyCheck.decide(tap(send), screen.snapshot(), nothing, standard.copy(mode = Mode.FULL_AUTO)) as Decision.Confirm
        assertTrue(asked.confirmation.question.startsWith("You didn't ask me to send anything. "))

    @Test

        val top = picker.add(200, "Close friends", parent = list)

        val flow = everything.copy(shareFlow = ShareFlow("org.telegram.messenger", emptyList(), ShareCount(1, 0), serial = 1))

        // "Close friends" lies in the toolbar band and holds "close", but a row is never a picker's control (review 2 I1).
        assertEquals(Category.SENDING, SafetyCheck.assess(tap(top), picker.snapshot(), flow, standard).category)
        assertEquals(Category.SENDING, SafetyCheck.assess(tap(ana), picker.snapshot(), flow, standard).category)

    @Test
    fun anActionThatSendsAndDeletesIsAskedAsASendAndNeedsTheAllowanceToSend() {
        val screen = titled()

    @Test

        val search = TestScreen()
        val field = search.add(100, null, editable = true, hint = "Search", text = "Ana")

        anr.window(2, "android", IntRect(100, 800, 900, 1400), kind = WindowKind.SYSTEM, active = true)
        val after = SafetyCheck.afterAction(tap(wait), anr.snapshot(), anr.snapshot(), everything)
        assertNull(after.shareFlow)

        val permission = TestScreen("com.google.android.permissioncontroller")
        val allow = permission.add(1500, "While using the app", id = "permission_allow_button")
        assertEquals("handover:PERMISSION_DIALOG", decide(tap(allow), permission))
    }

    @Test
    fun afterActionKeepsTheFlowTheTrailAndTheTypedTexts() {
        val gallery = TestScreen("com.example.gallery")
        val picker = TestScreen("org.telegram.messenger")
        val list = picker.add(300, null, scrollable = true, axis = ScrollAxis.VERTICAL, height = 1600, clickable = false)
        val row = picker.add(300, "Close friends", parent = list)
        val chat = TestScreen("org.telegram.messenger")
        chat.add(100, "Close friends", clickable = false)
        val share = Proposal("share_media", ActionKind.SHARE_MEDIA, receivingPackage = "org.telegram.messenger", shareCount = ShareCount(3, 0))

        val opened = SafetyCheck.afterAction(share, gallery.snapshot(), picker.snapshot(), everything)
        assertEquals(ShareFlow("org.telegram.messenger", emptyList(), ShareCount(3, 0), serial = 1), opened.shareFlow)
        val selected = SafetyCheck.afterAction(tap(row), picker.snapshot(), picker.snapshot(), opened)
        assertEquals(listOf("Close friends"), selected.shareFlow?.selected)
        assertNull(SafetyCheck.afterAction(tap(row), picker.snapshot(), chat.snapshot(), selected).shareFlow)
        // A second share is another flow (review 4 C2), and opening a link leaves the flow (review 2 C1).

        val typed = SafetyCheck.afterAction(Proposal("type_text", ActionKind.TYPE, targetKey = field, text = "I'm late"), compose.snapshot(), compose.snapshot(), everything)
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

/**
 * The ten rows of spec 12.3's table, in their order (design D13 of sub-project 5): a later row is more restrictive, so
 * the action's category is the highest that any source suggests. [wire] is the name in the tools' `category` enum.
 */
enum class Category(val wire: String) {
    READING("reading"),
    TYPING_REQUEST("typing_request"),
    ORDINARY_SETTINGS("ordinary_settings"),
    TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT("typing_screen_text"),
    SENDING("sending"),
    CALLS("calls"),
    DELETING("deleting"),
    PAYMENTS("payments"),
    CREDENTIALS("credentials"),
    PROTECTED("protected"),
    ;

    companion object {
        fun fromWire(name: String): Category? = entries.firstOrNull { it.wire == name }
    }
}

/** What kind of action a proposal is; each tool maps to one (design D10 and D13 of sub-project 5). */
enum class ActionKind {
    TAP,
    LONG_PRESS,
    TAP_AT,
    TYPE,
    SCROLL,
    SWIPE,
    BACK,
    HOME,
    WAIT,
    OPEN_APP,
    OPEN_URL,
    OPEN_DEEP_LINK,
    OPEN_SETTINGS,
    LOOK_CLOSER,

    /** `find_*`, `list_*` and `get_location`. */
    READ_DATA,

    /** `set_alarm`, `set_timer`, `create_event`, `media_control` and `navigate`. */
    SETTINGS_DATA,
    SHARE_MEDIA,
    COMPOSE_SMS,

    /** `ask_user`, `say`, `finish` and `fail`. */
    DIALOGUE,

    /** `remember` and `forget`, which always ask the owner themselves (spec 11.4). */
    MEMORY,
}

/** A point on the screen, in pixels. */
data class Point(val x: Int, val y: Int)

/** What `share_media` shares: how many photos and videos. */
data class ShareCount(val photos: Int, val videos: Int)

/**
 * An action that the agent or a routine proposes (design D13 of sub-project 5). [targetKey] names an element of the
 * snapshot that is checked with it; [point] is a `TapAt` in screen pixels, with [pointText], its OCR line; [text] is
 * `type_text`'s text with placeholders, never a vault value; [link] is `open_url`'s or `open_deep_link`'s link, which came
 * from the owner's request or memory when [linkFromOwner] is true, and [linkTargetPackage] is the package of the activity
 * that `:app` resolved for it; [receivingPackage] is the app that `share_media` or `compose_sms` opens. The launcher
 * labels come from `AppsPort`, because `:core:safety` cannot read them; null makes the question name the app by its
 * package's last part. Its text form prints only kinds and lengths.
 */
data class Proposal(
    val tool: String,
    val kind: ActionKind,
    val declared: Category? = null,
    val targetKey: String? = null,
    val point: Point? = null,
    val pointText: String? = null,
    val text: String? = null,
    val link: String? = null,
    val linkFromOwner: Boolean = false,
    val linkTargetPackage: String? = null,
    val receivingPackage: String? = null,
    val shareCount: ShareCount? = null,
    val frontAppLabel: String? = null,
    val receivingAppLabel: String? = null,
) {
    override fun toString(): String =
        "Proposal(tool=$tool, kind=$kind, declared=$declared, target=${targetKey != null}, point=${point != null}, " +
            "textLength=${text?.length ?: 0}, linkLength=${link?.length ?: 0})"
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect

/** What the safety check decides for a proposal (design D13 of sub-project 5). Every text form prints only kinds and lengths. */
sealed interface Decision {
    data object Run : Decision

    data class Confirm(val confirmation: Confirmation) : Decision

    data class HandOver(val handOver: dev.kestrel.safety.HandOver) : Decision

    /** [reason] is one of Kestrel's fixed sentences, which the model sees after "refused: ". */
    data class Block(val reason: String) : Decision {
        override fun toString(): String = "Block(reasonLength=${reason.length})"
    }
}

/** Why Kestrel stops acting and the owner acts himself (design D15 of sub-project 5). */
enum class HandOverKind { PAYMENT, CREDENTIALS, PERMISSION_DIALOG, CALL, PLAY_SERVICES, RECIPIENT, PERMISSION, ACCESS }

/** A hand-over with Kestrel's own text, which Kestrel speaks and the feedback bar shows. */
data class HandOver(val kind: HandOverKind, val text: String) {
    override fun toString(): String = "HandOver(kind=$kind, textLength=${text.length})"

    companion object {
        /** D15's fixed sentences; [HandOverKind.PERMISSION] and [HandOverKind.ACCESS] get theirs from the agent. */
        fun of(kind: HandOverKind): HandOver = HandOver(
            kind,
            when (kind) {
                HandOverKind.PAYMENT -> "This is a payment. Please finish it yourself, then say 'Kestrel, continue'."
                HandOverKind.CREDENTIALS -> "Please enter your password, then say 'Kestrel, continue'."
                HandOverKind.PERMISSION_DIALOG -> "The app asks for a permission. Please answer it, then say 'Kestrel, continue'."
                HandOverKind.CALL -> "Tap Call yourself if you want this call."
                HandOverKind.PLAY_SERVICES ->
                    "This is a Google Play services screen, which can show passwords. Please finish this step yourself, then say 'Kestrel, continue'."
                HandOverKind.RECIPIENT -> "I can't see who this goes to. Please check it and send it yourself, then say 'Kestrel, continue'."
                HandOverKind.PERMISSION -> "Kestrel needs a permission. Please answer Android's question."
                HandOverKind.ACCESS ->
                    "To read your notifications, Kestrel needs notification access. I'll open the page; turn on Kestrel, then say 'Kestrel, continue'."
            },
        )
    }
}

/**
 * A question that Kestrel's code built from the screen, never from the model's words (design D14 of sub-project 5):
 * [question] for the card, [spoken] for the voice (a long content is cut there), and what the owner confirms, so that
 * the fresh snapshot after his yes can be compared with it ([sameAs]).
 */
data class Confirmation(
    val question: String,
    val spoken: String,
    val category: Category,
    val recipients: List<String>,
    val appLabel: String?,
    val content: String?,
    val targetKey: String?,
    val targetBounds: IntRect?,
) {
    /** The same recipients, app, content, target key and bounds: a yes for one counts for the other. */
    fun sameAs(other: Confirmation): Boolean =
        recipients == other.recipients && appLabel == other.appLabel && content == other.content &&
            targetKey == other.targetKey && targetBounds == other.targetBounds

    override fun toString(): String =
        "Confirmation(category=$category, questionLength=${question.length}, recipients=${recipients.size}, " +
            "contentLength=${content?.length ?: 0}, target=${targetKey != null})"
}

/** Which rule suggested a category or changed a decision, for the activity log's `SAFETY` entry (design D25). */
enum class Source { DECLARED, FIXED, LABEL_WORDS, COMPOSE, PHONE_APP, SHARE_FLOW, PROTECTED_SCREEN, CREDENTIALS, PAYMENTS, TYPING, LINK, PLACEHOLDER, COVERED, TEST_MODE }

/**
 * The safety check's whole answer: the category with its sources, the decision before test mode, which the runs use to
 * judge Standard mode while test mode is on (design D27), and the final decision. [sends] is true when any source
 * suggests sending, also when a higher category wins ("Send and delete"), so that the question names the recipient and
 * test mode checks it (review 2 I2).
 */
data class Assessment(val category: Category, val sources: Set<Source>, val beforeTestMode: Decision, val decision: Decision, val sends: Boolean = false)
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer

/**
 * A text that a task typed, with the field that it went into: [text] is what was typed, a vault's value included, so it
 * stays in memory only and its text form prints lengths (design D14 and D17 of sub-project 5).
 */
data class TypedText(val fieldKey: String, val fieldName: String?, val packageName: String?, val text: String) {
    override fun toString(): String = "TypedText(fieldNameLength=${fieldName?.length ?: 0}, textLength=${text.length})"
}

/**
 * A share flow (design D13 of sub-project 5): from `share_media`, `compose_sms`, an app's Share or Forward button or a
 * system share sheet, until the app shows a chat titled as one of the [selected] rows, the task opens something else or
 * goes home, or it leaves the flow's apps. [selected] holds the name of every row that the agent tapped in the list of
 * rows, so that it is never smaller than the real selection. [serial] numbers the task's flows from 1, so that a second
 * share of other items to the same chat is another flow, which a yes for the first one never covers (review 4 C2).
 */
data class ShareFlow(val receivingPackage: String, val selected: List<String>, val count: ShareCount?, val serial: Int = 0) {
    override fun toString(): String = "ShareFlow(serial=$serial, selected=${selected.size}, count=${count != null})"
}

/** A protected trail in Settings, from the page whose heading [startTitle] started it (design D13 of sub-project 5). */
data class ProtectedTrail(val startTitle: String) {
    override fun toString(): String = "ProtectedTrail(titleLength=${startTitle.length})"
}

/**
 * The task's own state that the safety check reads (design D13 of sub-project 5): its allowance, the folded words of the
 * owner's request and answers, the memory values that it used, what it typed, its share flow and its protected trail,
 * how many share flows it started, and the vault's values that it revealed ([secrets], each with the words for its kind,
 * such as "your one-time code"), which a question names by those words, never by the value (design D14; review 2 I3).
 */
data class TaskSafety(
    val allowance: TaskAllowance,
    val ownerWords: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val memoryValues: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val typed: List<TypedText> = emptyList(),
    val shareFlow: ShareFlow? = null,
    val trail: ProtectedTrail? = null,
    val flows: Int = 0,
    val secrets: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
) {
    /** Adds the words of an answer of the owner's, so that typing them is typing the request. */
    fun withOwnerWords(text: String): TaskSafety = copy(ownerWords = ownerWords + Normalizer.words(text))

    /**
     * Remembers a vault's [value] that the task typed after the owner's yes, with the [words] that name its kind
     * (`Placeholders.forConfirmation` of its placeholder), so that a later question shows and speaks the words instead.
     */
    fun withSecret(value: String, words: String): TaskSafety = copy(secrets = secrets + (value to words))

    override fun toString(): String =
        "TaskSafety(allowance=$allowance, ownerWords=${ownerWords.size}, memoryValues=${memoryValues.size}, typed=${typed.size}, " +
            "shareFlow=$shareFlow, trail=$trail, flows=$flows, secrets=${secrets.size})"

    companion object {
        /** The state at a task's start, from the owner's [request] and the [knownNames] of memory and the contacts. */
        fun start(request: String, knownNames: Set<String> = emptySet()): TaskSafety =
            TaskSafety(TaskAllowance.from(request, knownNames), ownerWords = Normalizer.words(request).toSet())
    }
}

/**
 * What the safety check takes from Android and the owner's settings besides the snapshot (design D13 and D16): whether a
 * package is agent-free, Android's emergency-number check, the phone apps (the default phone app added by `:app`), and
 * the debug-only aliases that map a fixture's package to a real app's self-chat rule (design D18).
 */
data class SafetyEnvironment(
    val isAgentFree: (String?) -> Boolean = { it == "dev.kestrel" },
    val emergency: EmergencyNumbers = EmergencyNumbers.UNKNOWN,
    val phonePackages: Set<String> = EmergencyGuard.PHONE_PACKAGES,
    val selfChatAliases: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
) {
    override fun toString(): String = "SafetyEnvironment(phonePackages=${phonePackages.size}, aliases=${selfChatAliases.size})"
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer

/**
 * The words in a label that suggest a category (design D13 of sub-project 5; spec 12.2), in English and Serbian, folded
 * by [Normalizer], which removes diacritics and writes Cyrillic in Latin letters, so "пошаљи" and "pošalji" are both
 * "posalji". A word or phrase counts only whole, as consecutive words of the label.
 */
object LabelWords {
    private val WORDS: Map<Category, List<String>> = mapOf(
        Category.SENDING to listOf(
            "send", "post", "share", "confirm", "submit", "reply", "forward", "record", "voice message",
            "posalji", "posaljite", "objavi", "podeli", "podijeli", "podelite", "potvrdi", "potvrdite", "odgovori", "odgovorite",
            "prosledi", "prosledite", "snimi",
        ),
        Category.CALLS to listOf("call", "dial", "video call", "pozovi", "pozovite", "nazovi"),
        Category.DELETING to listOf(
            "delete", "remove", "erase", "clear", "discard", "trash", "bin",
            "obrisi", "obrisite", "izbrisi", "izbrisite", "ukloni", "uklonite",
        ),
        Category.PAYMENTS to listOf(
            "pay", "buy", "order", "checkout", "place order", "subscribe", "purchase",
            "plati", "platite", "kupi", "kupite", "naruci", "narucite", "pretplati",
        ),
        Category.PROTECTED to listOf(
            "install", "allow", "grant", "permit", "uninstall", "activate this device admin app",
            "instaliraj", "instalirajte", "dozvoli", "dozvolite",
        ),
    )

    /** A tap on these is checked against the typed texts before it runs (design D14): a send's words and these. */
    val SAVE_WORDS: Set<String> = setOf("save", "done", "apply", "ok", "sacuvaj", "gotovo", "primeni")

    /** A tap on these starts a share flow (design D13). */
    val SHARE_START_WORDS: Set<String> = setOf("share", "forward", "podeli", "podijeli", "prosledi")

    /** The most restrictive category whose words occur in [text], or null. */
    fun categoryOf(text: String?): Category? {
        val words = Normalizer.words(text ?: return null)
        if (words.isEmpty()) return null
        return WORDS.entries.filter { (_, list) -> list.any { holds(words, it) } }.maxOfOrNull { it.key }
    }

    /** Whether [text] holds a word of [category], also when the words of a higher category occur too. */
    fun holds(text: String?, category: Category): Boolean {
        val words = Normalizer.words(text ?: return false)
        return WORDS[category].orEmpty().any { holds(words, it) }
    }

    /** Whether [text] holds one of [words] (folded words or phrases) as whole words. */
    fun holdsWord(text: String?, words: Set<String>): Boolean {
        val folded = Normalizer.words(text ?: return false)
        return words.any { holds(folded, it) }
    }

    private fun holds(words: List<String>, phrase: String): Boolean {
        val parts = phrase.split(' ')
        if (parts.size > words.size) return false
        return (0..words.size - parts.size).any { start -> parts.indices.all { words[start + it] == parts[it] } }
    }
}
```

Create `core/safety/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/safety/TaskAllowance.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer

/**
 * Which of sending, calls and deleting the owner's own words ask for (design D13 of sub-project 5; decision 6; research
 * r52's tool filter). It reads verbs in a command position, never nouns, and never screen text: [from] takes only the
 * owner's request and the names that memory and the contacts know.
 */
class TaskAllowance(val categories: Set<Category>) {
    /** Reading, typing the request and ordinary settings always; typing screen text when sending is allowed. */
    fun allows(category: Category): Boolean = when (category) {
        Category.READING, Category.TYPING_REQUEST, Category.ORDINARY_SETTINGS -> true
        Category.TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT -> Category.SENDING in categories || category in categories
        else -> category in categories
    }

    /** The task message's sentence about the allowance (design D3). */
    fun describe(): String {
        val parts = listOfNotNull(
            "send messages".takeIf { Category.SENDING in categories },
            "delete things".takeIf { Category.DELETING in categories },
        )
        val calls = if (Category.CALLS in categories) " It may open a call for the owner to place himself." else ""
        if (parts.isEmpty()) return "This task may not send, call or delete anything without asking the owner." + calls
        return "This task may ${parts.joinToString(" and ")} after the owner confirms." + calls
    }

    override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean = other is TaskAllowance && other.categories == categories

    override fun hashCode(): Int = categories.hashCode()

    override fun toString(): String = "TaskAllowance(${categories.sorted().joinToString()})"

    companion object {
        val NONE = TaskAllowance(emptySet())

        private val POSITIONS = setOf("and", "then", "please", "also", "kestrel")
        private val NOT_NAMES = setOf("me", "my", "mi", "meni", "the", "a", "an", "this", "that", "all", "it")
        private val MESSAGE_MARKS = setOf("that", "saying", "about", "da")
        private val DURATIONS = setOf("second", "seconds", "minute", "minutes", "hour", "hours", "sekund", "sekundi", "minut", "minuta", "sat", "sati")
        private val ANY_OBJECT = mapOf(
            "send" to Category.SENDING, "share" to Category.SENDING, "posalji" to Category.SENDING, "odgovori" to Category.SENDING,
            "podeli" to Category.SENDING, "podijeli" to Category.SENDING, "prosledi" to Category.SENDING, "objavi" to Category.SENDING,
            "dial" to Category.CALLS, "ring" to Category.CALLS, "pozovi" to Category.CALLS, "nazovi" to Category.CALLS,
            "delete" to Category.DELETING, "remove" to Category.DELETING, "erase" to Category.DELETING,
            "obrisi" to Category.DELETING, "izbrisi" to Category.DELETING,
        )
        private val NAMED = mapOf(
            "message" to Category.SENDING, "text" to Category.SENDING, "email" to Category.SENDING, "answer" to Category.SENDING,
            "tell" to Category.SENDING, "javi" to Category.SENDING, "call" to Category.CALLS,
        )

        /**
         * The allowance of [request]. A verb counts at the start or after "and", "then", "please", "also" or "Kestrel".
         * "message", "text", "e-mail", "answer", "tell", "javi" and "call" need a name after them that is not "me",
         * "my", "mi", "meni", an article, a determiner or a number, and either a message after it ("that", "saying",
         * "to say", "about", "da", a colon or a quote) or a name of [knownNames]; "forward" and "post" need an object that is
         * no number or length of time; "reply" needs "to"; "clear" needs a noun.
         */
        fun from(request: String, knownNames: Set<String> = emptySet()): TaskAllowance {
            val folded = Normalizer.withOffsets(request)
            val words = folded.words.map { folded.text.substring(it) }
            val known = knownNames.map { Normalizer.words(it) }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            val found = HashSet<Category>()
            for ((index, word) in words.withIndex()) {
                if (index > 0 && words[index - 1] !in POSITIONS) continue
                val rest = words.drop(index + 1)
                ANY_OBJECT[word]?.let { found += it }
                val email = word == "e" && rest.firstOrNull() == "mail"
                val named = if (email) Category.SENDING else NAMED[word]
                if (named != null) {
                    val after = if (email) rest.drop(1) else rest
                    val raw = if (email) folded.span(index + 2, words.size) else folded.span(index + 1, words.size)
                    if (namesSomeone(after, request.substring(raw), known)) found += named
                }
                when (word) {
                    "reply" -> if (rest.firstOrNull() == "to") found += Category.SENDING
                    "forward", "post" -> if (isObject(rest)) found += Category.SENDING
                    "clear" -> if (rest.isNotEmpty() && rest.first().none(Char::isDigit)) found += Category.DELETING
                }
            }
            return TaskAllowance(found)
        }

        private fun namesSomeone(after: List<String>, rawAfter: String, known: List<List<String>>): Boolean {
            val first = after.firstOrNull() ?: return false
            if (first in NOT_NAMES || first.any(Char::isDigit)) return false
            if (known.any { name -> after.size >= name.size && after.subList(0, name.size) == name }) return true
            val message = after.drop(1).take(3)
            return message.any { it in MESSAGE_MARKS } || (message.take(2) == listOf("to", "say")) ||
                ':' in rawAfter || '"' in rawAfter || '\u201C' in rawAfter || '\u201E' in rawAfter
        }

        private fun isObject(rest: List<String>): Boolean {
            val first = rest.firstOrNull() ?: return false
            if (first.any(Char::isDigit) || first in DURATIONS) return false
            return rest.getOrNull(1) !in DURATIONS
        }
    }
}
```

Create `core/safety/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/safety/EmergencyGuard.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.commands.phone.PhoneNumbers
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenElement
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot

/** Android's emergency-number check, which `:app` passes in: null when Android cannot tell (design D13 of sub-project 5). */
fun interface EmergencyNumbers {
    fun isEmergency(digits: String): Boolean?

    companion object {
        /** Cannot tell, which counts as an emergency number wherever it matters. */
        val UNKNOWN = EmergencyNumbers { null }
    }
}

/**
 * The pure parts of plan 3C's emergency guard (design spec, section 8.7), moved from `:app`'s `CallCommands.kt` so that
 * the agent's safety check uses the same rules (design D13 of sub-project 5): R1's words, R2's phone packages and the
 * rules of a phone app's number field. `:app`'s guard calls these.
 */
object EmergencyGuard {
    /** The phone apps and Android's call services; `:app` adds the default phone app. */
    val PHONE_PACKAGES: Set<String> = setOf(
        "com.android.phone", "com.android.dialer", "com.google.android.dialer", "com.samsung.android.dialer",
        "com.samsung.android.incallui", "com.android.server.telecom",
        // One UI's emergency dialer.
        "com.samsung.android.app.telephonyui",
    )

    /** The contacts apps, where a tap on a number row places a call (design D13 of sub-project 5). */
    val CONTACTS_PACKAGES: Set<String> = setOf("com.android.contacts", "com.google.android.contacts", "com.samsung.android.app.contacts")

    private val EMERGENCY_WORDS = setOf("emergency", "sos")
    private val DELETE_IDS = setOf("deletebutton", "delete_button", "backspace")
    private val DELETE_NAMES = setOf("delete", "backspace", "erase")
    private const val DIGITS = ":id/digits"
    private const val KESTREL = "dev.kestrel"

    /** R1: whether the name of element [index] holds "emergency" or "sos"; never Kestrel's own windows, such as its bar. */
    fun emergencyNamed(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int): Boolean {
        val element = snapshot.elements[index]
        if (element.packageName == KESTREL) return false
        // A view ID such as "emergencyButton" or "sos_call" splits into words.
        val id = element.viewId?.substringAfter(":id/")?.replace(Regex("([a-z])([A-Z])"), "$1 $2")
        val names = listOfNotNull(element.text, element.contentDescription, id, element.label.takeIf { element.isActionable })
        return names.any { name -> Normalizer.words(name).any { it in EMERGENCY_WORDS } }
    }

    /**
     * Whether [element] is a phone app's number field: a text field, or a field with the view ID `digits`, which
     * Android's emergency dialer does not make editable.
     */
    fun isNumberField(element: ScreenElement): Boolean =
        element.editable && !element.password || element.viewId?.endsWith(DIGITS) == true

    /**
     * Whether the number field [element] shows [text] as a number: the field with the view ID `digits` with any text,
     * and another text field only with a digit, `*` or `#`, so that a name in the phone app's search box counts as none.
     */
    fun showsNumber(element: ScreenElement, text: String?): Boolean {
        if (text.isNullOrBlank() || !isNumberField(element)) return false
        return element.viewId?.endsWith(DIGITS) == true || text.any { it.isDigit() || it == '*' || it == '#' }
    }

    /**
     * Whether [element] is a phone app's delete key: by its view ID, or, when it takes a touch, by a whole name such as
     * "Delete" or "Backspace".
     */
    fun isDeleteKey(element: ScreenElement): Boolean {
        if (element.viewId?.substringAfter(":id/")?.lowercase() in DELETE_IDS) return true
        if (!element.clickable && !element.longClickable) return false
        return listOfNotNull(element.text, element.contentDescription).any { Normalizer.normalize(it) in DELETE_NAMES }
    }

    /**
     * Whether [element]'s own text or content description, trimmed, is as a whole a number that a phone app dials and
     * that Android reports as an emergency number, or cannot check ([emergency] not false).
     */
    fun showsEmergencyNumber(element: ScreenElement, emergency: (String) -> Boolean?): Boolean =
        listOfNotNull(element.text, element.contentDescription).any { text ->
            val digits = PhoneNumbers.dialable(text.trim()) ?: return@any false
            emergency(PhoneNumbers.mainNumber(digits)) != false
        }

    /**
     * Whether Kestrel may call [digits] itself (design D11 of sub-project 3): a long number without "*" or "#" that
     * Android reports as no emergency number; when Kestrel cannot tell ([emergency] null), it may not.
     */
    fun mayCall(digits: String, emergency: Boolean?): Boolean = PhoneNumbers.mayAutoDial(digits) && emergency == false

    /**
     * Whether a `tel:` link may open the dial screen with [number] (design D11 and D32 item 12 of sub-project 5): never
     * an emergency number, one that Android cannot check, one with fewer than 5 digits, or one with `*` or `#`.
     */
    fun telAllowed(number: String, emergency: EmergencyNumbers): Boolean {
        val digits = PhoneNumbers.dialable(number) ?: return false
        if (digits.any { it == '*' || it == '#' }) return false
        return mayCall(digits, emergency.isEmergency(PhoneNumbers.mainNumber(digits)))
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import java.net.URI
import java.net.URISyntaxException

/** What [LinkCheck] says about a link: it may open with at least [Allowed.category], or it is refused with a sentence. */
sealed interface LinkVerdict {
    data class Allowed(val category: Category) : LinkVerdict

    data class Refused(val reason: String) : LinkVerdict {
        override fun toString(): String = "Refused(reasonLength=${reason.length})"
    }
}

/**
 * Checks every link before Kestrel opens it (design D11 and D32 item 12 of sub-project 5): `open_url` opens only `https`,
 * `open_deep_link` only spec 11.4's schemes, never `intent:`, `file:`, `content:`, `javascript:` or `android-app:`, and
 * never a link whose activity belongs to Kestrel, an agent-free app or Play services. A `tel:` link opens only the dial
 * screen, and only for a number that Kestrel may dial ([EmergencyGuard.telAllowed]). A link that came from the screen or
 * a data tool and carries a query or a fragment with data ("=", "&" or a digit; a section anchor is none) sends that data
 * off the phone, so it is `SENDING` (research r52, fixture 12; review 2 M5 and 2-2 New 5). Data in a link's path is not recognised; spec 12.1 names that gap.
 */
object LinkCheck {
    val DEEP_LINK_SCHEMES: Set<String> = setOf("viber", "whatsapp", "tg", "waze", "google.navigation", "geo", "tel", "sms", "mailto")
    private val NEVER = setOf("intent", "file", "content", "javascript", "android-app")
    private val SCHEME = Regex("^([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*):")
    private const val PLAY_SERVICES = "com.google.android.gms"
    private const val KESTREL = "dev.kestrel"

    fun check(
        link: String,
        kind: ActionKind,
        fromOwner: Boolean,
        targetPackage: String?,
        isAgentFree: (String?) -> Boolean,
        emergency: EmergencyNumbers,
    ): LinkVerdict {
        val text = link.trim()
        val scheme = SCHEME.find(text)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.lowercase() ?: return LinkVerdict.Refused("The link has no scheme.")
        if (scheme in NEVER) return LinkVerdict.Refused("Kestrel never opens $scheme links.")
        when (kind) {
            ActionKind.OPEN_URL -> if (scheme != "https") return LinkVerdict.Refused("Only https links.")
            ActionKind.OPEN_DEEP_LINK -> if (scheme !in DEEP_LINK_SCHEMES) return LinkVerdict.Refused("Kestrel opens no $scheme links.")
            else -> return LinkVerdict.Refused("Only open_url and open_deep_link open links.")
        }
        if (scheme == "https") {
            val host = try {
                URI(text).host
            } catch (e: URISyntaxException) {
                null
            }
            if (host.isNullOrEmpty()) return LinkVerdict.Refused("The link cannot be read.")
        }
        if (targetPackage == KESTREL || targetPackage == PLAY_SERVICES || (targetPackage != null && isAgentFree(targetPackage))) {
            return LinkVerdict.Refused("The link opens an app that the agent may not use.")
        }
        if (scheme == "tel") {
            val number = text.substringAfter(':').substringBefore('?')
            if (!EmergencyGuard.telAllowed(number, emergency)) return LinkVerdict.Refused("Kestrel doesn't open this number; dial it yourself.")
        }
        // Data in the query or the fragment of a link that the screen or a data tool gave leaves the phone with it. A
        // fragment counts only when it holds "=", "&" or a digit, because a section anchor ("#History") is a word.
        val fragment = text.substringAfter('#', "")
        val data = text.substringAfter('?', "").substringBefore('#').isNotEmpty() || fragment.any { it == '=' || it == '&' || it.isDigit() }
        val category = if (!fromOwner && data) Category.SENDING else Category.READING
        return LinkVerdict.Allowed(category)
    }
}
```
