```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

/**
 * Kestrel's typed placeholders (design D17 of sub-project 5), such as `[OTP_1]`, which stand for values that the task's
 * vault keeps on the phone. A text that holds one is typed only after the owner's yes, and a confirmation names its kind,
 * never its value.
 */
object Placeholders {
    val PATTERN = Regex("\\[(OTP|CARD|IBAN|JMBG|TOKEN)_(\\d+)]")

    private val SPOKEN = mapOf(
        "OTP" to "your one-time code",
        "CARD" to "your card number",
        "IBAN" to "your IBAN",
        "JMBG" to "your JMBG number",
        "TOKEN" to "your access token",
    )

    fun holdsOne(text: String?): Boolean = text != null && PATTERN.containsMatchIn(text)

    /** [text] with each placeholder replaced by its kind's words for a confirmation: "your one-time code". */
    fun forConfirmation(text: String): String = PATTERN.replace(text) { SPOKEN.getValue(it.groupValues[1]) }
}

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenElement
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTitle
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScrollAxis
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowKind
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowSummary

/**
 * The context rules of the safety check (design D13 of sub-project 5; spec 12.2): compose screens, phone and contacts
 * apps, share flows, protected screens and the protected trail, credentials and payments. Their packages and words are
 * data here; plan 5B adds One UI's share panel and device-admin screen when it has recorded them.
 */
internal object ContextRules {
    const val SETTINGS = "com.android.settings"
    const val PLAY_STORE = "com.android.vending"
    const val CREDENTIAL_MANAGER = "com.android.credentialmanager"
    val SHARE_SHEETS = setOf("com.android.intentresolver", "android")
    private const val INTENT_RESOLVER = "com.android.intentresolver"

    /** The view IDs of Android's own chooser in the `android` package (review 2 M1). */
    private val CHOOSER_IDS = setOf("resolver_list", "chooser_header", "profile_pager", "chooser_action_row")

    /** The view IDs of an app's permission dialog, which some versions show in a full-height window (review 2 M11). */
    private val PERMISSION_IDS = setOf("permission_allow_button", "permission_deny_button", "grant_dialog")
    private val ROW_LISTS = listOf("RecyclerView", "ListView", "GridView")
    val PERMISSION_CONTROLLERS = setOf("com.google.android.permissioncontroller", "com.android.permissioncontroller")
    val INSTALLERS = setOf("com.android.packageinstaller", "com.google.android.packageinstaller")

    private val PLAY_WORDS = setOf("install", "update", "uninstall", "buy", "purchase", "play protect")
    private val TRAIL_WORDS = setOf(
        "security", "accessibility", "device admin", "unknown apps", "install apps", "special app access", "special access",
        "biometrics", "fingerprint", "face", "screen lock", "lock screen", "passwords",
    )
    private val NOT_MESSAGE_WORDS = setOf("search", "query", "url", "address", "find", "pretraga", "trazi")
    private val CREDENTIAL_WORDS = setOf("code", "otp", "pin", "kod", "sifra", "lozinka", "password", "card number", "cvv", "cvc")
    private val CREDENTIAL_PAGES = setOf("password manager", "passwords")
    private val PAYMENT_WORDS = setOf("checkout", "payment", "placanje", "kasa")
    private val PICKER_WORDS = setOf("search", "pretraga", "trazi", "back", "close", "nazad", "zatvori", "navigate up")
    private val CLEAR_COMPANIONS = setOf("text", "search", "query")
    private val TAB_CLASSES = listOf("TabLayout", "TabWidget", "TabRow", "TabView", "Tab")

    /** A page's heading by the title's rules 1 to 3, never the window's title (design D13). */
    fun heading(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, window: WindowSummary): String? = ScreenTitle.of(snapshot, window, appLabel = null)

    /** The heading of a Settings page that starts a protected trail, or null. */
    fun trailHeading(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot): String? {
        val window = ScreenTree.frontWindow(snapshot)?.takeIf { it.packageName == SETTINGS } ?: return null
        return heading(snapshot, window)?.takeIf { LabelWords.holdsWord(it, TRAIL_WORDS) }
    }

    /**
     * Whether Android's permission dialog of an app shows in [window]: a permission controller's window smaller than the
     * screen, or one that shows the grant dialog's own view IDs.
     */
    fun isPermissionDialog(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, window: WindowSummary): Boolean {
        if (window.packageName !in PERMISSION_CONTROLLERS) return false
        if (snapshot.elements.any { it.windowId == window.id && ScreenTree.idName(it.viewId) in PERMISSION_IDS }) return true
        val tallest = snapshot.windows.maxOfOrNull { it.bounds.height } ?: return false
        return window.bounds.height < tallest * 0.9
    }

    /** Whether [window] is a protected screen, on which every action that presses or types is blocked (design D13). */
    fun isProtected(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, window: WindowSummary, trail: ProtectedTrail?): Boolean {
        val pkg = window.packageName
        if (pkg in PERMISSION_CONTROLLERS || pkg in INSTALLERS) return true
        val inWindow = snapshot.elements.filter { it.windowId == window.id }
        if (pkg == PLAY_STORE) return inWindow.any { LabelWords.holdsWord(ScreenTree.name(it), PLAY_WORDS) }
        if (pkg != SETTINGS) return false
        return trail != null || trailHeading(snapshot) != null ||
            inWindow.any { LabelWords.holdsWord(it.text ?: it.label, setOf("device admin")) }
    }

    /**
     * A field that composes a message in window [windowId]: editable, focused or not empty, and not a password, search,
     * URL or address field (its view ID, hint and names hold none of their words).
     */
    fun composeField(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, windowId: Int): ScreenElement? = snapshot.elements.firstOrNull { element ->
        element.windowId == windowId && element.editable && !element.password &&
            (element.focused || !element.text.isNullOrBlank()) && !notMessageField(element)
    }

    /**
     * A chat's message field in window [windowId], focused or not, empty or not: so a chat whose field is empty is still a
     * chat, never a dialog (review 2-2 New 1).
     */
    fun messageField(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, windowId: Int): ScreenElement? = snapshot.elements.firstOrNull { element ->
        element.windowId == windowId && element.editable && !element.password && !notMessageField(element)
    }

    /**
     * Whether window [windowId] shows [name] as whole words in a text outside every list of rows, so that a message in a
     * chat's list never names a recipient, and "Ana" is never found in "Anastasia" (review 2-2 New 1).
     */
    fun showsName(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, windowId: Int, name: String): Boolean {
        val wanted = Normalizer.words(name).takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() } ?: return false
        return snapshot.elements.indices.any { index ->
            val element = snapshot.elements[index]
            element.windowId == windowId && rowsList(snapshot, index) == null &&
                listOfNotNull(element.text, element.contentDescription).any { text ->
                    val words = Normalizer.words(text)
                    (0..words.size - wanted.size).any { start -> wanted.indices.all { words[start + it] == wanted[it] } }
                }
        }
    }

    /** Whether a field's view ID, hint or names hold a search, URL or address word, so that it composes no message. */
    fun notMessageField(element: ScreenElement): Boolean =
        listOf(ScreenTree.idName(element.viewId), element.hint, element.label, element.contentDescription)
            .any { LabelWords.holdsWord(it?.replace('_', ' '), NOT_MESSAGE_WORDS) }

    /** Whether the unlabelled element [index] lies in the compose field's row or in the bar right above or below it. */
    fun nearCompose(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int): Boolean {
        val element = snapshot.elements[index]
        if (ScreenTree.name(element) != null || element.editable) return false
        val field = composeField(snapshot, element.windowId) ?: return false
        val band = field.bounds.height
        return element.bounds.bottom > field.bounds.top - band && element.bounds.top < field.bounds.bottom + band
    }

    fun isPhoneApp(packageName: String?, phonePackages: Set<String>): Boolean =
        packageName != null && (packageName in phonePackages || packageName in EmergencyGuard.CONTACTS_PACKAGES)

    /** Whether element [index] is a credentials field, or lies on a biometric prompt, an autofill picker or a password page. */
    fun isCredential(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int, window: WindowSummary?): Boolean {
        val element = snapshot.elements[index]
        if (element.password) return true
        val names = listOf(element.label, element.hint, element.contentDescription, ScreenTree.idName(element.viewId)?.replace('_', ' '))
        if (element.editable && names.any { LabelWords.holdsWord(it, CREDENTIAL_WORDS) }) return true
        val inWindow = snapshot.elements.filter { it.windowId == element.windowId }
        if (inWindow.any { ScreenTree.idName(it.viewId)?.lowercase()?.let { id -> "biometric" in id || "autofill" in id } == true }) return true
        return window != null && LabelWords.holdsWord(heading(snapshot, window), CREDENTIAL_PAGES)
    }

    /** Whether [window] is a checkout or payment screen: its heading or one of its buttons holds a payment word. */
    fun isPayment(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, window: WindowSummary): Boolean =
        LabelWords.holdsWord(heading(snapshot, window), PAYMENT_WORDS) ||
            snapshot.elements.any { it.windowId == window.id && it.clickable && LabelWords.holdsWord(ScreenTree.name(it), PAYMENT_WORDS) }

    /**
     * A share picker's own control outside its list of rows (design D13, review B3-M1): in the toolbar band or a tab bar,
     * named search, back or close, or a tab. Every element inside the list of rows stays `SENDING`.
     */
    fun pickerControl(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int, window: WindowSummary): Boolean {
        if (rowsList(snapshot, index) != null) return false
        val element = snapshot.elements[index]
        val band = window.bounds.top + window.bounds.height * ScreenTitle.TOP_BAND
        val lineage = listOf(index) + ScreenTree.ancestors(snapshot, index)
        val tabBar = lineage.any { position -> TAB_CLASSES.any { snapshot.elements[position].className.orEmpty().endsWith(it) } }
        if (!(ScreenTree.inToolbar(snapshot, index) || element.bounds.centerY < band || tabBar)) return false
        val tab = TAB_CLASSES.any { element.className.orEmpty().endsWith(it) }
        return tab || listOf(ScreenTree.name(element), ScreenTree.idName(element.viewId)?.replace('_', ' '))
            .any { LabelWords.holdsWord(it, PICKER_WORDS) }
    }

    /**
     * Whether element [index] is a field's own "Clear" (design D13, review B2-M3): its label is "Clear" alone or with
     * "text", "search", "query" or the field's name, and it lies inside an editable field or in its row.
     */
    fun clearsAField(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int): Boolean {
        val element = snapshot.elements[index]
        val words = Normalizer.words(ScreenTree.name(element) ?: return false)
        if (words.firstOrNull() != "clear" || words.size > 3) return false
        val ancestorField = ScreenTree.ancestors(snapshot, index).map { snapshot.elements[it] }.firstOrNull { it.editable }
        val rowField = snapshot.elements.firstOrNull { field ->
            field.editable && field.windowId == element.windowId &&
                element.bounds.bottom > field.bounds.top && element.bounds.top < field.bounds.bottom
        }
        val field = ancestorField ?: rowField ?: return false
        val rest = words.drop(1)
        val fieldName = Normalizer.words(field.hint ?: field.label ?: field.contentDescription ?: "")
        return rest.isEmpty() || rest.all { it in CLEAR_COMPANIONS } || (fieldName.isNotEmpty() && rest == fieldName)
    }

    /** Whether a window above the front app's window covers the point (design D13, review B I3). */
    fun covered(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, point: Point): Boolean {
        val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(snapshot) ?: return true
        return snapshot.windows.any { window ->
            window.id != front.id && window.layer > front.layer &&
                point.x >= window.bounds.left && point.x < window.bounds.right && point.y >= window.bounds.top && point.y < window.bounds.bottom
        }
    }

    /** The indices of the front window's elements that hold the point, innermost last. */
    fun atPoint(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, point: Point): List<Int> {
        val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(snapshot) ?: return emptyList()
        return snapshot.elements.indices.filter { index ->
            val element = snapshot.elements[index]
            element.windowId == front.id && point.x >= element.bounds.left && point.x < element.bounds.right &&
                point.y >= element.bounds.top && point.y < element.bounds.bottom
        }
    }

    /**
     * Whether [window] is Android's share sheet: the intent resolver's window, or an app window of the `android` package
     * that shows the chooser's own view IDs, so that an ANR dialog or a system alert never starts a share flow.
     */
    fun isShareSheet(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, window: WindowSummary): Boolean = when (window.packageName) {
        INTENT_RESOLVER -> window.kind != WindowKind.INPUT_METHOD
        "android" -> window.kind == WindowKind.APPLICATION &&
            snapshot.elements.any { it.windowId == window.id && ScreenTree.idName(it.viewId) in CHOOSER_IDS }
        else -> false
    }

    /** Whether a share sheet of Android shows in front. */
    fun shareSheetInFront(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot): Boolean = snapshot.windows.any { it.active && isShareSheet(snapshot, it) }

    /** Whether [element] is a list of rows, as a picker shows them, whether it scrolls or not (review 2 I1). */
    fun isRowsList(element: ScreenElement): Boolean {
        // A tab strip or a carousel is no list of rows (review 2-2 New 2).
        if (element.scrollAxis == ScrollAxis.HORIZONTAL) return false
        if (ScreenTree.isVerticalList(element) || element.scrollAxis == ScrollAxis.VERTICAL) return true
        val name = element.className.orEmpty()
        return !name.endsWith("HorizontalScrollView") && ROW_LISTS.any { name.endsWith(it) }
    }

    /** The nearest ancestor of element [index] that is a list of rows, or null. */
    fun rowsList(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int): Int? =
        ScreenTree.ancestors(snapshot, index).firstOrNull { isRowsList(snapshot.elements[it]) }

    /** The row of a list of rows that holds element [index]: the list's direct child on its line of ancestors, or null. */
    fun row(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int): Int? {
        val list = rowsList(snapshot, index) ?: return null
        var current = index
        while (true) {
            val parent = snapshot.elements[current].parent ?: return null
            if (parent == list) return current
            current = parent
        }
    }

    /**
     * A row's name as the screen shows it: the first text inside the row in reading order, else the row's own name, else
     * the first name inside it; null for a row without any (review 2 I1). A row named by all its texts at once ("Ana See you
     * 12:30") is named by its first text ("Ana").
     */
    fun rowName(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, row: Int): String? {
        val inside = snapshot.elements.indices.filter { it == row || row in ScreenTree.ancestors(snapshot, it) }
            .sortedWith(compareBy({ snapshot.elements[it].bounds.top }, { snapshot.elements[it].bounds.left }))
        inside.firstNotNullOfOrNull { snapshot.elements[it].text?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty) }?.let { return it }
        ScreenTree.name(snapshot.elements[row])?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { return it }
        return inside.firstNotNullOfOrNull { ScreenTree.name(snapshot.elements[it])?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty) }
    }

    /** The rows of [windowId] that hold a checked element: a picker's selection as the screen shows it. */
    fun checkedRows(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, windowId: Int): List<Int> = snapshot.elements.indices.filter {
        val element = snapshot.elements[it]
        element.windowId == windowId && element.checkable && element.checked
    }.mapNotNull { row(snapshot, it) }.distinct()
}

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTitle
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree

/**
 * Builds each confirmation from the screen, never from the model's words (design D14 of sub-project 5; spec 12.4). A
 * question names the app by its launcher label (or its package's last part), the content as the screen shows it, and a
 * placeholder by its kind; a long content is cut on the voice and shown whole on the card. When the code cannot fill a
 * question, it hands over instead.
 */
object ConfirmationBuilder {
    private const val SPOKEN_LIMIT = 200
    private const val TAIL = " Say confirm or cancel."

    fun build(proposal: Proposal, screen: ScreenSnapshot, category: Category, task: TaskSafety, why: String? = null): Decision {
        val index = proposal.targetKey?.let { key -> screen.elements.indexOfFirst { it.key == key }.takeIf { it >= 0 } }
        val element = index?.let { screen.elements[it] }
        val window = screen.windows.firstOrNull { it.id == element?.windowId } ?: ScreenTree.frontWindow(screen)
        val app = appName(proposal.frontAppLabel, window?.packageName)
        val prefix = why?.let { "$it " }.orEmpty()
        fun ask(body: String, content: String?, recipients: List<String> = emptyList()): Decision {
            val question = prefix + body + TAIL
            return Decision.Confirm(
                Confirmation(question, spoken(prefix, body, content), category, recipients, app, content, proposal.targetKey, element?.bounds),
            )
        }
        when (proposal.kind) {
            ActionKind.SHARE_MEDIA -> {
                val receiver = appName(proposal.receivingAppLabel, proposal.receivingPackage)
                return ask("Open $receiver's share screen with ${items(proposal.shareCount)}?", null)
            }
            ActionKind.COMPOSE_SMS -> return ask("Open the messages app with a text message?", null)
            ActionKind.TYPE -> {
                val text = Placeholders.forConfirmation(proposal.text.orEmpty())
                val field = element?.let { it.hint ?: it.contentDescription ?: it.label } ?: "the field"
                return ask("Type '${text}' into '$field' in $app?", text)
            }
            else -> Unit
        }
        val name = element?.let { ScreenTree.name(it) }
        if (task.shareFlow == null && LabelWords.holdsWord(name, LabelWords.SHARE_START_WORDS)) {
            return ask("Share this from $app? You'll choose the chat next.", null)
        }
        if (category == Category.DELETING) {
            val selected = window?.let { w -> screen.elements.count { it.windowId == w.id && it.checkable && it.checked } } ?: 0
            val title = window?.let { ScreenTitle.of(screen, it, proposal.frontAppLabel, withRule3 = false) }
                ?.takeIf { !it.equals(proposal.frontAppLabel, ignoreCase = true) }
            return when {
                selected > 0 -> ask("Delete $selected ${if (selected == 1) "item" else "items"} in $app?", "$selected")
                title != null -> ask("Delete '$title' in $app?", title)
                else -> Decision.HandOver(
                    HandOver(HandOverKind.RECIPIENT, "I can't see what this deletes. Please check it and do it yourself, then say 'Kestrel, continue'."),
                )
            }
        }
        val target = name ?: proposal.pointText ?: "this"
        return ask("Tap '$target' in $app?", null)
    }

    /** The app's launcher label, or the last part of its package. */
    fun appName(label: String?, packageName: String?): String =
        label?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: packageName?.substringAfterLast('.') ?: "this app"

    private fun items(count: ShareCount?): String {
        count ?: return "the items"
        val parts = listOfNotNull(
            count.photos.takeIf { it > 0 }?.let { "$it ${if (it == 1) "photo" else "photos"}" },
            count.videos.takeIf { it > 0 }?.let { "$it ${if (it == 1) "video" else "videos"}" },
        )
        return parts.joinToString(" and ").ifEmpty { "the items" }
    }

    /** The spoken question: a content over 200 characters is cut at its last word before 200, with how much is left. */
    fun spoken(prefix: String, body: String, content: String?): String {
        if (content == null || content.length <= SPOKEN_LIMIT) return prefix + body + TAIL
        val cut = content.substring(0, SPOKEN_LIMIT).substringBeforeLast(' ').ifEmpty { content.substring(0, SPOKEN_LIMIT) }
        val left = content.length - cut.length
        return prefix + body.replace(content, "$cut… and $left more characters") + TAIL
    }
}

Create `core/safety/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/safety/SafetyCheck.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTitle
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowSummary

/**
 * The safety check (design D13 of sub-project 5; spec 12.1 to 12.3): a pure function of a proposal, the fresh snapshot,
 * the task's state and the settings, called for every action that the agent or a routine proposes, before anything runs.
 * The action's category is the most restrictive that any source suggests: the declared or fixed category, the words of
 * the label that the action reaches, and the context rules. The mode decides run or confirm per row; the floor (payments
 * and credentials hand over, protected blocks) holds in every mode, every call of the agent is handed over, and an action
 * outside the task's allowance is confirmed in every mode, as is typing a placeholder.
 */
object SafetyCheck {
    private val ACTING = setOf(ActionKind.TAP, ActionKind.LONG_PRESS, ActionKind.TAP_AT, ActionKind.TYPE, ActionKind.SWIPE)
    private val PRESSING = setOf(ActionKind.TAP, ActionKind.LONG_PRESS, ActionKind.TAP_AT)
    private val DECLARING = setOf(ActionKind.TAP, ActionKind.LONG_PRESS, ActionKind.TAP_AT, ActionKind.TYPE, ActionKind.SCROLL, ActionKind.SWIPE)
    private val LEAVING = setOf(ActionKind.OPEN_APP, ActionKind.OPEN_URL, ActionKind.OPEN_DEEP_LINK, ActionKind.OPEN_SETTINGS, ActionKind.HOME)
    private const val CHANGED = "The screen changed before the action; nothing was done."
    private const val COVERED = "Another window covers that point."

    fun decide(proposal: Proposal, screen: ScreenSnapshot, task: TaskSafety, settings: SafetySettings, env: SafetyEnvironment = SafetyEnvironment()): Decision =
        assess(proposal, screen, task, settings, env).decision

    fun assess(proposal: Proposal, screen: ScreenSnapshot, task: TaskSafety, settings: SafetySettings, env: SafetyEnvironment = SafetyEnvironment()): Assessment {
        val sources = LinkedHashSet<Source>()
        var category = Category.READING
        // Whether any source suggests sending, also when a higher category wins (review 2 I2).
        var sends = false
        fun raise(suggested: Category?, source: Source) {
            if (suggested == null) return
            sources += source
            if (suggested == Category.SENDING) sends = true
            if (suggested > category) category = suggested
        }
        fun ending(decision: Decision) = Assessment(category, sources, decision, decision, sends)

        val index = proposal.targetKey?.let { key ->
            screen.elements.indexOfFirst { it.key == key }.takeIf { it >= 0 } ?: return ending(Decision.Block(CHANGED))
        }
        val point = proposal.point
        if (point != null && ContextRules.covered(screen, point)) {
            sources += Source.COVERED
            return ending(Decision.Block(COVERED))
        }
        val atPoint = point?.let { ContextRules.atPoint(screen, it) }.orEmpty()
        val reached = listOfNotNull(index) + atPoint
        val window = windowOf(screen, index ?: atPoint.lastOrNull())

        // 1. The declared category, or the tool's fixed one.
        if (proposal.kind in DECLARING) raise(proposal.declared ?: Category.READING, Source.DECLARED) else raise(fixed(proposal.kind), Source.FIXED)

        // 2. The words of the labels that the action reaches, and of their clickable ancestors.
        if (proposal.kind in PRESSING || proposal.kind == ActionKind.SWIPE) {
            val clears = index != null && ContextRules.clearsAField(screen, index)
            val names = reached.flatMap { at -> listOf(at) + ScreenTree.ancestors(screen, at).filter { screen.elements[it].clickable } }
                .map { ScreenTree.name(screen.elements[it]) } + proposal.pointText
            val words = names.mapNotNull { LabelWords.categoryOf(it) }.maxOrNull()
            raise(if (clears && words == Category.DELETING) Category.TYPING_REQUEST else words, Source.LABEL_WORDS)
            if (names.any { LabelWords.holds(it, Category.SENDING) }) sends = true
            if (reached.any { EmergencyGuard.emergencyNamed(screen, it) }) raise(Category.CALLS, Source.PHONE_APP)
        }

        // 3. The context rules of the window that the action reaches.
        if (window != null && proposal.kind in ACTING) {
            if (ContextRules.isPermissionDialog(screen, window)) {
                sources += Source.PROTECTED_SCREEN
                return ending(Decision.HandOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.PERMISSION_DIALOG)))
            }
            if (window.packageName == ContextRules.CREDENTIAL_MANAGER) {
                sources += Source.CREDENTIALS
                return ending(Decision.HandOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.CREDENTIALS)))
            }
            if (ContextRules.isProtected(screen, window, task.trail)) raise(Category.PROTECTED, Source.PROTECTED_SCREEN)
            if (ContextRules.isPhoneApp(window.packageName, env.phonePackages)) raise(Category.CALLS, Source.PHONE_APP)
            if (reached.any { ContextRules.isCredential(screen, it, window) }) raise(Category.CREDENTIALS, Source.CREDENTIALS)
            if (proposal.kind in PRESSING && ContextRules.isPayment(screen, window) && reached.any { screen.elements[it].clickable }) {
                raise(Category.PAYMENTS, Source.PAYMENTS)
            }
            if (proposal.kind in PRESSING && reached.any { ContextRules.nearCompose(screen, it) }) raise(Category.SENDING, Source.COMPOSE)
            val flow = task.shareFlow
            val inFlow = flow != null && (window.packageName == flow.receivingPackage || ContextRules.isShareSheet(screen, window))
            if (proposal.kind in PRESSING && (inFlow || ContextRules.shareSheetInFront(screen))) {
                val control = index != null && ContextRules.pickerControl(screen, index, window)
                if (!control) raise(Category.SENDING, Source.SHARE_FLOW)
            }
        }

        // Typing: the request's words or memory's values, else text from the screen.
        if (proposal.kind == ActionKind.TYPE) raise(typing(proposal.text.orEmpty(), task), Source.TYPING)

        // Links.
        if (proposal.kind == ActionKind.OPEN_URL || proposal.kind == ActionKind.OPEN_DEEP_LINK) {
            when (val verdict = LinkCheck.check(proposal.link.orEmpty(), proposal.kind, proposal.linkFromOwner, proposal.linkTargetPackage, env.isAgentFree, env.emergency)) {
                is LinkVerdict.Refused -> {
                    sources += Source.LINK
                    return ending(Decision.Block(verdict.reason))
                }
                is LinkVerdict.Allowed -> raise(verdict.category, Source.LINK)
            }
        }

        val decision = decision(proposal, screen, category, task, settings.mode, sends)
        return Assessment(category, sources.also { if (Placeholders.holdsOne(proposal.text)) it += Source.PLACEHOLDER }, decision, decision, sends)
    }

    /**
     * Updates the task's state after an action ran (design D13): a typed text is remembered (pass the proposal with the
     * text that was typed, the vault's values revealed), a share flow starts with the next serial number, grows by the
     * name of every row that a tap reached in its list of rows (never by a target of Android's share sheet, which is an
     * app), and ends at a chat titled as a selected row, after `open_*` or `home`, or outside its apps, and a protected
     * trail starts and ends.
     */
    fun afterAction(proposal: Proposal, before: ScreenSnapshot, after: ScreenSnapshot, task: TaskSafety): TaskSafety {
        var next = task
        val index = proposal.targetKey?.let { key -> before.elements.indexOfFirst { it.key == key }.takeIf { it >= 0 } }
        val element = index?.let { before.elements[it] }
        if (proposal.kind == ActionKind.TYPE && element != null) {
            val typed = TypedText(element.key, element.hint ?: element.contentDescription ?: element.label, element.packageName, proposal.text.orEmpty())
            next = next.copy(typed = next.typed.filterNot { it.fieldKey == element.key } + typed)
        }
        val flow = flowAfter(proposal, before, after, index, next.shareFlow, next.flows + 1)
        next = next.copy(shareFlow = flow, flows = maxOf(next.flows, flow?.serial ?: 0))
        next = next.copy(trail = trailAfter(proposal, before, after, next.trail))
        return next
    }

    private fun flowAfter(proposal: Proposal, before: ScreenSnapshot, after: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int?, flow: ShareFlow?, serial: Int): ShareFlow? {
        val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(after)?.packageName ?: return flow
        var current = flow
        if (proposal.kind == ActionKind.SHARE_MEDIA || proposal.kind == ActionKind.COMPOSE_SMS) {
            return ShareFlow(proposal.receivingPackage ?: front, emptyList(), proposal.shareCount, serial)
        }
        // Opening something else or going home leaves the flow, so that its selection never names another chat (review 2 C1).
        if (proposal.kind in LEAVING) current = null
        val sheet = index?.let { before.windows.firstOrNull { w -> w.id == before.elements[it].windowId } }?.let { ContextRules.isShareSheet(before, it) } == true
        if (current != null && proposal.kind in PRESSING && index != null && !sheet) {
            val row = ContextRules.row(before, index)?.let { ContextRules.rowName(before, it) }
            if (row != null && row !in current.selected) current = current.copy(selected = current.selected + row)
        }
        val name = index?.let { ScreenTree.name(before.elements[it]) }
        if (current == null && proposal.kind in PRESSING && LabelWords.holdsWord(name, LabelWords.SHARE_START_WORDS)) {
            current = ShareFlow(front, emptyList(), null, serial)
        }
        if (current == null && ContextRules.shareSheetInFront(after)) current = ShareFlow(front, emptyList(), null, serial)
        current ?: return null
        // From a share sheet into the app that the owner's task shares with.
        if (current.receivingPackage in ContextRules.SHARE_SHEETS && front !in ContextRules.SHARE_SHEETS) current = current.copy(receivingPackage = front)
        if (front != current.receivingPackage && front !in ContextRules.SHARE_SHEETS) return null
        val window = ScreenTree.frontWindow(after) ?: return current
        val title = ScreenTitle.of(after, window, proposal.receivingAppLabel ?: proposal.frontAppLabel, withRule3 = false)
        if (title != null && current.selected.any { Normalizer.normalize(it) == Normalizer.normalize(title) }) return null
        return current
    }

    private fun trailAfter(proposal: Proposal, before: ScreenSnapshot, after: ScreenSnapshot, trail: ProtectedTrail?): ProtectedTrail? {
        if (ScreenTree.frontWindow(after)?.packageName != ContextRules.SETTINGS) return null
        if (trail != null && proposal.kind == ActionKind.BACK) {
            val left = ScreenTree.frontWindow(before)?.let { ContextRules.heading(before, it) }
            if (left != null && Normalizer.normalize(left) == Normalizer.normalize(trail.startTitle)) return null
        }
        return trail ?: ContextRules.trailHeading(after)?.let { ProtectedTrail(it) }
    }


    private fun windowOf(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int?): WindowSummary? {
        val id = index?.let { snapshot.elements[it].windowId } ?: return ScreenTree.frontWindow(snapshot)
        return snapshot.windows.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: ScreenTree.frontWindow(snapshot)
    }

    /** The tools whose category code fixes (design D13, review A I7). */
    private fun fixed(kind: ActionKind): Category = when (kind) {
        ActionKind.SETTINGS_DATA -> Category.ORDINARY_SETTINGS
        else -> Category.READING
    }

    /**
     * Typing the request: every word occurs in the owner's words or in a memory value that the task used. Clearing a field
     * (a blank text) types nothing from the screen (review 2 M6).
     */
    private fun typing(text: String, task: TaskSafety): Category {
        if (text.isBlank()) return Category.TYPING_REQUEST
        val words = Normalizer.words(text)
        val known = task.ownerWords + task.memoryValues.flatMap { Normalizer.words(it) }
        return if (words.isNotEmpty() && words.all { it in known } && !Placeholders.holdsOne(text)) Category.TYPING_REQUEST else Category.TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT
    }

    /**
     * The mode's answer for [category], then the floor, the allowance and the placeholder rule. An action that [sends] and
     * deletes is asked about as a send, which names its recipient (the two rows have the same modes), and needs the
     * allowance to send too (review 2 I2).
     */
    private fun decision(proposal: Proposal, screen: ScreenSnapshot, category: Category, task: TaskSafety, mode: Mode, sends: Boolean): Decision {
        val asked = if (sends && category == Category.DELETING) Category.SENDING else category
        val confirm = { why: String? -> ConfirmationBuilder.build(proposal, screen, asked, task, why) }
        when (category) {
            Category.CALLS -> return Decision.HandOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.CALL))
            Category.PAYMENTS -> return Decision.HandOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.PAYMENT))
            Category.CREDENTIALS -> return Decision.HandOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.CREDENTIALS))
            Category.PROTECTED -> return Decision.Block("This is a protected screen, where Kestrel never acts.")
            else -> Unit
        }
        // share_media and compose_sms only open a screen, but they need the allowance to send (design D13, review B2-M1).
        if ((proposal.kind == ActionKind.SHARE_MEDIA || proposal.kind == ActionKind.COMPOSE_SMS) && !task.allowance.allows(Category.SENDING)) {
            return confirm(if (proposal.kind == ActionKind.SHARE_MEDIA) "You didn't ask me to share anything." else "You didn't ask me to send anything.")
        }
        if (sends && category == Category.DELETING && !task.allowance.allows(Category.SENDING)) return confirm(outside(Category.SENDING))
        if (!task.allowance.allows(category)) return confirm(outside(category))
        if (Placeholders.holdsOne(proposal.text)) return confirm(null)
        val runs = when (category) {
            Category.READING, Category.TYPING_REQUEST, Category.ORDINARY_SETTINGS -> true
            Category.TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT -> mode != Mode.STANDARD
            else -> mode == Mode.FULL_AUTO
        }
        return if (runs) Decision.Run else confirm(null)
    }

    private fun outside(category: Category): String = when (category) {
        Category.SENDING -> "You didn't ask me to send anything."
        Category.DELETING -> "You didn't ask me to delete anything."
        Category.TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT -> "You didn't ask me to copy text from the screen."
        else -> "You didn't ask me to do this."
    }
}

- [ ] **Step 9: Change the spec's 12.1 to 12.3**

In `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-kestrel-design.md`, replace

```markdown
The safety check in `:core:safety` applies to every action that the agent or a routine proposes. It does not apply to instant commands, which are the owner's direct control (section 9.5).
```

with

```markdown
The safety check in `:core:safety` applies to every action that the agent or a routine proposes. It does not apply to instant commands, which are the owner's direct control (section 9.5).

Every link is checked before Kestrel opens it: `open_url` opens only `https`, `open_deep_link` only the schemes of section 11.4, never `intent:`, `file:`, `content:`, `javascript:` or `android-app:`, and never a link whose activity belongs to Kestrel, an agent-free app or Google Play services. A `tel:` link opens only the dial screen, and only for a number that the emergency guard lets Kestrel dial. A link that came from the screen or a data tool and carries data in its query or its fragment sends that data, so it counts as sending. Data in a link's path (such as `https://example.com/c/0601234567`) is not recognised; such a link opens as reading.

Any app in front can start Kestrel's assistant and play speech, so it can speak a task and even say "confirm". What limits it: the phone must be unlocked with the app in front; the task's allowance (section 12.3) asks again for every category that the spoken task did not name; test mode blocks every send that does not go to the owner's own chats; a confirmation names the real recipient and text from the screen, and the card shows them; and while another app plays media or game audio, a confirmation of sending or deleting counts only by the card's button, or by voice after Kestrel has paused that audio.
```

```markdown
2. **Words in the label of the element that will be pressed,** in English and Serbian:
   - send, post, share, confirm and submit (pošalji, objavi, podeli, potvrdi) suggest sending;
   - call (pozovi) suggests a call;
   - delete and remove (obriši, izbriši, ukloni) suggest deleting;
   - pay, buy, order and checkout (plati, kupi, naruči) suggest a payment;
   - install and allow (instaliraj, dozvoli) suggest the protected category.
3. **Context rules:**
   - compose screens and the dialer suggest sending or a call;
   - the permission dialog, package installers, app-store install buttons, and the Settings pages for security, accessibility, device admin apps, unknown sources, biometrics and the lock screen suggest the protected category;
   - password fields, one-time-code fields, card fields and biometric prompts suggest the credentials category;
   - checkout screens suggest a payment;
   - data tools that share media or compose messages suggest sending.
```

```markdown

3. **Context rules:**

   - password fields, fields named for a code, PIN, password, card number, CVV or CVC, biometric prompts, autofill pickers, Android's Credential Manager and a page titled "Password Manager" or "Passwords" make typing and taps there the credentials category;
   - a screen whose heading or buttons name checkout, payment, plaćanje or kasa makes its buttons a payment;
   - `share_media` and `compose_sms` only open a screen, but they need sending in the task's allowance.

### Task 4: Redaction and the vault

**Files:**
- Create: `core/safety/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/safety/Checksums.kt`, `Vault.kt`, `Redactor.kt`
- Test: `core/safety/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/safety/RedactorTest.kt`, `VaultTest.kt`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 3's `Placeholders.PATTERN`; `Normalizer.withOffsets` of `:core:commands`.
- Produces (package `dev.kestrel.safety`): `enum class SecretKind(val tag: String, val spoken: String) { OTP, CARD, IBAN, JMBG, TOKEN }`; `class Vault` with `placeholderFor(kind, value): String`, `valueOf(placeholder): String?`, `kindOf(placeholder): SecretKind?`, `placeholdersIn(text): List<String>`, `reveal(text): String`, `spoken(text): String`, `values: Collection<String>`, `isEmpty`, `clear()` and `Vault.PLACEHOLDER`; `class Redactor(val vault: Vault)` with `redact(text: String, neighbours: List<String> = emptyList()): String`. Writer B's `Conversation` and `DataResultText` and Task 6's `ObservationBuilder` redact every text that enters a request exactly once with one `Redactor` per task; the agent's loop reveals a placeholder only in `type_text`'s text after the owner's yes and clears the vault in the task's `finally`.

Design D17 and D32 items 13 and 14; review A I4, review B I2, I14 and M7, review A3-I1. Each text that goes into a request passes `redact` once, when it enters the conversation, with its neighbours (the texts beside it in the same window, the other fields of a data tool's line), so that "Your verification code" in one element and "483920" in the next count as a code. The kinds: one-time codes (4 to 8 digits, also with one space or dash inside, within 40 characters of code, kod, kôd, šifra, PIN, OTP, verification, verifikacioni, lozinka or password, after the matcher's folding, which also reads Cyrillic), card numbers (every length from 13 to 19 at each start of a digit group that passes the Luhn check, so that a following year does not hide one), IBANs (the country's length and mod 97), JMBG numbers (date and check digit; a valid JMBG wins over Luhn), and tokens (JWTs, the known key prefixes, and long runs that mix capitals, small letters and digits or hold 8 digits, but never a URL slug). A value that the vault already holds is replaced wherever it appears later, with or without a keyword, so that a code found once never reaches a request again. A literal `[OTP_1]` in screen text becomes `(OTP_1)` first, so that only Kestrel's own placeholders reach the vault. Phone numbers and e-mail addresses stay (spec 12.6).

Review 2's fixes: a run of digits that holds two card numbers gives two placeholders, because the search goes on after a hit (M3); and a group of digits that a "+" or another group of digits follows or precedes across one space or dash is part of a longer number, such as a phone number, and never a one-time code (M4), so that "We sent a code to +381 60 1234567" stays as it is (spec 12.6 keeps phone numbers).

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import java.time.DateTimeException
import java.time.LocalDate

/** The checksums of the values that redaction recognises (design D17 of sub-project 5). */
internal object Checksums {
    /** The Luhn check of a card number. */
    fun luhn(digits: String): Boolean {
        if (digits.isEmpty() || digits.any { !it.isDigit() }) return false
        var sum = 0
        for ((position, char) in digits.reversed().withIndex()) {
            var value = char - '0'
            if (position % 2 == 1) {
                value *= 2
                if (value > 9) value -= 9
            }
            sum += value
        }
        return sum % 10 == 0
    }

    /** ISO 13616's mod-97 check of a compact IBAN in capital letters. */
    fun iban(compact: String): Boolean {
        if (compact.length < 15 || compact.length > 34) return false
        val moved = compact.substring(4) + compact.substring(0, 4)
        var rest = 0
        for (char in moved) {
            val value = when (char) {
                in '0'..'9' -> char - '0'
                in 'A'..'Z' -> char - 'A' + 10
                else -> return false
            }
            rest = if (value >= 10) (rest * 100 + value) % 97 else (rest * 10 + value) % 97
        }
        return rest == 1
    }

    /** A Serbian JMBG: 13 digits, a date that exists (DDMMYYY) and the check digit of its control rule. */
    fun jmbg(digits: String): Boolean {
        if (digits.length != 13 || digits.any { !it.isDigit() }) return false
        val d = digits.map { it - '0' }
        val sum = 7 * (d[0] + d[6]) + 6 * (d[1] + d[7]) + 5 * (d[2] + d[8]) + 4 * (d[3] + d[9]) + 3 * (d[4] + d[10]) + 2 * (d[5] + d[11])
        val control = (11 - sum % 11).let { if (it > 9) 0 else it }
        if (control != d[12]) return false
        val day = digits.substring(0, 2).toInt()
        val month = digits.substring(2, 4).toInt()
        val year = digits.substring(4, 7).toInt().let { if (it >= 800) 1000 + it else 2000 + it }
        return try {
            LocalDate.of(year, month, day)
            true
        } catch (e: DateTimeException) {
            false
        }
    }

    /** The IBAN length of each country that Kestrel knows (ISO 13616's registry); other countries take 15 to 34. */
    val IBAN_LENGTHS: Map<String, Int> = mapOf(
        "RS" to 22, "ME" to 22, "BA" to 20, "HR" to 21, "SI" to 19, "MK" to 19, "AL" to 28, "XK" to 20, "BG" to 22, "RO" to 24,
        "HU" to 28, "GR" to 27, "AT" to 20, "DE" to 22, "CH" to 21, "IT" to 27, "FR" to 27, "ES" to 24, "PT" to 25, "NL" to 18,
        "BE" to 16, "LU" to 20, "GB" to 22, "IE" to 22, "PL" to 28, "CZ" to 24, "SK" to 24, "SE" to 24, "NO" to 15, "DK" to 18,
        "FI" to 18, "TR" to 26,
    )
}

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

/** The kinds of values that redaction replaces, with the words that Kestrel speaks for each (design D17 and D24). */
enum class SecretKind(val tag: String, val spoken: String) {
    OTP("OTP", "a one-time code"),
    CARD("CARD", "a card number"),
    IBAN("IBAN", "an IBAN"),
    JMBG("JMBG", "a JMBG number"),
    TOKEN("TOKEN", "an access token"),
}

/**
 * The task's vault (design D17 of sub-project 5; spec 12.6): a map from Kestrel's placeholders, numbered per kind and
 * task, to the real values, in memory only, owned by one task and cleared in its `finally`. The same value always gets
 * the same placeholder, so a conversation's stable part never changes. A placeholder is revealed only in `type_text`'s
 * text after the owner's yes. Its text form prints only how many values it holds.
 */
class Vault {
    private val held = LinkedHashMap<String, Pair<SecretKind, String>>()
    private val placeholders = HashMap<Pair<SecretKind, String>, String>()
    private val counts = HashMap<SecretKind, Int>()

    /** The placeholder of [value], a new one the first time, such as `[OTP_1]`. */
    fun placeholderFor(kind: SecretKind, value: String): String {
        val key = kind to canonical(kind, value)
        placeholders[key]?.let { return it }
        val number = (counts[kind] ?: 0) + 1
        counts[kind] = number
        val placeholder = "[${kind.tag}_$number]"
        placeholders[key] = placeholder
        held[placeholder] = kind to value
        return placeholder
    }

    fun valueOf(placeholder: String): String? = held[placeholder]?.second

    fun kindOf(placeholder: String): SecretKind? = held[placeholder]?.first

    /** The vault's placeholders that [text] holds, in their order; a placeholder that the vault does not hold is left out. */
    fun placeholdersIn(text: String): List<String> = PLACEHOLDER.findAll(text).map { it.value }.filter { it in held }.toList()

    /** [text] with each of the vault's placeholders replaced by its value, for `type_text` after the owner's yes. */
    fun reveal(text: String): String = PLACEHOLDER.replace(text) { held[it.value]?.second ?: it.value }

    /** [text] with each of the vault's placeholders replaced by its kind's words, for what Kestrel speaks (design D24). */
    fun spoken(text: String): String = PLACEHOLDER.replace(text) { held[it.value]?.first?.spoken ?: it.value }

    /** The real values. */
    val values: Collection<String> get() = held.values.map { it.second }

    val isEmpty: Boolean get() = held.isEmpty()

    /** The known values with their kinds, the longest first, for redaction's search for a value that it met before. */
    internal fun known(): List<Pair<SecretKind, String>> = held.values.sortedByDescending { it.second.length }

    fun clear() {
        held.clear()
        placeholders.clear()
        counts.clear()
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "Vault(values=${held.size})"

    companion object {
        /** Kestrel's placeholders; the same pattern as [Placeholders.PATTERN]. */
        val PLACEHOLDER: Regex = Placeholders.PATTERN

        /** The form in which two values count as the same: digits only, or an IBAN without spaces in capitals. */
        internal fun canonical(kind: SecretKind, value: String): String = when (kind) {
            SecretKind.OTP, SecretKind.CARD, SecretKind.JMBG -> value.filter(Char::isDigit)
            SecretKind.IBAN -> value.filter(Char::isLetterOrDigit).uppercase()
            SecretKind.TOKEN -> value
        }
    }
}
```

Create `core/safety/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/safety/Redactor.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer

/**
 * Replaces secrets with typed placeholders in every text that goes into a request (design D17 of sub-project 5; spec
 * 12.6): one-time codes near a keyword (in the text or in a neighbouring text of the same window), card numbers that pass
 * the Luhn check, IBANs with a valid checksum, JMBG numbers and access tokens. Phone numbers and e-mail addresses stay.
 * Each text is redacted exactly once, when it enters the conversation, before it is quoted; a value that the [vault]
 * already holds is replaced wherever it appears later, with or without a keyword. A literal placeholder in untrusted
 * text becomes `(KIND_n)` first, so that only Kestrel's own placeholders reach the vault.
 */
class Redactor(val vault: Vault) {
    private class Hit(val range: IntRange, val kind: SecretKind)

    fun redact(text: String, neighbours: List<String> = emptyList()): String {
        var result = Placeholders.PATTERN.replace(text) { "(${it.value.substring(1, it.value.length - 1)})" }
        result = replaceKnown(result)
        for (finder in listOf(::tokens, ::ibans, ::jmbgs, ::cards)) result = replace(result, finder(result))
        return replace(result, codes(result, neighbours))
    }

    private fun replace(text: String, hits: List<Hit>): String {
        if (hits.isEmpty()) return text
        // Of overlapping hits, the one that starts first wins, and of those the longest, so that a JWT stays one token.
        val kept = mutableListOf<Hit>()
        for (hit in hits.sortedWith(compareBy<Hit> { it.range.first }.thenByDescending { it.range.last })) {
            if (kept.none { it.range.last >= hit.range.first }) kept += hit
        }
        // Right to left, so that the earlier ranges stay where they are; the placeholders are numbered left to right.
        val placeholders = kept.map { vault.placeholderFor(it.kind, text.substring(it.range)) }
        val builder = StringBuilder(text)
        for (index in kept.indices.reversed()) builder.replace(kept[index].range.first, kept[index].range.last + 1, placeholders[index])
        return builder.toString()
    }

    /** Every value that the vault holds, where its characters appear again, with its digits' separators. */
    private fun replaceKnown(text: String): String {
        var result = text
        for ((kind, value) in vault.known()) {
            val pattern = when (kind) {
                SecretKind.OTP, SecretKind.CARD, SecretKind.JMBG ->
                    Regex("(?<![0-9])" + Vault.canonical(kind, value).toCharArray().joinToString("[ -]?") + "(?![0-9])")
                SecretKind.IBAN -> Regex(Vault.canonical(kind, value).toCharArray().joinToString(" ?") { Regex.escape(it.toString()) }, RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
                SecretKind.TOKEN -> Regex(Regex.escape(value))
            }
            result = pattern.replace(result) { vault.placeholderFor(kind, it.value) }
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun tokens(text: String): List<Hit> {
        val hits = TOKEN_PATTERNS.flatMap { pattern -> pattern.findAll(text).map { Hit(it.range, SecretKind.TOKEN) } }
        val generic = LONG_RUN.findAll(text).filter { match ->
            val run = match.value
            val mixed = run.any(Char::isUpperCase) && run.any(Char::isLowerCase) && run.any(Char::isDigit)
            val slug = '-' in run && run.split('-').all { part -> part.all { it.isLowerCase() || it.isDigit() } }
            (mixed || run.count(Char::isDigit) >= 8) && !slug
        }.map { Hit(it.range, SecretKind.TOKEN) }
        return hits + generic
    }

    private fun ibans(text: String): List<Hit> = IBAN.findAll(text).mapNotNull { match ->
        val country = match.value.substring(0, 2).uppercase()
        val compact = match.value.filter(Char::isLetterOrDigit).uppercase()
        val lengths = Checksums.IBAN_LENGTHS[country]?.let { listOf(it) } ?: (34 downTo 15).toList()
        val length = lengths.firstOrNull { it <= compact.length && Checksums.iban(compact.substring(0, it)) } ?: return@mapNotNull null
        // The end of the IBAN's last character in the text.
        var seen = 0
        var end = match.range.first
        while (seen < length) {
            if (text[end].isLetterOrDigit()) seen++
            end++
        }
        Hit(match.range.first until end, SecretKind.IBAN)
    }.toList()

    private fun jmbgs(text: String): List<Hit> =
        THIRTEEN.findAll(text).filter { Checksums.jmbg(it.value) }.map { Hit(it.range, SecretKind.JMBG) }.toList()

    /**
     * Card numbers: at each start of a run of digits, every length from 13 to 19 that passes the Luhn check (review B M7);
     * after a hit, the search goes on after it, so that a second card in the same run is found too (review 2 M3).
     */
    private fun cards(text: String): List<Hit> = DIGIT_RUN.findAll(text).flatMap { match ->
        val positions = match.value.indices.filter { match.value[it].isDigit() }.map { match.range.first + it }
        val digits = positions.joinToString("") { text[it].toString() }
        // A group ends after a digit that a separator follows.
        val ends = positions.indices.filter { it == positions.lastIndex || positions[it + 1] != positions[it] + 1 }.map { it + 1 }.toSet()
        val starts = setOf(0) + ends
        val found = mutableListOf<Hit>()
        var start = 0
        while (start < positions.size) {
            val length = (19 downTo 13).firstOrNull { length ->
                val end = start + length
                end <= digits.length && ((start in starts && end in ends) || ends.size == 1) && Checksums.luhn(digits.substring(start, end))
            }
            if (length == null) {
                start++
            } else {
                found += Hit(positions[start]..positions[start + length - 1], SecretKind.CARD)
                start += length
            }
        }
        found.asSequence()
    }.toList()

    /** One-time codes: 4 to 8 digits, also in up to three groups split by a space or a dash, within 40 characters of a keyword or beside one. */
    private fun codes(text: String, neighbours: List<String>): List<Hit> {
        val candidates = CODE.findAll(text).filter { it.value.count(Char::isDigit) in 4..8 && !inNumber(text, it.range) }.toList()
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        if (neighbours.any { keywordRanges(it).isNotEmpty() }) return candidates.map { Hit(it.range, SecretKind.OTP) }
        val keywords = keywordRanges(text)
        return candidates.filter { candidate ->
            keywords.any { keyword ->
                val gap = if (keyword.last < candidate.range.first) candidate.range.first - keyword.last else keyword.first - candidate.range.last
                gap <= NEAR
            }
        }.map { Hit(it.range, SecretKind.OTP) }
    }

    /**
     * Whether the digits at [range] are part of a longer number, such as a phone number: a "+" before them, or another
     * digit across one space or dash on either side (review 2 M4).
     */
    private fun inNumber(text: String, range: IntRange): Boolean {
        fun at(index: Int) = text.getOrNull(index)
        val before = at(range.first - 1)
        if (before == '+') return true
        if ((before == ' ' || before == '-') && (at(range.first - 2)?.isDigit() == true || at(range.first - 2) == '+')) return true
        val after = at(range.last + 1)
        return (after == ' ' || after == '-') && at(range.last + 2)?.isDigit() == true
    }

    /** Where the code keywords stand in [text], found on the folded text and mapped back to [text]. */
    private fun keywordRanges(text: String): List<IntRange> {
        val folded = Normalizer.withOffsets(text)
        val words = folded.words.map { folded.text.substring(it) }
        return words.indices.filter { words[it] in KEYWORDS }.map { folded.span(it, it + 1) }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val NEAR = 40
        val KEYWORDS = setOf("code", "codes", "kod", "kodovi", "sifra", "pin", "otp", "verification", "verifikacioni", "lozinka", "password")
        // Up to three groups ("12 34 56"); a longer number, such as a phone number, has more than 8 digits (review 2-2 New 3).
        val CODE = Regex("(?<![0-9A-Za-z])[0-9]{1,8}(?:[ -][0-9]{1,8}){0,2}(?![0-9A-Za-z])")
        val DIGIT_RUN = Regex("[0-9](?:[ -]?[0-9]){12,}")
        val THIRTEEN = Regex("(?<![0-9])[0-9]{13}(?![0-9])")
        val IBAN = Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])[A-Za-z]{2}[0-9]{2}(?: ?[A-Za-z0-9]){11,30}")
        val LONG_RUN = Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])")
        val TOKEN_PATTERNS = listOf(
            Regex("eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+"),
            Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}"),
            Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}"),
            Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])gh[po]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}"),
            Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}"),
            Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}"),
            Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}(?![A-Za-z0-9])"),
            Regex("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])AIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{35}(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])"),
        )
    }
}

Task 6's `ObservationBuilder` hides the windows of `AgentFreeApps` and Play services; writer B's loop stops a task with `AGENT_FREE` when an agent-free app is in front, hands over with `PLAY_SERVICES` when `PlayServices.handsOver`, runs `SendCheck` before a send and `testModeAllows` with a fresh `ConfirmationBuilder.build` after the owner's yes.

Design D14, D16 and D18 and D32 items 15 and 16; review A C2, review B C1, I4 to I6, I8, I9, M6, M8, n3, and their rounds 2 and 3. Agent-free apps: the shipped list is r62's and r62b's confirmed rows, without Google Password Manager's `com.google.android.gms` (Play services has its own rule: its windows are left out, and one in front or over half of the screen is handed over) and with Samsung Wallet once; names match whole; the owner's additions and removals are kept apart from the shipped list; Kestrel itself is always agent-free (D32 item 16). Test mode (D32 item 15): inside `assess`, before any question, every `SENDING` action that `SelfChats` does not recognise as the owner's own chat, every `CALLS` action (also the `CALL` hand-over) and `compose_sms` become `Block`, and `testModeAllows` repeats the check on the fresh snapshot after the owner's yes. `SelfChats` reads structural signs per app (r63): Telegram's "Saved Messages" with the subtitle "forward here to save" and no other header text, or the picker's first row with the preview "Forward here to save." and no time, while no search shows; WhatsApp's "<name> (You)" with "Message yourself"; Viber's chat name with a sign of the notes chat; Gmail's To, Cc and Bcc with only the owner's addresses. By D18's one rule, no app's rule is active in this plan (`ACTIVE` is empty) until a reviewed fix pins it from a real tree, so test mode blocks every send, except to a `:testapp` fixture that the debug-only aliases map to an app's rule. `ConfirmationBuilder` now reads the recipient from the screen at the moment of the send: a chat's title by the title's rules 1, 2 and 4 only; in a share flow, the tapped row and every row with a checked element of a list of rows (also a list that does not scroll), each by its row's first text, or the chat on the screen when it is a row that the flow selected, or the selected rows that an app's own dialog names, never the rows that the flow selected earlier alone (review 2 C1 and I1); a target of Android's share sheet as "Share 3 photos with Telegram?"; or every address of an e-mail; and it hands over when it cannot read one. A vault's value that the task typed is named by its kind in every question (review 2 I3). Test mode checks the recipient of every action that any source rates as sending, also when a higher category wins, such as "Send and delete" (review 2 I2), and an alias applies only to `:testapp`'s package. A link whose category needs the owner's yes (`open_url` or `open_deep_link` with data from the screen, which Task 3 rates `SENDING`) gets its own question instead of the recipient's hand-over: "Open <host> in <app>? It sends what the link holds. Say confirm or cancel.", with the host read from the link ("a mailto link" for a link without one) and the app from the activity that `:app` resolved for it (`linkTargetPackage`, labelled by `receivingAppLabel`), never from the model's words; without a resolved app it hands over with "I can't tell where this link goes. …". `SendCheck` is the cheap check before a send, save, done, apply or OK.

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowKind
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** Design D16 of sub-project 5: the shipped list of r62 and r62b, the owner's changes and Play services' rule. */
class AgentFreeAppsTest {
    @Test
    fun theShippedListHoldsBothReportsWithoutPlayServicesAndWithSamsungWalletOnce() {
        val apps = AgentFreeApps()

        assertEquals(74, AgentFreeApps.SHIPPED.size)
        assertTrue(apps.isAgentFree("hr.asseco.android.intesa.isbd.bib"))
        assertTrue(apps.isAgentFree("com.x8bit.bitwarden"))
        assertTrue(apps.isAgentFree("com.samsung.knox.securefolder"))
        assertTrue(apps.isAgentFree("com.samsung.android.spay"))
        assertFalse(apps.isAgentFree("com.google.android.gms"))
        assertTrue(apps.isAgentFree("dev.kestrel"))
    }

    @Test
    fun namesCountOnlyWholeAndTheOwnersChangesAreKeptApart() {
        val apps = AgentFreeApps.from(AgentFreeChanges(added = listOf("com.example.bank"), removed = listOf("com.paypal.android.p2pmobile")))

        assertFalse(apps.isAgentFree("hr.asseco.android.jimba.mUCI.hu"))
        assertFalse(apps.isAgentFree("hr.asseco.android"))
        assertTrue(apps.isAgentFree("com.example.bank"))
        assertFalse(apps.isAgentFree("com.paypal.android.p2pmobile"))
        // Kestrel itself stays agent-free whatever the owner removes.
        assertTrue(AgentFreeApps(removed = setOf("dev.kestrel")).isAgentFree("dev.kestrel"))
        assertEquals("AgentFreeChanges(added=1, removed=1)", AgentFreeChanges(listOf("a"), listOf("b")).toString())
    }

    @Test
    fun launcherLabelsThatSuggestAnApp() {
        assertTrue(AgentFreeApps.suggests("mBanking"))
        assertTrue(AgentFreeApps.suggests("Moj novčanik"))
        assertTrue(AgentFreeApps.suggests("KeePassDX"))
        assertTrue(AgentFreeApps.suggests("2FA Codes"))
        assertFalse(AgentFreeApps.suggests("Telegram"))
    }

    @Test
    fun aPlayServicesWindowInFrontOrOverHalfTheScreenIsHandedOver() {
        val app = TestScreen()
        app.add(500, "Sign in")
        val small = TestScreen().apply { window(2, "com.google.android.gms", IntRect(0, 1700, 1000, 2000)) }
        val large = TestScreen().apply { window(2, "com.google.android.gms", IntRect(0, 600, 1000, 2000)) }
        val front = TestScreen().apply { window(2, "com.google.android.gms", IntRect(0, 1700, 1000, 2000), WindowKind.APPLICATION, active = true) }

        assertFalse(PlayServices.handsOver(app.snapshot()))
        assertFalse(PlayServices.handsOver(small.snapshot()))
        assertTrue(PlayServices.handsOver(large.snapshot()))
        assertTrue(PlayServices.handsOver(front.snapshot()))
    }
}

package dev.kestrel.safety

import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScrollAxis
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** Test mode's recogniser and its look-alikes (design D18 of sub-project 5; research r63), on snapshots with the real apps' packages. */
class SelfChatsTest {
    private val settings = SafetySettings(ownerEmails = listOf("owner@example.com"), whatsappOwnName = "Aleksa")

    /** A chat with a header of [title] and [subtitle], a list of messages and a Send button; returns the snapshot and the button. */
    private fun chat(packageName: String, title: String, subtitle: String?, message: String = "Hello", extra: TestScreen.() -> Unit = {}): Pair<TestScreen, String> {
        val screen = TestScreen(packageName)
        screen.add(80, null, right = 100, className = "android.widget.ImageView")
        screen.add(80, title, left = 150, height = 50, clickable = false)
        if (subtitle != null) screen.add(140, subtitle, left = 150, height = 40, clickable = false)
        val list = screen.add(300, null, scrollable = true, height = 1400, clickable = false)
        screen.add(400, message, parent = list, clickable = false)
        screen.add(1800, null, editable = true, hint = "Message", text = "Test", right = 850)
        val send = screen.add(1800, "Send", left = 850)
        screen.extra()
        return screen to send
    }

    /** A picker whose list holds [rows], each a name with its texts; returns the snapshot and each row's key. */
    private fun picker(packageName: String, rows: List<List<String>>, searching: Boolean = false): Pair<TestScreen, List<String>> {
        val screen = TestScreen(packageName)
        if (searching) screen.add(100, null, editable = true, text = "Saved", hint = "Search")
        val list = screen.add(300, null, scrollable = true, axis = ScrollAxis.VERTICAL, height = 1600, clickable = false)
        val keys = rows.mapIndexed { index, texts ->
            val row = screen.add(300 + index * 150, null, parent = list, height = 140, text = null)
            texts.forEachIndexed { line, text -> screen.add(310 + index * 150 + line * 40, text, parent = row, clickable = false, height = 40) }
            row
        }
        return screen to keys
    }

    private val telegram = setOf(SelfChats.TELEGRAM)


    @Test
    fun aTabStripAboveThePickerIsNoListOfRows() {
        val screen = TestScreen(SelfChats.TELEGRAM)
        val tabs = screen.add(150, null, className = "androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView", axis = ScrollAxis.HORIZONTAL, scrollable = true, height = 100, clickable = false)
        screen.add(150, "All chats", parent = tabs, right = 300)
        val list = screen.add(300, null, scrollable = true, axis = ScrollAxis.VERTICAL, height = 1600, clickable = false)
        val row = screen.add(300, null, parent = list, height = 140, text = null)
        screen.add(310, "Saved Messages", parent = row, clickable = false, height = 40)
        screen.add(350, "Forward here to save.", parent = row, clickable = false, height = 40)

        assertTrue(recognise(screen to row))
    }

    private fun recognise(pair: Pair<TestScreen, String>, active: Set<String> = telegram, aliases: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), flow: ShareFlow? = null, owner: SafetySettings = settings) =
        SelfChats.recognise(pair.first.snapshot(), pair.second, owner, flow, aliases, active)

    @Test
    fun telegramsSavedMessagesNeedsItsSubtitleAndAnActiveRuleOrAnAlias() {
        val saved = chat(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, "Saved Messages", "forward here to save")

        assertTrue(recognise(saved))
        assertFalse(recognise(saved, active = SelfChats.ACTIVE))
        assertTrue(SelfChats.ACTIVE.isEmpty())
        val fixture = chat("dev.kestrel.testapp", "Saved Messages", "forward here to save")
        assertTrue(recognise(fixture, active = emptySet(), aliases = mapOf("dev.kestrel.testapp" to SelfChats.TELEGRAM)))
        // An alias never turns on a rule for a real app's package (review 2 n2).
        val lookAlike = chat("com.example.messenger", "Saved Messages", "forward here to save")
        assertFalse(recognise(lookAlike, active = emptySet(), aliases = mapOf("com.example.messenger" to SelfChats.TELEGRAM)))
        assertFalse(recognise(fixture, active = emptySet()))
        assertTrue(SafetyEnvironment().selfChatAliases.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun telegramsLookAlikesAreNoSelfChat() {
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, "Saved Messages", null)))
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, "Saved Messages", "last seen recently")))
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, "Saved Messages", "3 members")))
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, "Saved Messages", "bot")))
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, "Ana", "online", message = "forward here to save")))
    }

    @Test
    fun telegramsPickerRowIsTheFirstWithItsPreviewAndNoSearch() {
        val (screen, rows) = picker(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, listOf(listOf("Saved Messages", "Forward here to save."), listOf("Ana", "See you", "12:30")))
        val (impostor, impostorRows) = picker(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, listOf(listOf("Saved Messages", "Forward here to save.", "12:30")))
        val (second, secondRows) = picker(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, listOf(listOf("Ana", "Hi"), listOf("Saved Messages", "Forward here to save.")))
        val (search, searchRows) = picker(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, listOf(listOf("Saved Messages", "Forward here to save.")), searching = true)

        assertTrue(recognise(screen to rows[0]))
        assertFalse(recognise(screen to rows[1]))
        assertFalse(recognise(impostor to impostorRows[0]))
        assertFalse(recognise(second to secondRows[1]))
        assertFalse(recognise(search to searchRows[0]))
    }

    @Test
    fun aSendAfterTheRowCountsOnlyWhenTheScreenShowsTheSelfChat() {
        val dialog = TestScreen(SelfChats.TELEGRAM)
        dialog.add(900, "Send to Saved Messages?", clickable = false)
        val send = dialog.add(1000, "Send")
        val silent = TestScreen(SelfChats.TELEGRAM)
        val silentSend = silent.add(1000, "Send")
        val saved = ShareFlow(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, listOf("Saved Messages"), ShareCount(1, 0), serial = 1)

        assertTrue(recognise(dialog to send, flow = saved))
        assertFalse(recognise(dialog to send, flow = ShareFlow(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, listOf("Ana"), ShareCount(1, 0), serial = 1)))
        assertFalse(recognise(silent to silentSend, flow = saved))
        // Another chat on the screen is checked by the chat's own rule, never by the flow's selection (review 2 C1), also
        // when its message field is empty and a message in it names the self-chat (review 2-2 New 1).
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.TELEGRAM, "Marko", "online"), flow = saved))
        val marko = TestScreen(SelfChats.TELEGRAM)
        marko.add(80, "Marko", left = 150, height = 50, clickable = false)
        marko.add(140, "online", left = 150, height = 40, clickable = false)
        val list = marko.add(300, null, scrollable = true, height = 1400, clickable = false)
        marko.add(400, "Saved Messages are handy", parent = list, clickable = false)
        marko.add(1800, null, editable = true, hint = "Message", text = "", right = 850)
        val share = marko.add(1700, "Share my phone number")
        assertFalse(recognise(marko to share, flow = saved))
    }

    @Test
    fun whatsappNeedsTheOwnersNameWithYouAndItsSubtitle() {
        val whatsapp = setOf(SelfChats.WHATSAPP)

        assertTrue(recognise(chat(SelfChats.WHATSAPP, "Aleksa (You)", "Message yourself"), active = whatsapp))
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.WHATSAPP, "Aleksa (You)", null), active = whatsapp))
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.WHATSAPP, "Aleksa (You)", "Message yourself"), active = whatsapp, owner = settings.copy(whatsappOwnName = null)))
    }

    @Test
    fun vibersNotesNeedTheNameAndASignAndTheRuleIsNotActive() {
        val viber = setOf(SelfChats.VIBER)
        val notes = chat(SelfChats.VIBER, "My Notes", null) { add(80, null, left = 850, description = "Reminders list", text = null) }

        assertTrue(recognise(notes, active = viber))
        assertFalse(recognise(chat(SelfChats.VIBER, "My Notes", null), active = viber))
        assertFalse(recognise(notes))
        assertFalse(SelfChats.VIBER in SelfChats.ACTIVE)
    }

    @Test
    fun anEmailGoesOnlyToTheOwnersAddresses() {
        fun mail(vararg fields: Pair<String, String>): Pair<TestScreen, String> {
            val screen = TestScreen(SelfChats.GMAIL)
            fields.forEachIndexed { index, (id, text) -> screen.add(200 + index * 100, null, id = id, editable = true, text = text) }
            return screen to screen.add(80, "Send", left = 850)
        }
        val gmail = setOf(SelfChats.GMAIL)

        assertTrue(recognise(mail("to" to "owner@example.com"), active = gmail))
        assertTrue(recognise(mail("to" to "Owner@Example.com"), active = gmail))
        assertFalse(recognise(mail("to" to "owner@example.com", "cc" to "marko@example.com"), active = gmail))
        assertFalse(recognise(mail("to" to "owner@example.com, Ana"), active = gmail))
        assertFalse(recognise(mail("to" to ""), active = gmail))
        assertFalse(recognise(mail("to" to "owner@example.com"), active = gmail, owner = settings.copy(ownerEmails = emptyList())))
    }
}
