```kotlin
    @Test
    fun aSidewaysSwipeOnAListRowIsRefused() {
        val snapshot = tree.snapshot()
        fun refusal(direction: Direction, target: Int?) = ActionMapper.swipeRefusal(AgentCall.Swipe(direction, target, "r", Category.READING), table, snapshot)
        val plain = TestTree().apply { add(500, "Next photo", clickable = true) }

        assertEquals(ActionMapper.SWIPE_REFUSAL, refusal(Direction.LEFT, 3))
        assertEquals(ActionMapper.SWIPE_REFUSAL, refusal(Direction.RIGHT, null))
        assertNull(refusal(Direction.LEFT, 1))
        assertNull(refusal(Direction.UP, 3))
        assertNull(ActionMapper.swipeRefusal(AgentCall.Swipe(Direction.LEFT, null, "r", Category.READING), table, plain.snapshot()))
    }

    @Test
    fun dataToolsRunOnThePortWithTheirDays() = runTest {
        val port = RecordingData()
        val today = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 20)

        ActionMapper.runData(AgentCall.FindMedia("yesterday", null, MediaKinds.PHOTOS), port, today)
        ActionMapper.runData(AgentCall.ShareMedia("telegram", listOf("m1", "m2")), port, today, sharePackage = "org.telegram.messenger")
        ActionMapper.runData(AgentCall.CreateEvent("Dentist", "2026-11-21T10:00", null, null), port, today)
        val refused = ActionMapper.runData(AgentCall.ShareMedia("unknown", listOf("m1")), port, today)

        assertEquals(listOf("findMedia 2026-11-19 2026-11-19 PHOTOS", "shareMedia org.telegram.messenger 2", "createEvent 2026-11-21T10:00"), port.calls)
        assertEquals(DataResult.Failed("Kestrel can't share with that app."), refused)
        assertNull(ActionMapper.runData(AgentCall.Say("Hi"), port, today))
        val share = ActionMapper.proposal(AgentCall.ShareMedia("telegram", listOf("m1")), table, "Gallery", "org.telegram.messenger", "Telegram")
        assertEquals(listOf(ActionKind.SHARE_MEDIA, "org.telegram.messenger", "Telegram"), listOf(share.kind, share.receivingPackage, share.receivingAppLabel))
        assertEquals(ActionKind.READ_DATA, ActionMapper.proposal(AgentCall.ListSms(null, 5), table, "Chat").kind)
        assertEquals(ActionKind.SETTINGS_DATA, ActionMapper.proposal(AgentCall.SetTimer(60, null), table, "Chat").kind)
        assertEquals("Hi", ActionMapper.proposal(AgentCall.ComposeSms("+381 60 000 0000", "Hi"), table, "Chat").text)
        val link = ActionMapper.proposal(AgentCall.OpenUrl("https://example.com/?q=1", Browser.FIREFOX, "read"), table, "Chat", receivingAppLabel = "Firefox", linkTargetPackage = "org.mozilla.firefox")
        assertEquals(listOf("https://example.com/?q=1", "org.mozilla.firefox", "Firefox"), listOf(link.link, link.linkTargetPackage, link.receivingAppLabel))
        // The A71 runs Telegram's website build (review 3 I2).
        assertEquals(listOf("org.telegram.messenger", "org.telegram.messenger.web"), SharePackages.of(" Telegram "))
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), SharePackages.of("Signal"))
    }

    /** Records each call; answers every tool with an empty result. */
    private class RecordingData : DataPort {
        val calls = mutableListOf<String>()
        private val ok = DataResult.Ok(emptyList())

        override suspend fun findContact(name: String) = ok.also { calls += "findContact" }
        override suspend fun findMedia(from: LocalDate, until: LocalDate, kinds: MediaKinds) = ok.also { calls += "findMedia $from $until $kinds" }
        override suspend fun shareMedia(packageName: String, items: List<String>) = ok.also { calls += "shareMedia $packageName ${items.size}" }
        override suspend fun listEvents(from: LocalDate, to: LocalDate) = ok.also { calls += "listEvents" }
        override suspend fun createEvent(title: String, start: LocalDateTime, end: LocalDateTime?, location: String?) = ok.also { calls += "createEvent $start" }
        override suspend fun setAlarm(hour: Int, minute: Int, label: String?, days: List<DayOfWeek>) = ok.also { calls += "setAlarm" }
        override suspend fun setTimer(seconds: Int, label: String?) = ok.also { calls += "setTimer" }
        override suspend fun listNotifications() = ok.also { calls += "listNotifications" }
        override suspend fun listSms(from: String?, limit: Int) = ok.also { calls += "listSms" }
        override suspend fun composeSms(number: String, text: String) = ok.also { calls += "composeSms" }
        override suspend fun listCalls(limit: Int) = ok.also { calls += "listCalls" }
        override suspend fun getLocation() = ok.also { calls += "getLocation" }
        override suspend fun mediaControl(action: MediaAction) = ok.also { calls += "mediaControl" }
        override suspend fun navigate(app: NavigationApp, to: String, mode: TravelMode?) = ok.also { calls += "navigate" }
        override fun forgetTask() = Unit
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.TestTree
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowKind
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

/** Design D6 of sub-project 5: the result of an action by code, over the app's windows only. */
class ChangesTest {
    /**
     * A chat named [title] in its toolbar, a list of [rows] and a quantity [count] beside a "+" button at [bottom]; with
     * the keyboard up, the app moves that row above the keyboard and its window keeps its full height.
     */
    private fun chat(
        title: String = "Ana",
        rows: List<String> = listOf("Hi", "See you"),
        count: String = "1",
        packageName: String = "com.example.chat",
        bottom: Int = 2200,
    ) = TestTree(packageName).apply {
        val bar = add(80, id = "toolbar", className = "android.view.ViewGroup", height = 160)
        add(100, title, parent = bar)
        val list = add(300, description = "Messages", scrollable = true, height = bottom - 400, key = "list")
        rows.forEachIndexed { index, row -> add(320 + index * 100, row, parent = list, key = "row$index") }
        add(bottom, "+", clickable = true, className = "android.widget.Button", key = "plus", right = 200)
        add(bottom, count, left = 200, key = "count")
    }

    @Test
    fun anotherAppAnotherShapeOrAnotherTitleIsAnotherScreen() {
        val before = chat().snapshot()
        val list = TestTree().apply {
            add(80, "Chats", id = "toolbar", height = 160)
            add(400, "Ana", clickable = true, key = "a")
            add(500, "Marko", clickable = true, key = "b")
            add(600, "Petar", clickable = true, key = "c")
        }

        assertEquals(Outcome.AnotherScreen(null), Changes.outcome(before, chat(packageName = "com.example.other").snapshot(), "plus"))
        assertEquals(Outcome.AnotherScreen(null), Changes.outcome(before, list.snapshot(), "plus"))
        assertEquals(Outcome.AnotherScreen(null), Changes.outcome(before, chat(title = "Marko").snapshot(), "plus"))
        // The same parts in a new window of the app: another screen within one step (review 1-2 N1).
        val moved = before.copy(windows = before.windows.map { it.copy(id = 9) }, elements = before.elements.map { it.copy(windowId = 9) })
        assertEquals(Outcome.AnotherScreen(null), Changes.outcome(before, moved, "plus"))
    }

    @Test
    fun aScrollWhoseFirstRowChangesOnAScreenWithoutAToolbarTitleChangesTheTarget() {
        fun page(rows: List<String>) = TestTree().apply {
            val list = add(0, description = "Settings", scrollable = true, height = 2400, key = "list")
            rows.forEachIndexed { index, row -> add(10 + index * 100, row, parent = list, key = "row$index") }
        }

        assertEquals(Outcome.TargetChanged, Changes.outcome(page(listOf("Wi-Fi", "Bluetooth")).snapshot(), page(listOf("Display", "Sound")).snapshot(), "list"))
    }

    @Test
    fun theTargetTheRestOfTheScreenOrNothing() {
        val before = chat().snapshot()

        assertEquals(Outcome.ChangedElsewhere, Changes.outcome(before, chat(count = "2").snapshot(), "plus"))
        assertEquals(Outcome.NothingChanged, Changes.outcome(before, chat().snapshot(), "plus"))
        assertEquals(Outcome.TargetChanged, Changes.outcome(before, chat(rows = listOf("Hi", "See you", "Bye")).snapshot(), "list"))
        assertEquals(Outcome.TargetChanged, Changes.outcome(before, chat(rows = listOf("Hi")).snapshot(), "row1"))
        assertEquals(Outcome.ChangedElsewhere, Changes.outcome(before, chat(count = "2").snapshot(), null))
    }

    @Test
    fun theKeyboardAndSystemUiNeverChangeAResult() {
        val before = chat().apply {
            window(5, "com.android.systemui", IntRect(0, 0, 1080, 80), kind = WindowKind.SYSTEM)
            add(10, "10:20", window = 5, key = "clock")
        }.snapshot()
        // The keyboard comes up and the app moves its bottom row just above it (review 3 I3).
        val after = chat(bottom = 1400).apply {
            window(5, "com.android.systemui", IntRect(0, 0, 1080, 80), kind = WindowKind.SYSTEM)
            add(10, "10:21", window = 5, key = "clock")
            window(6, "com.google.android.inputmethod.latin", IntRect(0, 1500, 1080, 2400), kind = WindowKind.INPUT_METHOD)
            add(1600, "q", clickable = true, window = 6, key = "q")
        }.snapshot()

        assertEquals(Outcome.NothingChanged, Changes.outcome(before, after, "plus"))
    }

    @Test
    fun aQuickSettingsTileThatTheActionFlippedChangedAndAHiddenWindowNeverCounts() {
        fun shade(checked: Boolean) = chat().apply {
            window(5, "com.android.systemui", IntRect(0, 0, 1080, 1600), kind = WindowKind.SYSTEM)
            add(100, description = "Hotspot", id = "tile", clickable = true, checkable = true, checked = checked, className = "android.widget.Switch", window = 5, key = "tile")
        }.snapshot()
        fun withBank(balance: String) = chat().apply {
            window(7, "com.example.bank", IntRect(0, 1800, 1080, 2400))
            add(1900, balance, window = 7, key = "balance")
        }.snapshot()

        assertEquals(Outcome.TargetChanged, Changes.outcome(shade(false), shade(true), "tile"))
        assertEquals(Outcome.NothingChanged, Changes.outcome(withBank("100"), withBank("90"), "plus", hidden = { it == "com.example.bank" }))
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.TableEntry
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** Design D6 of sub-project 5: the result line, the one-line summary and the `Last:` line of a step. */
class StepResultTest {
    private fun entry(shown: String, className: String = "android.widget.Button") = TableEntry(
        number = 15, key = "send", label = "raw label", shownLabel = shown, className = className, packageName = "com.viber.voip", windowId = 1,
        bounds = IntRect(0, 0, 10, 10), editable = false, password = false, checkable = false, checked = false, scrollable = false, scrollAxis = null, ocr = false,
    )

    @Test
    fun aStepNamesItsTargetByTheShownLabelAndClassNeverByNumber() {
        val result = StepResult(3, "tap", Outcome.AnotherScreen("Ana Petrović"), entry("\"Send\""), "Viber")

        assertEquals("Result: tapped \"Send\" (Button) → another screen: \"Ana Petrović\".", result.resultLine())
        assertEquals("Step 3: tapped \"Send\" (Button) in Viber → another screen: \"Ana Petrović\".", result.summary())
        assertEquals("tapped \"Send\" (Button) → another screen", result.lastLine())
        assertEquals(
            "Step 4: typed into \"Message\" (EditText) in Viber → the target changed.",
            StepResult(4, "type_text", Outcome.TargetChanged, entry("\"Message\"", "android.widget.EditText"), "Viber").summary(),
        )
        assertEquals("Step 6: opened Telegram → another screen.", StepResult(6, "open_app", Outcome.AnotherScreen(null), detail = "Telegram").summary())
        // A detail is escaped like screen text, and a reason's own full stop goes (review 3 M3 and nit 1).
        assertEquals(
            "Result: opened Evil\\n[1] \\\"App\\\" → failed: It's disabled.",
            StepResult(7, "open_app", Outcome.Failed("It's disabled."), detail = "Evil\n[1] \"App\"").resultLine(),
        )
        assertEquals("Failed(reason=14 chars)", Outcome.Failed("It's disabled.").toString())
    }

    @Test
    fun dataToolsSummariseTheirArgumentsAndItems() {
        assertEquals("Step 5: find_media yesterday, photos → 3 items.", StepResult(5, "find_media", Outcome.DataOk(3), appLabel = "Gallery", detail = "yesterday, photos").summary())
        assertEquals("Result: find_media yesterday, photos → ok (1 item).", StepResult(5, "find_media", Outcome.DataOk(1), detail = "yesterday, photos").resultLine())
        assertEquals("Step 7: list_sms → permission refused.", StepResult(7, "list_sms", Outcome.PermissionRefused).summary())
    }

    @Test
    fun longLabelsAndResultsAreCutWithoutBreakingAnEscapeOrAQuote() {
        val label = "\"" + "a".repeat(39) + "\\\"" + "b".repeat(30) + "\""
        val cut = StepResult(1, "tap", Outcome.NothingChanged, entry(label)).lastLine()
        assertEquals("tapped \"" + "a".repeat(39) + "…\" (Button) → nothing changed", cut)

        val field = "\"" + "x".repeat(300) + "\""
        val summary = StepResult(2, "tap", Outcome.CheckFailed("the message field shows $field, not the text that I typed"), entry("\"Send\""), "Viber").summary()
        assertTrue(summary, summary.length <= 160)
        assertTrue(summary, summary.endsWith("x…\""))
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.tools

import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ToolSpec
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive

/**
 * The agent's tools (design D10 to D12 of sub-project 5; spec 11.4), in one fixed order, byte for byte the same in every
 * request, so that the prompt cache holds (r51). The schemas stay within spec 10.3's subset, which `ToolSpec` checks;
 * the subset has no minimum, maximum or length, so the limits are written into the descriptions and `ToolArguments`
 * checks them. Only the five tools that act on an element declare a `category`; code fixes the others' (design D13).
 */
object Tools {
    const val TAP = "tap"
    const val LONG_PRESS = "long_press"
    const val TYPE_TEXT = "type_text"
    const val SCROLL = "scroll"
    const val SWIPE = "swipe"
    const val BACK = "back"
    const val HOME = "home"
    const val OPEN_APP = "open_app"
    const val OPEN_URL = "open_url"
    const val OPEN_DEEP_LINK = "open_deep_link"
    const val OPEN_SETTINGS = "open_settings"
    const val WAIT = "wait"
    const val LOOK_CLOSER = "look_closer"
    const val FIND_CONTACT = "find_contact"
    const val FIND_MEDIA = "find_media"
    const val SHARE_MEDIA = "share_media"
    const val LIST_EVENTS = "list_events"
    const val CREATE_EVENT = "create_event"
    const val SET_ALARM = "set_alarm"
    const val SET_TIMER = "set_timer"
    const val LIST_NOTIFICATIONS = "list_notifications"
    const val LIST_SMS = "list_sms"
    const val COMPOSE_SMS = "compose_sms"
    const val LIST_CALLS = "list_calls"
    const val GET_LOCATION = "get_location"
    const val MEDIA_CONTROL = "media_control"
    const val NAVIGATE = "navigate"
    const val ASK_USER = "ask_user"
    const val SAY = "say"
    const val FINISH = "finish"
    const val FAIL = "fail"
    const val REMEMBER = "remember"
    const val FORGET = "forget"

    /** The tools whose call declares a category: those that act on an element. */
    val WITH_CATEGORY: Set<String> = setOf(TAP, LONG_PRESS, TYPE_TEXT, SCROLL, SWIPE)

    internal const val REASON_LIMIT = 120
    internal const val QUESTION_LIMIT = 200
    internal const val SAY_LIMIT = 600
    internal const val SUMMARY_LIMIT = 300
    internal const val FAIL_LIMIT = 200
    internal const val NOTE_LIMIT = 200
    internal const val NOTES_PER_APP = 3
    internal const val WAIT_MAX = 10
    internal const val LIST_MAX = 20
    internal const val TIMER_MAX = 86_400

    internal val DIRECTIONS = listOf("up", "down", "left", "right")
    internal val DAYS = listOf("monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday")

    private fun string(description: String, values: List<String>? = null): JsonObject = JsonObject(
        buildMap {
            put("type", JsonPrimitive("string"))
            put("description", JsonPrimitive(description))
            if (values != null) put("enum", JsonArray(values.map(::JsonPrimitive)))
        },
    )

    private fun integer(description: String): JsonObject = JsonObject(mapOf("type" to JsonPrimitive("integer"), "description" to JsonPrimitive(description)))

    private fun boolean(description: String): JsonObject = JsonObject(mapOf("type" to JsonPrimitive("boolean"), "description" to JsonPrimitive(description)))

    private fun array(description: String, items: JsonObject): JsonObject =
        JsonObject(mapOf("type" to JsonPrimitive("array"), "description" to JsonPrimitive(description), "items" to items))

    private fun objectOf(properties: List<Pair<String, JsonObject>>, required: List<String>, description: String? = null): JsonObject = JsonObject(
        buildMap {
            put("type", JsonPrimitive("object"))
            if (description != null) put("description", JsonPrimitive(description))
            put("properties", JsonObject(properties.toMap()))
            if (required.isNotEmpty()) put("required", JsonArray(required.map(::JsonPrimitive)))
        },
    )

    private val target = "target" to integer("The number of an element in the newest observation.")
    private val optionalTarget = "target" to integer("The number of an element in the newest observation; leave it out for the whole screen.")
    private val reason = "reason" to string("Why this action, in a few words; at most $REASON_LIMIT characters. Logged, never spoken.")
    private val category = "category" to string(
        "The kind of this action: reading, typing the owner's request, ordinary settings, typing text from the screen, sending, " +
            "calls, deleting, payments, credentials or protected settings. Kestrel's code checks it.",
        Category.entries.map { it.wire },
    )
    private val direction = "direction" to string("Which way to move the content's view: up, down, left or right.", DIRECTIONS)

    private fun tool(name: String, description: String, properties: List<Pair<String, JsonObject>>, required: List<String>) =
        ToolSpec(name, description, objectOf(properties, required))

    val ALL: List<ToolSpec> = listOf(
        tool(TAP, "Tap an element of the newest observation; an OCR line is tapped at its centre.", listOf(target, reason, category), listOf("target", "reason", "category")),
        tool(LONG_PRESS, "Long-press an element of the newest observation.", listOf(target, reason, category), listOf("target", "reason", "category")),
        tool(
            TYPE_TEXT,
            "Replace the whole text of an editable field with the given text. A placeholder such as [OTP_1] is typed as its real value only after the owner's yes.",
            listOf(target, "text" to string("The field's whole new text."), reason, category),
            listOf("target", "text", "reason", "category"),
        ),
        tool(
            SCROLL,
            "Scroll an element, or the largest scrollable element of the screen, to show more content in the given direction: down shows what is below.",
            listOf(direction, optionalTarget, reason, category),
            listOf("direction", "reason", "category"),
        ),
        tool(
            SWIPE,
            "Swipe across an element or the screen in the given direction. Left and right only on an element that scrolls sideways or on a screen without a list that scrolls up and down.",
            listOf(direction, optionalTarget, reason, category),
            listOf("direction", "reason", "category"),
        ),
        tool(BACK, "Press Android's Back.", listOf(reason), listOf("reason")),
        tool(HOME, "Go to the home screen.", listOf(reason), listOf("reason")),
        tool(OPEN_APP, "Open an installed app by its name.", listOf("name" to string("The app's name as the launcher shows it."), reason), listOf("name", "reason")),
        tool(
            OPEN_URL,
            "Open an https link in a browser. Use this to open web pages; never type into a browser's address bar.",
            listOf("url" to string("An https link."), "browser" to string("Which browser: default, firefox or chrome.", Browser.entries.map { it.wire }), reason),
            listOf("url", "reason"),
        ),
        tool(
            OPEN_DEEP_LINK,
            "Open a link into an app. Only these schemes: viber, whatsapp, tg, waze, google.navigation, geo, tel, sms and mailto. A tel link only opens the dial screen.",
            listOf("uri" to string("The link."), reason),
            listOf("uri", "reason"),
        ),
        tool(
            OPEN_SETTINGS,
            "Open a page of Android's settings.",
            listOf("page" to string("The settings page.", SettingsPage.entries.map { it.wire }), reason),
            listOf("page", "reason"),
        ),
        tool(
            WAIT,
            "Wait until the screen changes or the time runs out, whichever comes first.",
            listOf("seconds" to integer("How long to wait at most: 1 to $WAIT_MAX seconds."), reason),
            listOf("seconds", "reason"),
        ),
        tool(
            LOOK_CLOSER,
            "When the observation misses something that the screen shows: the first call reads text with OCR, the second may send a screenshot, the third asks the owner to pick a number.",
            listOf(optionalTarget, reason),
            listOf("reason"),
        ),
        tool(FIND_CONTACT, "Find contacts by name: their numbers, e-mail addresses and messaging apps.", listOf("name" to string("The name to look for.")), listOf("name")),
        tool(
            FIND_MEDIA,
            "Find photos and videos taken on a day or between two days. Returns item numbers such as m1, never the pictures.",
            listOf(
                "day" to string("today, yesterday or YYYY-MM-DD."),
                "until" to string("The last day: today, yesterday or YYYY-MM-DD; leave it out for one day."),
                "kinds" to string("photos, videos or both.", listOf("photos", "videos", "both")),
            ),
            listOf("day"),
        ),
        tool(
            SHARE_MEDIA,
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.tools

import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalDateTime
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException

/**
 * The settings pages that `open_settings` opens (design D11 of sub-project 5): each page's intent actions, tried in
 * order until one has an activity. The protected pages (accessibility, security, device admin, unknown sources,
 * biometrics, lock screen) are not on the list (spec 12.3's floor).
 */
enum class SettingsPage(val wire: String, val actions: List<String>) {
    WIFI("wifi", listOf("android.settings.WIFI_SETTINGS")),
    BLUETOOTH("bluetooth", listOf("android.settings.BLUETOOTH_SETTINGS")),
    HOTSPOT("hotspot", listOf("android.settings.TETHER_SETTINGS", "com.android.settings.WIFI_TETHER_SETTINGS", "android.settings.WIRELESS_SETTINGS")),
    MOBILE_DATA("mobile_data", listOf("android.settings.DATA_USAGE_SETTINGS")),
    DISPLAY("display", listOf("android.settings.DISPLAY_SETTINGS")),
    SOUND("sound", listOf("android.settings.SOUND_SETTINGS")),
    LOCATION("location", listOf("android.settings.LOCATION_SOURCE_SETTINGS")),
    BATTERY("battery", listOf("android.settings.BATTERY_SAVER_SETTINGS")),
    DATE_TIME("date_time", listOf("android.settings.DATE_SETTINGS")),
    APPS("apps", listOf("android.settings.APPLICATION_SETTINGS")),
    NOTIFICATIONS("notifications", listOf("android.settings.ALL_APPS_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS", "android.settings.APPLICATION_SETTINGS")),
    MAIN("main", listOf("android.settings.SETTINGS")),
    ;

    companion object {
        fun fromWire(name: String): SettingsPage? = entries.firstOrNull { it.wire == name }
    }
}

/** `open_url`'s browsers (design D11): the packages to try, the first installed one wins; [DEFAULT] sets none. */
enum class Browser(val wire: String, val packages: List<String>) {
    DEFAULT("default", emptyList()),
    FIREFOX("firefox", listOf("org.mozilla.firefox", "org.mozilla.firefox_beta", "org.mozilla.fenix")),
    CHROME("chrome", listOf("com.android.chrome")),
    ;

    companion object {
        fun fromWire(name: String): Browser? = entries.firstOrNull { it.wire == name }
    }
}

/**
 * The share targets that `share_media` names by a word (design D12): the packages to try, in order, the first installed
 * one wins; empty for a launcher app's name. Telegram has its Play build and its website build, which the A71 runs
 * (review 3 I2).
 */
object SharePackages {
    private val KNOWN = mapOf(
        "telegram" to listOf("org.telegram.messenger", "org.telegram.messenger.web"),
        "whatsapp" to listOf("com.whatsapp"),
        "viber" to listOf("com.viber.voip"),
        "gmail" to listOf("com.google.android.gm"),
    )

    fun of(app: String): List<String> = KNOWN[app.trim().lowercase()].orEmpty()
}

/** The data tools' days and times (design D12): `today`, `yesterday`, `YYYY-MM-DD` and `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`, local time. */
object Dates {
    private val DAY = Regex("[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
    private val DATE_TIME = Regex("[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}")

    fun day(text: String, today: LocalDate): LocalDate? = when (val word = text.trim().lowercase()) {
        "today" -> today
        "yesterday" -> today.minusDays(1)
        else -> if (DAY.matches(word)) parse { LocalDate.parse(word) } else null
    }

    fun dateTime(text: String): LocalDateTime? {
        val trimmed = text.trim()
        return if (DATE_TIME.matches(trimmed)) parse { LocalDateTime.parse(trimmed) } else null
    }

    private fun <T> parse(block: () -> T): T? = try {
        block()
    } catch (_: DateTimeParseException) {
        null
    }
}
```

Create `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/tools/ToolArguments.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.tools

import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ObservationTable
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Direction
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.MediaAction
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.MediaKinds
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.NavigationApp
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.TravelMode
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import dev.kestrel.safety.Vault
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.booleanOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.doubleOrNull
import java.time.DayOfWeek
import java.time.LocalDate

/**
 * Checks a tool call's arguments against its schema and the limits of its description (design D4 and D10 of
 * sub-project 5): an unknown tool, a missing or mistyped argument, a value outside its list, a broken limit, a target that
 * the newest observation does not have, a placeholder that the task's vault does not hold, and a placeholder of the vault
 * anywhere but `type_text`'s text (typed after the owner's yes) and the texts that Kestrel speaks as its kind (`say`'s
 * text, `finish`'s summary and `fail`'s reason; design D17) give [ParsedCall.Invalid] with one of Kestrel's fixed
 * sentences, which names the argument but never repeats the model's text. A null argument and a blank optional text
 * count as left out, and an unknown argument is ignored.
 */
object ToolArguments {
    private class Bad(val reason: String) : Exception(null, null, false, false)

    private class Reader(val arguments: JsonObject, val table: ObservationTable) {
        private fun value(name: String): JsonElement? = arguments[name]?.takeUnless { it is JsonNull }

        private fun missing(name: String): Nothing = throw Bad("The argument $name is missing.")

        fun string(name: String, limit: Int? = null): String = optionalString(name, limit, blank = false) ?: missing(name)

        /** A blank optional text counts as left out, because models often send `""` for an optional field (review 3 M5). */
        fun optionalString(name: String, limit: Int? = null, blank: Boolean = true): String? {
            val element = value(name) ?: return null
            if (element !is JsonPrimitive || !element.isString) throw Bad("The argument $name must be a string.")
            val text = element.content
            if (text.isBlank()) {
                if (blank) return null
                throw Bad("The argument $name is empty.")
            }
            if (limit != null && text.length > limit) throw Bad("The argument $name is longer than $limit characters.")
            return text
        }

        fun int(name: String, range: IntRange? = null): Int = optionalInt(name, range) ?: missing(name)

        fun optionalInt(name: String, range: IntRange? = null): Int? {
            val element = value(name) ?: return null
            val number = (element as? JsonPrimitive)?.takeUnless { it.isString }?.doubleOrNull
            if (number == null || number % 1.0 != 0.0 || number !in Int.MIN_VALUE.toDouble()..Int.MAX_VALUE.toDouble()) {
                throw Bad("The argument $name must be an integer.")
            }
            val value = number.toInt()
            if (range != null && value !in range) throw Bad("The argument $name must be from ${range.first} to ${range.last}.")
            return value
        }

        fun optionalBoolean(name: String): Boolean? {
            val element = value(name) ?: return null
            return (element as? JsonPrimitive)?.takeUnless { it.isString }?.booleanOrNull ?: throw Bad("The argument $name must be true or false.")
        }

        fun <T> choice(name: String, values: Map<String, T>): T = optionalChoice(name, values) ?: missing(name)

        fun <T> optionalChoice(name: String, values: Map<String, T>): T? {
            val text = optionalString(name) ?: return null
            return values[text] ?: throw Bad("The argument $name must be one of: ${values.keys.joinToString(", ")}.")
        }

        fun array(name: String): List<JsonElement>? {
            val element = value(name) ?: return null
            return element as? JsonArray ?: throw Bad("The argument $name must be an array.")
        }

        fun target(name: String = "target", typed: Boolean = false, pressed: Boolean = false): Int = optionalTarget(name, typed, pressed) ?: missing(name)

        /** A number of the newest observation; [typed] and [pressed] need an element (an OCR line can only be tapped). */
        fun optionalTarget(name: String = "target", typed: Boolean = false, pressed: Boolean = false): Int? {
            val number = optionalInt(name) ?: return null
            val entry = table.entry(number) ?: throw Bad("The newest observation has no [$number].")
            if (entry.ocr && (typed || pressed)) throw Bad("[$number] is an OCR line, which Kestrel can only tap.")
            if (typed && !entry.editable) throw Bad("[$number] is not an editable field.")
            return number
        }
    }

    private val CATEGORIES = Category.entries.associateBy { it.wire }
    private val DIRECTIONS = mapOf("up" to Direction.UP, "down" to Direction.DOWN, "left" to Direction.LEFT, "right" to Direction.RIGHT)
    private val BROWSERS = Browser.entries.associateBy { it.wire }
    private val PAGES = SettingsPage.entries.associateBy { it.wire }
    private val KINDS = mapOf("photos" to MediaKinds.PHOTOS, "videos" to MediaKinds.VIDEOS, "both" to MediaKinds.BOTH)
    private val MEDIA = mapOf("play" to MediaAction.PLAY, "pause" to MediaAction.PAUSE, "next" to MediaAction.NEXT, "previous" to MediaAction.PREVIOUS)
    private val NAVIGATION = mapOf("waze" to NavigationApp.WAZE, "google_maps" to NavigationApp.GOOGLE_MAPS)
    private val MODES = mapOf("drive" to TravelMode.DRIVE, "bicycle" to TravelMode.BICYCLE, "walk" to TravelMode.WALK, "two_wheeler" to TravelMode.TWO_WHEELER)
    private val DAYS = Tools.DAYS.zip(DayOfWeek.values()).toMap()
    private val ITEM = Regex("m[0-9]+")
    private val ANY_DAY = LocalDate.of(2000, 1, 1)

    fun parse(name: String, arguments: JsonObject, table: ObservationTable, vault: Vault): ParsedCall {
        if (Tools.spec(name) == null) return ParsedCall.Invalid("Kestrel has no such tool.")
        placeholder(name, arguments, vault)?.let { return ParsedCall.Invalid(it) }
        return try {
            ParsedCall.Valid(read(name, Reader(arguments, table)))
        } catch (bad: Bad) {
            ParsedCall.Invalid(bad.reason)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Why a placeholder cannot stand in [arguments]: one that [vault] does not hold, which the model made up, or one that
     * it holds outside the argument of [PLACEHOLDER_ARGUMENTS] where Kestrel can type or speak it; null when none.
     */
    private fun placeholder(name: String, arguments: JsonObject, vault: Vault): String? {
        fun strings(element: JsonElement): List<String> = when (element) {
            is JsonPrimitive -> if (element.isString) listOf(element.content) else emptyList()
            is JsonArray -> element.flatMap(::strings)
            is JsonObject -> element.values.flatMap(::strings)
        }
        for ((key, value) in arguments) {
            for (text in strings(value)) {
                Vault.PLACEHOLDER.findAll(text).map { it.value }.firstOrNull { vault.valueOf(it) == null }?.let { return "Kestrel has no $it in this task." }
                if (PLACEHOLDER_ARGUMENTS[name] != key) vault.placeholdersIn(text).firstOrNull()?.let { return "Kestrel can't use $it there." }
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    /** The one argument of each tool where a placeholder may stand: typed after the owner's yes, or spoken as its kind. */
    private val PLACEHOLDER_ARGUMENTS = mapOf(Tools.TYPE_TEXT to "text", Tools.SAY to "text", Tools.FINISH to "summary", Tools.FAIL to "reason")

    private fun read(name: String, r: Reader): AgentCall = when (name) {
        Tools.TAP -> AgentCall.Tap(r.target(), reason(r), category(r))
        Tools.LONG_PRESS -> AgentCall.LongPress(r.target(pressed = true), reason(r), category(r))
        Tools.TYPE_TEXT -> AgentCall.TypeText(r.target(typed = true), textOf(r), reason(r), category(r))
        Tools.SCROLL -> AgentCall.Scroll(r.choice("direction", DIRECTIONS), r.optionalTarget(pressed = true), reason(r), category(r))
        Tools.SWIPE -> AgentCall.Swipe(r.choice("direction", DIRECTIONS), r.optionalTarget(pressed = true), reason(r), category(r))
        Tools.BACK -> AgentCall.Back(reason(r))
        Tools.HOME -> AgentCall.Home(reason(r))
        Tools.OPEN_APP -> AgentCall.OpenApp(r.string("name"), reason(r))
        Tools.OPEN_URL -> AgentCall.OpenUrl(r.string("url"), r.optionalChoice("browser", BROWSERS) ?: Browser.DEFAULT, reason(r))
        Tools.OPEN_DEEP_LINK -> AgentCall.OpenDeepLink(r.string("uri"), reason(r))
        Tools.OPEN_SETTINGS -> AgentCall.OpenSettings(r.choice("page", PAGES), reason(r))
        Tools.WAIT -> AgentCall.Wait(r.int("seconds", 1..Tools.WAIT_MAX), reason(r))
        Tools.LOOK_CLOSER -> AgentCall.LookCloser(r.optionalTarget(), reason(r))
        Tools.FIND_CONTACT -> AgentCall.FindContact(r.string("name"))
        Tools.FIND_MEDIA -> AgentCall.FindMedia(day(r, "day")!!, day(r, "until"), r.optionalChoice("kinds", KINDS) ?: MediaKinds.BOTH)
        Tools.SHARE_MEDIA -> AgentCall.ShareMedia(r.string("app"), items(r))
        Tools.LIST_EVENTS -> AgentCall.ListEvents(day(r, "from")!!, day(r, "to")!!)
        Tools.CREATE_EVENT -> AgentCall.CreateEvent(r.string("title"), dateTime(r, "start")!!, dateTime(r, "end"), r.optionalString("location"))
        Tools.SET_ALARM -> AgentCall.SetAlarm(r.int("hour", 0..23), r.int("minute", 0..59), r.optionalString("label"), days(r))
        Tools.SET_TIMER -> AgentCall.SetTimer(r.int("seconds", 1..Tools.TIMER_MAX), r.optionalString("label"))
        Tools.LIST_NOTIFICATIONS -> AgentCall.ListNotifications
        Tools.LIST_SMS -> AgentCall.ListSms(r.optionalString("from"), r.optionalInt("limit", 1..Tools.LIST_MAX) ?: Tools.LIST_MAX)
        Tools.COMPOSE_SMS -> AgentCall.ComposeSms(r.string("number"), r.string("text"))
        Tools.LIST_CALLS -> AgentCall.ListCalls(r.optionalInt("limit", 1..Tools.LIST_MAX) ?: Tools.LIST_MAX)
        Tools.GET_LOCATION -> AgentCall.GetLocation
        Tools.MEDIA_CONTROL -> AgentCall.MediaControl(r.choice("action", MEDIA))
        Tools.NAVIGATE -> AgentCall.Navigate(r.choice("app", NAVIGATION), r.string("to"), r.optionalChoice("mode", MODES))
        Tools.ASK_USER -> AgentCall.AskUser(r.string("question", Tools.QUESTION_LIMIT))
        Tools.SAY -> AgentCall.Say(r.string("text", Tools.SAY_LIMIT))
        Tools.FINISH -> AgentCall.Finish(r.string("summary", Tools.SUMMARY_LIMIT), evidence(r), r.optionalString("signature"), notes(r))
        Tools.FAIL -> AgentCall.Fail(r.string("reason", Tools.FAIL_LIMIT))
        Tools.REMEMBER -> AgentCall.Remember(r.string("key"), r.string("value"))
        else -> AgentCall.Forget(r.string("key"))
    }

    private fun reason(r: Reader): String = r.string("reason", Tools.REASON_LIMIT)

    private fun category(r: Reader): Category = r.choice("category", CATEGORIES)

    /** `type_text`'s text may be empty, which clears the field. */
    private fun textOf(r: Reader): String {
        val element = r.arguments["text"]?.takeUnless { it is JsonNull } ?: throw Bad("The argument text is missing.")
        if (element !is JsonPrimitive || !element.isString) throw Bad("The argument text must be a string.")
        return element.content
    }

    private fun day(r: Reader, name: String): String? {
        val text = r.optionalString(name) ?: return if (name == "until") null else throw Bad("The argument $name is missing.")
        if (Dates.day(text, ANY_DAY) == null) throw Bad("The argument $name must be today, yesterday or YYYY-MM-DD.")
        return text
    }

    private fun dateTime(r: Reader, name: String): String? {
        val text = r.optionalString(name) ?: return if (name == "end") null else throw Bad("The argument $name is missing.")
        if (Dates.dateTime(text) == null) throw Bad("The argument $name must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.")
        return text
    }

    private fun items(r: Reader): List<String> {
        val items = r.array("items") ?: throw Bad("The argument items is missing.")
        if (items.isEmpty()) throw Bad("The argument items is empty.")
        return items.map { item ->
            val text = (item as? JsonPrimitive)?.takeIf { it.isString }?.content
            if (text == null || !ITEM.matches(text)) throw Bad("The argument items must hold item numbers such as m1.")
            text
        }
    }

    private fun days(r: Reader): List<DayOfWeek> = r.array("days").orEmpty().map { day ->
        val text = (day as? JsonPrimitive)?.takeIf { it.isString }?.content
        DAYS[text] ?: throw Bad("The argument days must hold: ${Tools.DAYS.joinToString(", ")}.")
    }

    private fun evidence(r: Reader): List<Evidence> {
        val items = r.array("evidence") ?: throw Bad("The argument evidence is missing.")
        return items.map { item ->
            val fields = Reader(item as? JsonObject ?: throw Bad("Each item of evidence must be an object."), r.table)
            val target = fields.optionalTarget()
            val step = fields.optionalInt("step", 1..Int.MAX_VALUE)
            if ((target == null) == (step == null)) throw Bad("Each item of evidence needs a target or a step.")
            Evidence(target, step, fields.optionalBoolean("checked"))
        }
    }

    private fun notes(r: Reader): List<NoteDraft> {
        val notes = r.array("notes").orEmpty().map { item ->
            val fields = Reader(item as? JsonObject ?: throw Bad("Each note must be an object."), r.table)
            NoteDraft(fields.string("app"), fields.string("note", Tools.NOTE_LIMIT))
        }
        if (notes.groupingBy { it.app.trim().lowercase() }.eachCount().values.any { it > Tools.NOTES_PER_APP }) {
            throw Bad("At most ${Tools.NOTES_PER_APP} notes per app.")
        }
        return notes
    }
}
```

Create `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/tools/ActionMapper.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.tools

import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ObservationTable
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.TableEntry
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.DataPort
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.DataResult
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Direction
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.GlobalKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Press
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ScreenAction
import dev.kestrel.safety.ActionKind
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import dev.kestrel.safety.Point
import dev.kestrel.safety.Proposal
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScrollAxis
import java.time.LocalDate

/**
 * Maps a checked call onto the safety check's [Proposal], the screen's [ScreenAction] and the [DataPort] (design D10
 * to D13 of sub-project 5). Every action on an element carries the [dev.kestrel.agent.port.Expect] of the observation's
 * table (design D32 item 27), so that `:app` does nothing when the element changed.
 */
object ActionMapper {
    /** The sentence of a refused sideways swipe (design D10). */
    const val SWIPE_REFUSAL = "a sideways swipe on a list row can archive, delete or call"

    /**
     * The proposal for the safety check. `share_media`'s [Proposal.shareCount] is left to the loop, which knows the kinds
     * of the task's media items. For `open_url` and `open_deep_link`, [receivingAppLabel] is the label of the app that
     * opens the link, which the link's question names.
     */
    fun proposal(
        call: AgentCall,
        table: ObservationTable,
        frontAppLabel: String?,
        receivingPackage: String? = null,
        receivingAppLabel: String? = null,
        linkFromOwner: Boolean = false,
        linkTargetPackage: String? = null,
    ): Proposal {
        fun of(kind: ActionKind, declared: Category? = null, target: TableEntry? = null, text: String? = null) =
            Proposal(call.tool, kind, declared, targetKey = target?.key, text = text, frontAppLabel = frontAppLabel)
        return when (call) {
            is AgentCall.Tap -> {
                val entry = table.entry(call.target)
                if (entry != null && entry.ocr) {
                    Proposal(call.tool, ActionKind.TAP_AT, call.category, point = Point(entry.bounds.centerX, entry.bounds.centerY), pointText = entry.label, frontAppLabel = frontAppLabel)
                } else {
                    of(ActionKind.TAP, call.category, entry)
                }
            }
            is AgentCall.LongPress -> of(ActionKind.LONG_PRESS, call.category, table.entry(call.target))
            is AgentCall.TypeText -> of(ActionKind.TYPE, call.category, table.entry(call.target), call.text)
            is AgentCall.Scroll -> of(ActionKind.SCROLL, call.category, call.target?.let(table::entry) ?: largestScrollable(table))
            is AgentCall.Swipe -> of(ActionKind.SWIPE, call.category, call.target?.let(table::entry))
            is AgentCall.Back -> of(ActionKind.BACK)
            is AgentCall.Home -> of(ActionKind.HOME)
            is AgentCall.Wait -> of(ActionKind.WAIT)
            is AgentCall.LookCloser -> of(ActionKind.LOOK_CLOSER, target = call.target?.let(table::entry))
            is AgentCall.OpenApp -> of(ActionKind.OPEN_APP)
            is AgentCall.OpenUrl -> of(ActionKind.OPEN_URL)
                .copy(link = call.url, linkFromOwner = linkFromOwner, linkTargetPackage = linkTargetPackage, receivingAppLabel = receivingAppLabel)
            is AgentCall.OpenDeepLink -> of(ActionKind.OPEN_DEEP_LINK)
                .copy(link = call.uri, linkFromOwner = linkFromOwner, linkTargetPackage = linkTargetPackage, receivingAppLabel = receivingAppLabel)
            is AgentCall.OpenSettings -> of(ActionKind.OPEN_SETTINGS)
            is AgentCall.FindContact, is AgentCall.FindMedia, is AgentCall.ListEvents, AgentCall.ListNotifications,
            is AgentCall.ListSms, is AgentCall.ListCalls, AgentCall.GetLocation -> of(ActionKind.READ_DATA)
            is AgentCall.SetAlarm, is AgentCall.SetTimer, is AgentCall.CreateEvent, is AgentCall.MediaControl, is AgentCall.Navigate ->
                of(ActionKind.SETTINGS_DATA)
            is AgentCall.ShareMedia -> of(ActionKind.SHARE_MEDIA).copy(receivingPackage = receivingPackage, receivingAppLabel = receivingAppLabel)
            is AgentCall.ComposeSms -> of(ActionKind.COMPOSE_SMS, text = call.text).copy(receivingPackage = receivingPackage, receivingAppLabel = receivingAppLabel)
            is AgentCall.AskUser, is AgentCall.Say, is AgentCall.Finish, is AgentCall.Fail -> of(ActionKind.DIALOGUE)
            is AgentCall.Remember, is AgentCall.Forget -> of(ActionKind.MEMORY)
        }
    }

    /**
     * The screen action of [call], or null for a call that is none (the data, dialogue and memory tools, `open_*`, `wait`
     * and `look_closer`, which the loop runs itself). [text] replaces `type_text`'s text: the revealed text after the
     * owner's yes. An OCR line is tapped at its centre. A `scroll` without a target scrolls the largest scrollable
     * element of the observation, or the screen when there is none.
     */
    fun screenAction(call: AgentCall, table: ObservationTable, text: String? = null, press: Press): ScreenAction? = when (call) {
        is AgentCall.Tap -> table.entry(call.target)?.let { entry ->
            if (entry.ocr || entry.key == null) ScreenAction.TapAt(entry.bounds.centerX, entry.bounds.centerY) else ScreenAction.Tap(entry.key, entry.expect, press)
        }
        is AgentCall.LongPress -> table.entry(call.target)?.let { entry -> entry.key?.let { ScreenAction.LongPress(it, entry.expect, press) } }
        is AgentCall.TypeText -> table.entry(call.target)?.let { entry -> entry.key?.let { ScreenAction.SetText(it, entry.expect, text ?: call.text) } }
        is AgentCall.Scroll -> {
            val entry = call.target?.let(table::entry) ?: largestScrollable(table)
            ScreenAction.Scroll(entry?.key, call.direction, entry?.expect)
        }
        is AgentCall.Swipe -> {
            val entry = call.target?.let(table::entry)
            ScreenAction.Swipe(entry?.key, call.direction, entry?.expect)
        }
        is AgentCall.Back -> ScreenAction.Global(GlobalKind.BACK)
        is AgentCall.Home -> ScreenAction.Global(GlobalKind.HOME)
        else -> null
    }

    /**
     * [Press.ONCE] for every action of `TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT` and above and every action after a confirmation, else
     * [Press.VERIFIED] (design D32 item 29).
     */
    fun press(category: Category, confirmed: Boolean): Press =
        if (confirmed || category >= Category.TYPING_SCREEN_TEXT) Press.ONCE else Press.VERIFIED

    /**
     * Why a `swipe` is refused, or null (design D10): up and down are free; left and right only on an element that
     * scrolls sideways itself, or across a front window without a list that scrolls up and down.
     */
    fun swipeRefusal(call: AgentCall.Swipe, table: ObservationTable, snapshot: ScreenSnapshot): String? {
        if (call.direction == Direction.UP || call.direction == Direction.DOWN) return null
        val target = call.target?.let(table::entry)
        if (target != null) return if (target.scrollable && target.scrollAxis == ScrollAxis.HORIZONTAL) null else SWIPE_REFUSAL
        val window = ScreenTree.frontWindow(snapshot) ?: return null
        val list = snapshot.elements.any { it.windowId == window.id && ScreenTree.isVerticalList(it) }
        return if (list) SWIPE_REFUSAL else null
    }

    /**
     * Runs a data tool, or returns null for a call that is none. `share_media` needs [sharePackage], the package that the
     * loop resolved from the app's name.
     */
    suspend fun runData(call: AgentCall, port: DataPort, today: LocalDate, sharePackage: String? = null): DataResult? = when (call) {
        is AgentCall.FindContact -> port.findContact(call.name)
        is AgentCall.FindMedia -> {
            val from = Dates.day(call.day, today)
            val until = call.until?.let { Dates.day(it, today) } ?: from
            if (from == null || until == null) DataResult.Failed(BAD_DATE) else port.findMedia(from, until, call.kinds)
        }
        is AgentCall.ShareMedia -> sharePackage?.let { port.shareMedia(it, call.items) } ?: DataResult.Failed("Kestrel can't share with that app.")
        is AgentCall.ListEvents -> {
            val from = Dates.day(call.from, today)
            val to = Dates.day(call.to, today)
            if (from == null || to == null) DataResult.Failed(BAD_DATE) else port.listEvents(from, to)
        }
        is AgentCall.CreateEvent -> {
            val start = Dates.dateTime(call.start)
            if (start == null) DataResult.Failed(BAD_DATE) else port.createEvent(call.title, start, call.end?.let(Dates::dateTime), call.location)
        }
        is AgentCall.SetAlarm -> port.setAlarm(call.hour, call.minute, call.label, call.days)
        is AgentCall.SetTimer -> port.setTimer(call.seconds, call.label)
        AgentCall.ListNotifications -> port.listNotifications()
        is AgentCall.ListSms -> port.listSms(call.from, call.limit)
        is AgentCall.ComposeSms -> port.composeSms(call.number, call.text)
        is AgentCall.ListCalls -> port.listCalls(call.limit)
        AgentCall.GetLocation -> port.getLocation()
        is AgentCall.MediaControl -> port.mediaControl(call.action)
        is AgentCall.Navigate -> port.navigate(call.app, call.to, call.mode)
        else -> null
    }

    private const val BAD_DATE = "The date is not valid."

    private fun largestScrollable(table: ObservationTable): TableEntry? =
        table.entries.filter { it.scrollable && !it.ocr }.maxByOrNull { it.bounds.width.toLong() * it.bounds.height }
}
```

Create `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/StepResult.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ScreenText
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.TableEntry
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.Tools
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenElement
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSignature
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTitle
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree

/** What a step did, computed by code (design D6 of sub-project 5); [words] is its form in the result line. */
sealed interface Outcome {
    val words: String

    /** The form in the `Last:` line, which leaves out another screen's title. */
    val short: String get() = words

    /** [title] is the new observation's title, already redacted, which the loop fills in; it is quoted here. */
    data class AnotherScreen(val title: String?) : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "another screen" + (title?.let { ": " + ScreenText.quote(it, StepResult.LABEL_CUT) } ?: "")
        override val short: String get() = "another screen"

        override fun toString(): String = "AnotherScreen(title=${title?.length ?: 0} chars)"
    }

    data object TargetChanged : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "the target changed"
    }

    data object ChangedElsewhere : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "the screen changed elsewhere"
    }

    data object NothingChanged : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "nothing changed"
    }

    /** [reason] is Kestrel's sentence, which may quote the model's app name or an app's label; its own full stop goes. */
    data class Failed(val reason: String) : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "failed: ${reason.trimEnd('.')}"

        override fun toString(): String = "Failed(reason=${reason.length} chars)"
    }

    data object Uncertain : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "uncertain"
    }

    /** [reason] is Kestrel's sentence, which may quote the model's app name or an app's label; its own full stop goes. */
    data class Refused(val reason: String) : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "refused: ${reason.trimEnd('.')}"

        override fun toString(): String = "Refused(reason=${reason.length} chars)"
    }

    /** [what] is Kestrel's sentence with the field's text already redacted, quoted and escaped (design D14). */
    data class CheckFailed(val what: String) : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "check failed: $what"

        override fun toString(): String = "CheckFailed(what=${what.length} chars)"
    }

    data class DataOk(val count: Int) : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "ok (${items(count)})"
    }

    data object DataEmpty : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "empty"
    }

    data object PermissionRefused : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "permission refused"
    }

    data object Answered : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "answered"
    }

    data object NoAnswer : Outcome {
        override val words: String get() = "no answer"
    }

    companion object {
        fun items(count: Int): String = if (count == 1) "1 item" else "$count items"
    }
}

/**
 * D6's comparison of the snapshots before and after an action, over the app's windows only: SystemUI, the status bar,
 * the keyboard, Kestrel's own windows and the windows that [outcome]'s `hidden` names (agent-free apps and Play services,
 * which the model never sees) never change a result. Within one step a new front window is another screen, so the
 * window's ID counts here, while `Signature.sameScreen` leaves it out for routines (review 1-2 N1). The title rule leaves
 * out rule 3, which a scroll would change, and rule 4, because `Changes` knows no launcher label and a new window title
 * comes with a new window, which the ID already catches; `AnotherScreen`'s title is left for the loop to fill from the new
 * observation. The target itself is compared wherever it lies, also a Quick Settings tile in SystemUI's shade (review 3 M1).
 */
object Changes {
    private data class State(
        val text: String?,
        val description: String?,
        val stateDescription: String?,
        val checked: Boolean,
        val selected: Boolean,
        val enabled: Boolean,
        val focused: Boolean,
    )

    fun outcome(before: ScreenSnapshot, after: ScreenSnapshot, targetKey: String?, hidden: (String?) -> Boolean = { false }): Outcome {
        val beforeWindow = ScreenTree.frontWindow(before)
        val afterWindow = ScreenTree.frontWindow(after)
        if (beforeWindow?.packageName != afterWindow?.packageName || beforeWindow?.id != afterWindow?.id ||
            !ScreenSignature.of(before).sameScreen(ScreenSignature.of(after))
        ) {
            return Outcome.AnotherScreen(null)
        }
        val beforeTitle = beforeWindow?.let { ScreenTitle.of(before, it, null, withRule3 = false) }
        val afterTitle = afterWindow?.let { ScreenTitle.of(after, it, null, withRule3 = false) }
        if (beforeTitle != afterTitle) return Outcome.AnotherScreen(null)

        val old = states(before, hidden)
        val new = states(after, hidden)
        if (targetKey != null) {
            val index = before.elements.indexOfFirst { it.key == targetKey }
            if (index >= 0) {
                val afterIndex = after.elements.indexOfFirst { it.key == targetKey }
                if (afterIndex < 0 || state(before.elements[index]) != state(after.elements[afterIndex]) || subtree(before, index) != subtree(after, afterIndex)) {
                    return Outcome.TargetChanged
                }
            }
        }
        return if (old != new) Outcome.ChangedElsewhere else Outcome.NothingChanged
    }

    private fun appWindows(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, hidden: (String?) -> Boolean): Set<Int> =
        ScreenTree.appWindows(snapshot).filterNot { hidden(it.packageName) }.map { it.id }.toSet()

    private fun state(element: ScreenElement) =
        State(element.text, element.contentDescription, element.stateDescription, element.checked, element.selected, element.enabled, element.focused)

    private fun states(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, hidden: (String?) -> Boolean): Map<String, State> {
        val windows = appWindows(snapshot, hidden)
        return snapshot.elements.filter { it.windowId in windows }.associate { it.key to state(it) }
    }

    /** The descendants of element [index] with their states: rows that scrolled in, a field's new text. */
    private fun subtree(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, index: Int): Map<String, State> =
        snapshot.elements.indices.filter { index in ScreenTree.ancestors(snapshot, it) }.associate { snapshot.elements[it].key to state(snapshot.elements[it]) }
}

/**
 * One step's result (design D6): the result line that opens the tool result, the one-line summary that replaces the
 * step later, and the `Last:` line of the next observation. The target is named by the label that the observation
 * showed ([TableEntry.shownLabel], already redacted, quoted and escaped), never by its number; [appLabel] is the front
 * app's launcher label, and [detail] is a data tool's short argument text, what an `open_*` tool opened, or the direction
 * of a `scroll` or `swipe`, already redacted; both are escaped here. The texts depend only on the step's data.
 */
data class StepResult(
    val step: Int,
    val tool: String,
    val outcome: Outcome,
    val target: TableEntry? = null,
    val appLabel: String? = null,
    val detail: String? = null,
) {
    /** "Result: tapped "Send" (Button) → another screen: "Ana Petrović"." */
    fun resultLine(): String = "Result: ${action()} → ${outcome.words}."

    /** "Step 3: tapped "Send" (Button) in Viber → another screen: "Ana Petrović"."; at most 160 characters. */
    fun summary(): String {
        val app = appLabel?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && tool !in DATA_TOOLS }?.let { " in " + ScreenText.escape(ScreenText.cut(it, LABEL_CUT)) }.orEmpty()
        val result = if (outcome is Outcome.DataOk) Outcome.items(outcome.count) else outcome.words
        val line = "Step $step: ${action()}$app → $result."
        if (line.length <= SUMMARY_LIMIT) return line
        // A cut inside quoted text closes the quote, so that the next line can never read as screen text.
        val cut = safeCut(line, SUMMARY_LIMIT - 2) + "…"
        return if (openQuote(cut)) "$cut\"" else cut
    }

    /** "tapped "Send" (Button) → another screen" */
    fun lastLine(): String = "${action()} → ${outcome.short}"

    private fun action(): String {
        val verb = VERBS[tool] ?: tool
        val named = target?.let { " " + cutShown(it.shownLabel) + " (" + (if (it.ocr) "OCR" else ScreenText.shortClass(it.className)) + ")" }.orEmpty()
        // The detail can hold an app's label or the model's words, so it is escaped like screen text (review 3 M3).
        val more = detail?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { " " + ScreenText.escape(it) }.orEmpty()
        return verb + named + more
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "StepResult(step=$step, tool=$tool, outcome=${outcome::class.simpleName}, target=${target != null})"

    companion object {
        const val SUMMARY_LIMIT = 160
        const val LABEL_CUT = 40

        private val VERBS = mapOf(
            Tools.TAP to "tapped",
            Tools.LONG_PRESS to "long-pressed",
            Tools.TYPE_TEXT to "typed into",
            Tools.SCROLL to "scrolled",
            Tools.SWIPE to "swiped",
            Tools.BACK to "went back",
            Tools.HOME to "went home",
            Tools.OPEN_APP to "opened",
            Tools.OPEN_URL to "opened a link in",
            Tools.OPEN_DEEP_LINK to "opened a link in",
            Tools.OPEN_SETTINGS to "opened settings:",
            Tools.WAIT to "waited",
            Tools.LOOK_CLOSER to "looked closer",
            Tools.ASK_USER to "asked the owner",
            Tools.SAY to "said something",
        )

        private val DATA_TOOLS = setOf(
            Tools.FIND_CONTACT, Tools.FIND_MEDIA, Tools.SHARE_MEDIA, Tools.LIST_EVENTS, Tools.CREATE_EVENT, Tools.SET_ALARM, Tools.SET_TIMER,
            Tools.LIST_NOTIFICATIONS, Tools.LIST_SMS, Tools.COMPOSE_SMS, Tools.LIST_CALLS, Tools.GET_LOCATION, Tools.MEDIA_CONTROL, Tools.NAVIGATE,
        )

        /** A shown label cut at 40 characters inside its quotes, never inside an escape. */
        private fun cutShown(shown: String): String {
            val open = shown.indexOf('"')
            if (open < 0 || !shown.endsWith('"') || open == shown.length - 1) return shown
            val inner = shown.substring(open + 1, shown.length - 1)
            if (inner.length <= LABEL_CUT) return shown
            return shown.substring(0, open + 1) + safeCut(inner, LABEL_CUT).trimEnd() + "…\""
        }

        /** Whether [text] ends inside a quote: an odd number of quotes that no backslash escapes. */
        private fun openQuote(text: String): Boolean {
            var open = false
            var index = 0
            while (index < text.length) {
                when (text[index]) {
                    '\\' -> index++
                    '"' -> open = !open
                }
                index++
            }
            return open
        }

        /** The first [limit] characters, without a lone backslash or half a surrogate pair at the end. */
        private fun safeCut(text: String, limit: Int): String {
            var end = limit.coerceAtMost(text.length)
            if (end > 0 && Character.isHighSurrogate(text[end - 1])) end--
            var slashes = 0
            while (end - slashes > 0 && text[end - slashes - 1] == '\\') slashes++
            if (slashes % 2 == 1) end--
            return text.substring(0, end)
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 8: The conversation, its single rewrite and redaction exactly once

**Files:**
- Create: `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/Redacted.kt`, `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/Conversation.kt`, `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/DataResultText.kt`
- Create (test fixture): `core/agent/src/testFixtures/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/testing/ScreenBuilder.kt`
- Test: `core/agent/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/ConversationTest.kt`, `core/agent/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/DataResultTextTest.kt`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 2's `ChatRequest` (with `context` and `cacheAfter`), `ChatRequests.check`, `ChatMessage`, `AssistantPart`, `Part`, `ReasoningState`, `ToolChoice`, `ReasoningLevel`, `ToolSpec` and `RequestMeta`; Task 4's `Redactor` and `Vault`; Task 5's `AgentFreeApps`; Task 6's `Observation` (`text`, `table`, `earlier()`, `firstScreen()`), `ObservationBuilder`, `ObservationInput`, `ScreenText` (`quote`, `tokens`, `VALUE_LIMIT`), `DataResult`, `DataLine` and `DataField`; Task 7's `Tools.ALL`, `StepResult` and `Outcome`.
- Produces (package `dev.kestrel.agent.loop`): `class Redacted` with `text` and `companion object { fun of(redactor: Redactor, text: String, neighbours: List<String> = emptyList()): Redacted; fun kestrel(text: String): Redacted }`; `data class ResultText(callId: String, name: String, text: Redacted, failed: Boolean = false)`; `class Step(number: Int, reply: ChatMessage.Assistant, results: List<ResultText>, observedCall: String? = null, observation: Observation? = null, data: Redacted? = null, summary: Redacted? = null, screenshot: Part.Image? = null, reprompt: Redacted? = null)`; `class Conversation(system: String, tools: List<ToolSpec>, context: Redacted?, task: Redacted, first: Observation, taskId: String, signedThinking: Boolean = false, budget: Int? = null, cacheKey: String? = CACHE_KEY)` with `add(step: Step)`, `addObservation(number: Int, note: Redacted, observation: Observation)`, `growOnly()`, `val growsOnly: Boolean`, `val newestObservation: Observation`, `request(toolChoice: ToolChoice, reasoning: ReasoningLevel?, step: Int): ChatRequest?` and `companion object { MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 4_096; CACHE_KEY = "kestrel-agent"; OLLAMA_BUDGET = 32_768; fun budget(localOllama: Boolean, window: Int?): Int? }`. Package `dev.kestrel.agent`: `object DataResultText { const val NO_ITEMS = "No items."; fun of(result: DataResult.Ok, redactor: Redactor): Redacted }`. Test fixtures (package `dev.kestrel.agent.testing`): `class ScreenBuilder(packageName: String, windowTitle: String? = null, windowId: Int = 1)` with `text`, `button`, `icon`, `field`, `switch`, `list`, `row`, `group`, `image`, `build()` and `companion object { WIDTH, HEIGHT, ROW; fun screen(packageName, windowTitle, build): ScreenSnapshot }`. Tasks 10 to 14 build every request through `Conversation`.

Design D3 and D5, and D32 items 8, 9, 10, 13 and 34. `Conversation` keeps one task's messages: the task message, the first observation in a user message of its own, and one `Step` per model reply (its assistant message exactly as it came, one `ToolResult` per call, and below the executed call's result line the new observation or a data tool's lines). Only the two newest observations stay in full: when a third arrives, the second-newest is relabelled once with `Observation.earlier()`, and every older step shrinks once to its one-line summary, its screenshot to "(The screenshot of step N was here.)". Everything before the step that holds the second-newest observation is the stable region, which never changes again, and `cacheAfter` names its last message. Steps are only ever removed whole (D32 item 8). For a model with Claude's signed thinking outside Copilot (`signedThinking`), the `Reasoning` parts of Anthropic's and Bedrock's style are removed from the stable region's assistant messages at the moment of the shrink, and `growOnly()` stops every later shrink and relabelling, for the fallback after a 400, because newer Claude models also refuse signed thinking after an earlier tool result changed (D32 item 9; review 4 m2). A local Ollama model's `budget` (`budget(localOllama, window)`: the window, at most 32,768 tokens) keeps each request below 90 % of it by leaving out the oldest shrunk steps whole, with one line "(N earlier steps left out.)"; when even the fixed part and the two observations do not fit, `request` returns null (D32 item 10). Every text goes in as `Redacted`, which only `Redacted.of` (one pass of the redactor, with neighbours) or `Redacted.kestrel` (Kestrel's own text, or one built from parts that were redacted already) can make, so no text is redacted twice; observations come redacted from Task 6's builder, and `DataResultText` redacts each data field with the other fields of its line as neighbours before it quotes and escapes it (review A3-I1; D32 item 13). Each request carries `RequestMeta(taskId, agentStep = step > 1)` (D32 item 34), the system prompt and the tools unchanged, `context` as its own field, `maxOutputTokens` 4,096 and the one `prompt_cache_key` `kestrel-agent` for every task, so that tasks share the cached prefix (D5). `ScreenBuilder` is a test fixture that builds one-window snapshots in code for the JVM tests of Tasks 8 to 13.
