```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.testing

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelInfo
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelPort
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.RoleModel
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.AssistantPart
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ChatMessage
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ChatRequest
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ChatResponse
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.InvalidKind
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.InvalidToolCall
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.Part
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.RequestStyle
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.StopReason
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.Usage
import dev.kestrel.providers.client.PricedResponse
import dev.kestrel.providers.cost.Cost
import dev.kestrel.providers.http.ProviderError
import dev.kestrel.providers.http.ProviderException
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.ModelRole
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.booleanOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.doubleOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.intOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.put

/**
 * A model that follows a script (design D27 and D28): the JVM tests and `:app`'s debug hook `agent-script` use it, so no
 * test and no dry run calls a provider. Each reply of [replies] is one JSON object:
 * - `{"tool": "tap", "target": {"label": "Send", "class": "Button"}, "arguments": {"reason": "…", "category": "sending"}}`:
 *   one call; a `target` names an element of the newest observation by its label (and optionally a part of its class),
 *   which the script resolves to the element's number, so that scripts survive changes of numbering; it may also be a
 *   number, and a `target` inside the arguments (`finish`'s evidence) is resolved the same way;
 * - `{"calls": [ {…}, {…} ]}`: several calls in one reply;
 * - `{"text": "…"}`: text without a call;
 * - `{"invalid": "UNKNOWN_TOOL"}`: a call that the adapter could not use (an `InvalidKind`);
 * - `{"stop": "MAX_TOKENS", …}` or `"FILTERED"` with or without calls: a cut reply;
 * - `{"error": "Timeout"}`, `{"error": "BadRequest", "toolChoice": true}`, `{"error": "ServerError", "status": 503}`,
 *   `{"error": "RateLimited"}`, `{"error": "Unreachable"}`, `{"error": "Malformed"}`, `{"error": "QuotaOrPolicy"}`:
 *   the call throws that provider error.
 * Any reply may carry `"credits": 0.5` (the default is 0.1). When the script is used up, the model fails the task with
 * "The script has no more replies." toString prints only counts.
 */
class ScriptedModel(
    replies: List<JsonObject>,
    override val model: ModelInfo = INFO,
) : ModelPort {
    private val script = ArrayDeque(replies)
    private val recorded = mutableListOf<Pair<ModelRole, ChatRequest>>()

    val requests: List<ChatRequest> get() = recorded.map { it.second }
    val roles: List<ModelRole> get() = recorded.map { it.first }
    val left: Int get() = script.size

    override suspend fun call(role: ModelRole, request: ChatRequest, step: Int): PricedResponse {
        recorded += role to request
        val reply = script.removeFirstOrNull() ?: buildJsonObject {
            put("tool", "fail")
            put("arguments", buildJsonObject { put("reason", "The script has no more replies.") })
        }
        reply["error"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull?.let { throw ProviderException(error(it, reply)) }
        val credits = reply["credits"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull ?: DEFAULT_CREDITS
        val parts = mutableListOf<AssistantPart>()
        reply["text"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull?.let { parts += AssistantPart.Text(it) }
        val calls = (reply["calls"] as? JsonArray)?.map { it.jsonObject } ?: listOfNotNull(reply.takeIf { "tool" in it })
        calls.forEachIndexed { index, call -> parts += call(call, request, "call-${recorded.size}-${index + 1}") }
        val invalid = reply["invalid"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull?.let { InvalidToolCall(InvalidKind.valueOf(it), "scripted") }
        val stop = reply["stop"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull?.let { StopReason.valueOf(it) }
            ?: if (parts.any { it is AssistantPart.ToolCall }) StopReason.TOOL_CALL else StopReason.END
        val id = if (role == ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT) model.lightweight.id else model.versatile.id
        val response = ChatResponse(ChatMessage.Assistant(parts), stop, Usage(input = 1_000, output = 50, cacheRead = 500), id, invalid)
        return PricedResponse(response, Cost(credits / 100, credits, estimated = false, priceKnown = true, planUsage = false), RequestStyle.CHAT_COMPLETIONS)
    }

    private fun call(call: JsonObject, request: ChatRequest, id: String): AssistantPart.ToolCall {
        val arguments = (call["arguments"] as? JsonObject)?.toMutableMap() ?: mutableMapOf()
        call["target"]?.let { arguments["target"] = it }
        return AssistantPart.ToolCall(id, call["tool"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content, resolveAll(JsonObject(arguments), request) as JsonObject)
    }

    // Every "target" that names an element by its label, also inside finish's evidence, becomes the element's number.
    private fun resolveAll(element: JsonElement, request: ChatRequest): JsonElement = when (element) {
        is JsonObject -> JsonObject(element.mapValues { (key, value) ->
            if (key == "target" && value is JsonObject) JsonPrimitive(resolve(value, request)) else resolveAll(value, request)
        })
        is JsonArray -> JsonArray(element.map { resolveAll(it, request) })
        else -> element
    }

    /** The number of the newest observation's element whose label is the target's `label` and whose class holds `class`. */
    private fun resolve(target: JsonObject, request: ChatRequest): Int {
        val label = target["label"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content
        val className = target["class"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
        for (text in texts(request).asReversed()) {
            val lines = LINE.findAll(text).toList()
            if (lines.isEmpty()) continue
            val line = lines.firstOrNull { match ->
                unescape(match.groupValues[3]) == label && (className == null || match.groupValues[2].contains(className, ignoreCase = true))
            } ?: throw IllegalStateException("The newest observation has no element for the script's target")
            return line.groupValues[1].toInt()
        }
        throw IllegalStateException("The request has no observation")
    }

    private fun texts(request: ChatRequest): List<String> = request.messages.mapNotNull { message ->
        when (message) {
            is ChatMessage.ToolResult -> message.text
            is ChatMessage.User -> message.parts.filterIsInstance<Part.Text>().joinToString("\n") { it.text }
            is ChatMessage.Assistant -> null
        }
    }

    private fun error(name: String, reply: JsonObject): ProviderError {
        val status = reply["status"]?.jsonPrimitive?.intOrNull
        return when (name) {
            "Timeout" -> ProviderError.Timeout
            "Unreachable" -> ProviderError.Unreachable
            "Malformed" -> ProviderError.Malformed
            "Unauthorized" -> ProviderError.Unauthorized
            "NotAllowed" -> ProviderError.NotAllowed
            "RateLimited" -> ProviderError.RateLimited(null)
            "ServerError" -> ProviderError.ServerError(status ?: 500)
            "QuotaOrPolicy" -> ProviderError.QuotaOrPolicy(status ?: 402)
            "BadRequest" -> ProviderError.BadRequest(status ?: 400, null, reply["toolChoice"]?.jsonPrimitive?.booleanOrNull ?: false)
            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Unknown error in the script")
        }
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "ScriptedModel(left=${script.size}, calls=${recorded.size})"

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_CREDITS = 0.1
        private val LINE = Regex("""(?m)^\[(\d+)]\*?\s+(\S+)\s+(?:hint |id |password |OCR )?"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"""")

        val INFO = ModelInfo(
            providerName = "Scripted",
            providerId = "scripted",
            countsCredits = true,
            localOllama = false,
            lightweight = RoleModel("Scripted light", "scripted-light", RequestStyle.CHAT_COMPLETIONS, 128_000, takesImages = false, signedThinking = false),
            versatile = RoleModel("Scripted versatile", "scripted-versatile", RequestStyle.CHAT_COMPLETIONS, 128_000, takesImages = true, signedThinking = false),
        )

        /** A script in its JSON form: `{"replies": [ … ]}`. */
        fun fromJson(text: String, model: ModelInfo = INFO): ScriptedModel =
            ScriptedModel(Json.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject["replies"]!!.jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }, model)

        /** One reply with one call, for the Kotlin tests. */
        fun call(tool: String, label: String? = null, className: String? = null, credits: Double? = null, vararg arguments: Pair<String, Any?>): JsonObject =
            buildJsonObject {
                put("tool", tool)
                if (label != null) put("target", buildJsonObject { put("label", label); if (className != null) put("class", className) })
                put("arguments", JsonObject(arguments.associate { (key, value) -> key to json(value) }))
                if (credits != null) put("credits", credits)
            }

        fun json(value: Any?): JsonElement = when (value) {
            null -> kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonNull
            is JsonElement -> value
            is String -> JsonPrimitive(value)
            is Number -> JsonPrimitive(value)
            is Boolean -> JsonPrimitive(value)
            is List<*> -> JsonArray(value.map(::json))
            is Map<*, *> -> JsonObject(value.entries.associate { (key, item) -> key.toString() to json(item) })
            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Not a JSON value")
        }

        private fun unescape(text: String): String = text.replace("\\\"", "\"").replace("\\\\", "\\")
    }
}
```

```kotlin
/**
 * A screen that the tests script (design D27): it starts at one snapshot and moves to another when an action matches one
 * of its rules; a `SetText` without a rule writes the text into its field. It records every action. A null snapshot is a
 * service that is not connected.
 */
class FakeScreen(first: ScreenSnapshot?) : ScreenPort {
    private class Rule(val matches: (ScreenAction, ScreenSnapshot) -> Boolean, val next: (ScreenSnapshot) -> ScreenSnapshot?)

    private val rules = mutableListOf<Rule>()
    var current: ScreenSnapshot? = first
    val actions = mutableListOf<ScreenAction>()
    val badges = mutableListOf<List<Badge>>()
    var resolver: (IntentSpec) -> String? = { it.packageName }
    var outcome: (ScreenAction) -> ActionOutcome = { ActionOutcome(done = true, method = "fake") }

    /** After an action that [matches] on the current screen, the screen becomes what [next] makes of it. */
    fun on(matches: (ScreenAction, ScreenSnapshot) -> Boolean, next: (ScreenSnapshot) -> ScreenSnapshot?) {
        rules += Rule(matches, next)
    }

    /** A tap or long press on the element labelled [label] shows [next]. */
    fun onTap(label: String, next: ScreenSnapshot) = on({ action, screen ->
        val key = (action as? ScreenAction.Tap)?.key ?: (action as? ScreenAction.LongPress)?.key
        key != null && screen.element(key)?.label == label
    }) { next }

    /** Opening anything (an app, a link, an intent) shows [next]. */
    fun onOpen(next: ScreenSnapshot) = on({ action, _ ->
        action is ScreenAction.OpenApp || action is ScreenAction.OpenUri || action is ScreenAction.OpenIntent
    }) { next }

    override suspend fun snapshot(): ScreenSnapshot? = current

    override suspend fun act(action: ScreenAction): ActionOutcome {
        actions += action
        val result = outcome(action)
        if (!result.done) return result
        val screen = current ?: return result
        val rule = rules.firstOrNull { it.matches(action, screen) }
        current = when {
            rule != null -> rule.next(screen)
            action is ScreenAction.SetText -> typed(screen, action.key, action.text)
            else -> screen
        }
        return result
    }

    override suspend fun resolve(intent: IntentSpec): String? = resolver(intent)

    override suspend fun showBadges(badges: List<Badge>) {
        this.badges += badges
    }

    override suspend fun hideBadges() = Unit

    override suspend fun waitForFront(packageName: String?, millis: Long, before: String?): Boolean = true

    override fun toString(): String = "FakeScreen(actions=${actions.size})"

    companion object {
        /** [screen] with [text] in the field with [key], as Android shows a typed field. */
        fun typed(screen: ScreenSnapshot, key: String, text: String): ScreenSnapshot = screen.copy(
            elements = screen.elements.map { if (it.key == key) it.copy(text = text, label = text.ifEmpty { it.hint }) else it },
        )
    }
}

/** The owner as the tests script him (design D27): queues of answers, and records of what Kestrel said and asked. */
class FakeOwner : OwnerPort {
    val answers = ArrayDeque<Answer>()
    val confirms = ArrayDeque<ConfirmEnd>()
    val handOverEnds = ArrayDeque<HandOverEnd>()
    val permissionEnds = ArrayDeque<PermissionEnd>()
    val gates = ArrayDeque<Gate>()
    val said = mutableListOf<String>()
    val asked = mutableListOf<Pair<String, AnswerKind>>()
    val confirmations = mutableListOf<Confirmation>()
    val handOvers = mutableListOf<HandOver>()
    val permissions = mutableListOf<List<String>>()

    /** Runs when a confirmation is asked, before its answer: a test may cancel the task's job here (a touch). */
    var onConfirm: suspend (Confirmation) -> Unit = {}

    /** Runs after Kestrel spoke: a test may change the screen here. */
    var onSay: suspend (String) -> Unit = {}

    /** Runs when a question is asked, before its answer: a test may change the screen here. */
    var onAsk: suspend (String) -> Unit = {}

    override suspend fun say(text: String) {
        said += text
        onSay(text)
    }

    override suspend fun ask(question: String, kind: AnswerKind): Answer {
        asked += question to kind
        onAsk(question)
        return answers.removeFirstOrNull() ?: Answer.Silence
    }

    override suspend fun confirm(confirmation: Confirmation): ConfirmEnd {
        confirmations += confirmation
        onConfirm(confirmation)
        return confirms.removeFirstOrNull() ?: ConfirmEnd.NO
    }

    override suspend fun handOver(handOver: HandOver): HandOverEnd {
        handOvers += handOver
        return handOverEnds.removeFirstOrNull() ?: HandOverEnd.CANCELLED
    }

    override suspend fun askPermission(permissions: List<String>, why: String): PermissionEnd {
        this.permissions += permissions
        return permissionEnds.removeFirstOrNull() ?: PermissionEnd.REFUSED
    }

    override suspend fun gate(): Gate = gates.removeFirstOrNull() ?: Gate.GO

    override fun toString(): String = "FakeOwner(asked=${asked.size}, confirmations=${confirmations.size})"
}

/** The data tools as the tests script them: one answer per tool, the next answer first when a queue holds one. */
class FakeData : DataPort {
    val results = mutableMapOf<String, ArrayDeque<DataResult>>()
    val calls = mutableListOf<String>()

    /** The name that `find_contact` and the place that `navigate` got, in order. */
    val names = mutableListOf<String>()
    var forgotten = false

    /** Runs on every call, before its answer: a test may change the screen here, as an intent would. */
    var onCall: (String) -> Unit = {}

    fun answer(tool: String, vararg results: DataResult) {
        this.results.getOrPut(tool) { ArrayDeque() } += results
    }

    private fun next(tool: String): DataResult {
        calls += tool
        onCall(tool)
        val queue = results[tool] ?: return DataResult.Failed("the test gave no answer")
        return if (queue.size > 1) queue.removeFirst() else queue.firstOrNull() ?: DataResult.Failed("the test gave no answer")
    }

    override suspend fun findContact(name: String) = next("find_contact").also { names += name }
    override suspend fun findMedia(from: LocalDate, until: LocalDate, kinds: MediaKinds) = next("find_media")
    override suspend fun shareMedia(packageName: String, items: List<String>) = next("share_media")
    override suspend fun listEvents(from: LocalDate, to: LocalDate) = next("list_events")
    override suspend fun createEvent(title: String, start: LocalDateTime, end: LocalDateTime?, location: String?) = next("create_event")
    override suspend fun setAlarm(hour: Int, minute: Int, label: String?, days: List<DayOfWeek>) = next("set_alarm")
    override suspend fun setTimer(seconds: Int, label: String?) = next("set_timer")
    override suspend fun listNotifications() = next("list_notifications")
    override suspend fun listSms(from: String?, limit: Int) = next("list_sms")
    override suspend fun composeSms(number: String, text: String) = next("compose_sms")
    override suspend fun listCalls(limit: Int) = next("list_calls")
    override suspend fun getLocation() = next("get_location")
    override suspend fun mediaControl(action: MediaAction) = next("media_control")
    override suspend fun navigate(app: NavigationApp, to: String, mode: TravelMode?) = next("navigate").also { names += to }

    override fun forgetTask() {
        forgotten = true
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "FakeData(calls=${calls.size})"
}

class FakeApps(val apps: List<LauncherApp> = DEFAULT) : AppsPort {
    override suspend fun launcherApps(): List<LauncherApp> = apps

    override suspend fun label(packageName: String): String? = apps.firstOrNull { it.packageName == packageName }?.label

    override fun toString(): String = "FakeApps(${apps.size})"

    companion object {
        val DEFAULT = listOf(
            LauncherApp("Viber", "com.viber.voip", "26.1"),
            LauncherApp("Telegram", "org.telegram.messenger", "12.2"),
            LauncherApp("Gmail", "com.google.android.gm", "2026.11"),
            LauncherApp("Settings", "com.android.settings", "17"),
            LauncherApp("Waze", "com.waze", "5.12"),
            LauncherApp("Firefox", "org.mozilla.firefox", "160.0"),
            LauncherApp("Kestrel fixtures", "dev.kestrel.testapp", "1.0"),
            LauncherApp("Kestrel", "dev.kestrel", "0.5"),
        )
    }
}

class FakeMemory : MemoryStore {
    val facts = mutableListOf<Fact>()
    val approvals = mutableSetOf<Pair<String, String>>()

    override suspend fun facts(): List<Fact> = facts.toList()

    override suspend fun saveFact(fact: Fact) {
        facts.removeAll { it.key == fact.key }
        facts += fact
    }

    override suspend fun deleteFact(key: String): Boolean = facts.removeAll { it.key == key }

    override suspend fun screenshotApproved(packageName: String, providerId: String): Boolean = (packageName to providerId) in approvals

    override suspend fun approveScreenshots(packageName: String, providerId: String) {
        approvals += packageName to providerId
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "FakeMemory(facts=${facts.size})"
}

class FakeLog : TaskLog {
    val entries = mutableListOf<Pair<TaskLog.Kind, String>>()

    override suspend fun write(kind: TaskLog.Kind, text: String) {
        entries += kind to text
    }

    fun texts(kind: TaskLog.Kind): List<String> = entries.filter { it.first == kind }.map { it.second }

    override fun toString(): String = "FakeLog(${entries.size})"
}

/** Kestrel's clock in the tests: the time moves only when a test moves it, or by [step] on every reading. */
class FakeClock(var step: Long = 0) : AgentClock {
    var elapsed = 0L
    var time: ZonedDateTime = ZonedDateTime.of(2026, 11, 20, 10, 20, 0, 0, ZoneId.of("Europe/Belgrade"))

    override fun elapsedMillis(): Long = elapsed.also { elapsed += step }

    override fun now(): ZonedDateTime = time

    override fun toString(): String = "FakeClock(elapsed=$elapsed)"
}

/** Kestrel's eyes in the tests: a capture of [width] × [height], the given OCR lines, and a fixed JPEG. */
class FakeEyes(var lines: List<OcrLine>? = emptyList(), var capture: Capture? = null) : EyesPort {
    var closed = 0
    val encoded = mutableListOf<Pair<List<IntRect>, List<Badge>>>()

    override suspend fun capture(): Capture = capture ?: Capture.Captured(
        image = object : Capture.Image {
            override val width = 1080
            override val height = 2400

            override fun close() {
                closed++
            }
        },
        originX = 0,
        originY = 0,
        appPixels = listOf(IntRect(0, 0, 1080, 2400)),
        blocked = emptyList(),
    )

    override suspend fun read(capture: Capture.Captured, regions: List<IntRect>, exclude: List<IntRect>): List<OcrLine>? = lines

    override suspend fun encode(capture: Capture.Captured, masks: List<IntRect>, marks: List<Badge>): Part.Image {
        encoded += masks to marks
        return Part.Image(ImageType.JPEG, byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3))
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "FakeEyes"
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelInfo
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeApps
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeClock
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeData
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeEyes
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeLog
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeMemory
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeOwner
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeScreen
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.ScriptedModel
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ChatMessage
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.Part
import dev.kestrel.safety.SafetySettings
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject

/**
 * One agent with fakes for every port, for the JVM tests (design D27). Test mode is off unless a test turns it on, so that
 * the tests judge Standard mode's decisions; the tests of test mode set it.
 */
class Harness(
    first: ScreenSnapshot?,
    replies: List<JsonObject>,
    var settings: AgentSettings = AgentSettings(safety = SafetySettings(testMode = false)),
    model: ModelInfo = ScriptedModel.INFO,
) {
    val screen = FakeScreen(first)
    val owner = FakeOwner()
    val data = FakeData()
    val apps = FakeApps()
    val memory = FakeMemory()
    val log = FakeLog()
    val clock = FakeClock()
    val eyes = FakeEyes()
    val model = ScriptedModel(replies, model)
    val reports = mutableListOf<TaskReport>()

    val agent: Agent get() = Agent(AgentPorts(screen, eyes, data, owner, model, apps, memory, log, clock), settings)

    /** Runs [text] as a task to its end and returns its one report. */
    suspend fun run(text: String, knownNames: Set<String> = emptySet()): TaskReport {
        agent.run(TaskRequest("task-1-0a1b2c3d", text, knownNames)) { reports += it }
        return reports.single()
    }

    /** Every text that went to the model in the newest request: the context and the messages' texts. */
    fun lastRequestText(): String = model.requests.last().let { request ->
        (listOf(request.context.orEmpty()) + request.messages.mapNotNull { message ->
            when (message) {
                is ChatMessage.ToolResult -> message.text
                is ChatMessage.User -> message.parts.filterIsInstance<Part.Text>().joinToString("\n") { it.text }
                is ChatMessage.Assistant -> null
            }
        }).joinToString("\n")
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "Harness"
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.ScreenBuilder
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot

/**
 * The fixture messenger's screens as the JVM tests build them (design D27 and D28): `:testapp`'s messenger runs as
 * `dev.kestrel.testapp`, whose chat header has the view ID `chat_title` (`ScreenTitles`' rule for `:testapp`).
 */
object Screens {
    const val MESSENGER = "dev.kestrel.testapp"
    const val MAIL = "com.google.android.gm"

    fun chats(vararg names: String = arrayOf("Ana Petrović", "Marko Marković")): ScreenSnapshot = ScreenBuilder.screen(MESSENGER, "Kestrel fixtures") {
        text("Chats", 100, viewId = "chat_title")
        val list = list("Chats", 300, 2200, viewId = "chat_list")
        names.forEachIndexed { index, name -> row(name, 320 + index * 140, list, viewId = "chat_row") }
    }

    fun chat(name: String, vararg messages: String, typed: String = "", call: Boolean = false): ScreenSnapshot =
        ScreenBuilder.screen(MESSENGER, "Kestrel fixtures") {
            icon("Navigate up", 100, viewId = "up")
            text(name, 100, viewId = "chat_title")
            if (call) button("Call", 100, viewId = "call", left = 900)
            val list = list("Messages", 300, 2000, viewId = "messages")
            messages.forEachIndexed { index, message -> text(message, 320 + index * 130, viewId = "bubble", parent = list) }
            field("Type a message…", typed, 2100, viewId = "compose")
            button("Send", 2250, viewId = "send", left = 900)
        }

    /** An e-mail being written; [copies] shows Cc and Bcc, else they are collapsed behind "Show Cc/Bcc". */
    fun email(copies: Boolean): ScreenSnapshot = ScreenBuilder.screen(MAIL, "Gmail") {
        icon("Send", 100, viewId = "send", left = 900, right = 1040)
        field("To", "ana@example.com", 300, viewId = "to")
        if (copies) {
            field("Cc", "boss@example.com", 420, viewId = "cc")
            field("Bcc", "", 540, viewId = "bcc")
        } else {
            icon("Show Cc/Bcc", 300, viewId = "add_cc_bcc", left = 900, right = 1040)
        }
        field("Subject", "Late", 700, viewId = "subject")
        field("Compose email", "I'm late", 850, viewId = "body")
    }

    fun settingsPage(title: String, switch: String, checked: Boolean): ScreenSnapshot = ScreenBuilder.screen("com.android.settings", "Settings") {
        text(title, 100, viewId = "action_bar_title")
        switch(switch, checked, 400, viewId = "switch_widget")
    }

    fun app(packageName: String, vararg texts: String): ScreenSnapshot = ScreenBuilder.screen(packageName) {
        texts.forEachIndexed { index, text -> text(text, 300 + index * 130) }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.loop.ScreenSteps
import dev.kestrel.agent.loop.TaskRun
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Answer
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ConfirmEnd

import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ChatMessage
import dev.kestrel.safety.AgentFreeApps
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOverKind
import dev.kestrel.safety.SafetySettings
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class AgentTest {
    private fun finish(summary: String, vararg evidence: String) =
        call("finish", null, null, null, "summary" to summary, "evidence" to evidence.map { mapOf("target" to mapOf("label" to it)) })

    private fun sendSteps() = listOf(
        call("type_text", "Type a message…", null, null, "text" to "I'm late", "reason" to "write it", "category" to "typing_request"),
        call("tap", "Send", "Button", null, "reason" to "send it", "category" to "sending"),
        finish("Sent.", "I'm late"),
    )

    private fun sendHarness(confirm: ConfirmEnd): Harness = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi"), sendSteps()).apply {
        screen.onTap("Send", Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi", "I'm late"))
        owner.confirms += confirm
    }

    @Test
    fun aTaskRunsItsStepsAndFinishesWithItsEvidence() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chats(), listOf(
            call("tap", "Ana Petrović", null, null, "reason" to "open the chat", "category" to "reading"),
            finish("Ana wrote: See you tomorrow!", "See you tomorrow!"),
        ))
        harness.screen.onTap("Ana Petrović", Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "See you tomorrow!"))

        val report = harness.run("Read Ana's last message")

        assertEquals(EndReason.FINISHED, report.end)
        assertEquals("Ana wrote: See you tomorrow!", report.summary)
        assertEquals(2, report.steps)
        assertEquals(listOf("opened \"Ana Petrović\""), report.ledger)
        assertEquals(1, harness.reports.size)
        assertEquals(listOf(TaskLog.Kind.START, TaskLog.Kind.PROMPT, TaskLog.Kind.REPLY, TaskLog.Kind.SAFETY, TaskLog.Kind.ACTION),
            harness.log.entries.map { it.first }.take(5))
        assertEquals(TaskLog.Kind.END, harness.log.entries.last().first)
        assertTrue(harness.data.forgotten)
    }

    @Test
    fun aSendIsConfirmedAndPressedOnceAfterTheScreenIsReadAgain() = runTest {
        val harness = sendHarness(ConfirmEnd.YES)

        val report = harness.run("Send Ana a message that I'm late")

        assertEquals(EndReason.FINISHED, report.end)
        assertEquals(1, harness.owner.confirmations.size)
        assertEquals(listOf("Ana Petrović"), harness.owner.confirmations.single().recipients)
        val taps = harness.screen.actions.filterIsInstance<ScreenAction.Tap>()
        assertEquals(1, taps.size)
        assertEquals(Press.ONCE, taps.single().press)
        assertEquals(listOf("Sent to Ana Petrović on Kestrel fixtures."), report.sends)
        assertEquals(1, report.confirmed)
        assertEquals(0, report.unconfirmed)
        assertEquals(0, report.beforeTestMode)
    }

    @Test
    fun anEmailsCollapsedCopiesAreOpenedBeforeTheQuestion() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.email(copies = false), listOf(call("tap", "Send", null, null, "reason" to "send it", "category" to "sending")))
        harness.screen.onTap("Show Cc/Bcc", Screens.email(copies = true))
        harness.owner.confirms += ConfirmEnd.NO

        val report = harness.run("Email Ana that I'm late")

        assertEquals(EndReason.DECLINED, report.end)
        val confirmation = harness.owner.confirmations.single()
        assertEquals(listOf("ana@example.com", "boss@example.com"), confirmation.recipients)
        assertTrue(confirmation.question, "as a copy, boss@example.com" in confirmation.question)
        assertEquals(listOf("Show Cc/Bcc"), harness.screen.actions.map { (it as ScreenAction.Tap).expect.label })
    }

    @Test
    fun onlyACcExpanderOfAnEmailAppIsTappedAndOnlyAfterTheSafetyCheck() = runTest {
        val hostile = ScreenBuilder.screen(Screens.MAIL, "Gmail") {
            icon("Send", 100, viewId = "send", left = 900, right = 1040)
            field("To", "ana@example.com", 300, viewId = "to")
            button("CC: Buy the premium plan", 420, viewId = "upsell")
            field("Subject", "Late", 700, viewId = "subject")
            field("Compose email", "I'm late", 850, viewId = "body")
        }
        val harness = Harness(hostile, listOf(call("tap", "Send", null, null, "reason" to "send it", "category" to "sending")))
        harness.owner.confirms += ConfirmEnd.NO

        assertEquals(EndReason.DECLINED, harness.run("Email Ana that I'm late").end)
        assertTrue(harness.screen.actions.isEmpty())

        val gmail = Harness(Screens.email(copies = false), listOf(call("tap", "Send", null, null, "reason" to "send it", "category" to "sending")))
        gmail.screen.onTap("Show Cc/Bcc", Screens.email(copies = true))
        gmail.owner.confirms += ConfirmEnd.NO
        gmail.run("Email Ana that I'm late")
        assertTrue(gmail.log.texts(TaskLog.Kind.SAFETY).any { it.startsWith("tap: category=reading") })
        assertTrue(gmail.log.texts(TaskLog.Kind.ACTION).any { it.startsWith("tap: opened Cc and Bcc") })
    }

    @Test
    fun aTypedVaultValueIsNamedByItsKindInTheSendQuestion() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Your verification code: 483920"), listOf(
            call("type_text", "Type a message…", null, null, "text" to "[OTP_1]", "reason" to "send her the code", "category" to "typing_screen_text"),
            call("tap", "Send", "Button", null, "reason" to "send it", "category" to "sending"),
        ))
        harness.owner.confirms += listOf(ConfirmEnd.YES, ConfirmEnd.NO)

        assertEquals(EndReason.DECLINED, harness.run("Send Ana the code").end)

        val send = harness.owner.confirmations[1]
        assertEquals("483920", harness.screen.actions.filterIsInstance<ScreenAction.SetText>().single().text)
        assertFalse(send.question, send.question.contains("483920"))
        assertFalse(send.spoken, send.spoken.contains("483920"))
        assertTrue(send.question, send.question.contains("one-time code"))
    }

    @Test
    fun aDeclinedConfirmationEndsTheTaskWithItsLedgerAndWithoutTheModelsWords() = runTest {
        val harness = sendHarness(ConfirmEnd.NO)

        val report = harness.run("Send Ana a message that I'm late")

        assertEquals(EndReason.DECLINED, report.end)
        assertNull(report.summary)
        assertTrue(report.ledger.single().startsWith("typed into"))
        assertTrue(harness.screen.actions.none { it is ScreenAction.Tap })
    }

    @Test
    fun whenTheScreenChangesAfterTheYesNothingIsPressed() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi"), sendSteps().take(2) + call("fail", null, null, null, "reason" to "The chat changed."))
        harness.owner.confirms += ConfirmEnd.YES
        harness.owner.onConfirm = { harness.screen.current = Screens.chat("Marko Marković", "Hi", typed = "I'm late") }

        val report = harness.run("Send Ana a message that I'm late")

        assertEquals(EndReason.FAILED_BY_MODEL, report.end)
        assertTrue(harness.screen.actions.none { it is ScreenAction.Tap })
        assertTrue(harness.lastRequestText().contains(ScreenSteps.CHANGED_AFTER))
        assertEquals(0, report.sends.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCallIsHandedOverAndEndsAsDoneWhenTheOwnerPlacesIt() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi", call = true), listOf(
            call("tap", "Call", null, null, "reason" to "call Ana", "category" to "reading"),
        ))
        harness.owner.handOverEnds += HandOverEnd.DONE_BY_ITSELF

        val report = harness.run("Call Ana")

        assertEquals(EndReason.FINISHED, report.end)
        assertEquals("You placed the call to Ana Petrović.", report.summary)
        assertEquals(HandOverKind.CALL, harness.owner.handOvers.single().kind)
        assertTrue(harness.screen.actions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun aHandOverThatTheOwnerFinishesIsHisStepAndOneThatExpiresEndsTheTask() = runTest {
        val continued = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi", call = true), listOf(
            call("tap", "Call", null, null, "reason" to "call Ana", "category" to "calls"),
            call("fail", null, null, null, "reason" to "Done."),
        ))
        continued.owner.handOverEnds += HandOverEnd.CONTINUED
        continued.run("Call Ana")
        assertTrue(continued.lastRequestText().contains(TaskRun.OWNER_DID_IT_RESULT))

        val expired = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi", call = true), listOf(call("tap", "Call", null, null, "reason" to "call", "category" to "calls")))
        expired.owner.handOverEnds += HandOverEnd.EXPIRED
        assertEquals(EndReason.HAND_OVER_EXPIRED, expired.run("Call Ana").end)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCancelledTaskReportsOnceWhatItHadDoneAndAPauseThatEndedSaysSo() = runTest {
        val harness = sendHarness(ConfirmEnd.YES)
        harness.owner.onConfirm = { throw TaskCancellation(EndReason.CANCELLED) }

        assertTrue(runCatching { harness.run("Send Ana a message that I'm late") }.exceptionOrNull() is TaskCancellation)
        val report = harness.reports.single()
        assertEquals(EndReason.CANCELLED, report.end)
        assertTrue(report.ledger.single().startsWith("typed into"))

        val paused = sendHarness(ConfirmEnd.YES)
        paused.owner.onConfirm = { throw TaskCancellation(EndReason.PAUSED_TOO_LONG) }
        assertTrue(runCatching { paused.run("Send Ana a message that I'm late") }.exceptionOrNull() is TaskCancellation)
        assertEquals(EndReason.PAUSED_TOO_LONG, paused.reports.single().end)
    }

    @Test
    fun aResumedTaskObservesTheScreenAgainBeforeItActs() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chats(), listOf(
            call("tap", "Ana Petrović", null, null, "reason" to "open the chat", "category" to "reading"),
            call("fail", null, null, null, "reason" to "Stop."),

        harness.owner.gates += listOf(Gate.GO, Gate.RESUMED)

        harness.run("Open Ana's chat")

        assertTrue(harness.screen.actions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(harness.lastRequestText().contains(ScreenSteps.PAUSED))
    }

    @Test
    fun testModeBlocksASendToAnotherPersonAndEndsTheTaskWithoutAQuestion() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi", typed = "I'm late"), listOf(

        val report = harness.run("Send Ana a message that I'm late")

        assertEquals(EndReason.TEST_MODE, report.end)
        assertTrue(harness.owner.confirmations.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(harness.screen.actions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(harness.model.requests.single().context.orEmpty().contains(TaskRun.TEST_MODE_NOTE))
        assertTrue(harness.log.texts(TaskLog.Kind.SAFETY).single().contains("beforeTestMode=Confirm decision=Block"))
    }

    @Test
    fun anAgentFreeAppOrKestrelInFrontEndsTheTaskBeforeAnyModelCall() = runTest {
        val kestrel = Harness(Screens.app("dev.kestrel", "Safety"), emptyList())
        assertEquals(EndReason.AGENT_FREE, kestrel.run("Turn on hotspot").end)
        assertEquals("Kestrel", kestrel.reports.single().detail)

        val bank = Harness(Screens.app("com.example.bank", "Balance"), emptyList(),
            settings = AgentSettings(safety = SafetySettings(testMode = false), agentFree = AgentFreeApps(added = setOf("com.example.bank"))))
        assertEquals(EndReason.AGENT_FREE, bank.run("Check my balance").end)

    fun theReportSpeaksAPlaceholderAsItsKindAndNoCodeReachesTheModel() = runTest {
        val screen = ScreenBuilder.screen("com.google.android.apps.messaging") {
            text("Your verification code", 400)
            text("483920", 530)
        }
        val harness = Harness(screen, listOf(call("finish", null, null, null, "summary" to "The code is [OTP_1].",
            "evidence" to listOf(mapOf("target" to mapOf("label" to "[OTP_1]"))))))

        val report = harness.run("Read me the code")

        assertEquals(EndReason.FINISHED, report.end)
        assertEquals("The code is a one-time code.", report.summary)
        val sent = harness.lastRequestText()
        assertTrue(sent.contains("20 November 2026"))
        assertFalse(sent.contains("483920"))
        assertFalse(harness.log.entries.any { it.second.contains("483920") })
    }

    @Test
    fun rememberAndForgetAskTheOwnerFirst() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chats(), listOf(
            call("remember", null, null, null, "key" to "gate code", "value" to "blue"),
            call("forget", null, null, null, "key" to "parking"),
            call("forget", null, null, null, "key" to "gate code"),
            call("fail", null, null, null, "reason" to "Stop."),
        ))
        harness.owner.answers += listOf(Answer.Yes, Answer.Yes)

        harness.run("Remember that the gate code is blue")

        assertEquals(listOf("Remember that gate code is blue?", "Forget gate code?"), harness.owner.asked.map { it.first })
        assertTrue(harness.memory.facts.isEmpty())
        val results = harness.model.requests.last().messages.filterIsInstance<ChatMessage.ToolResult>().map { it.text }
        assertTrue(results.any { it.startsWith("Step 1: remember → stored") || it.startsWith("Result: stored.") })
        assertTrue(results.any { it.contains("no such fact") })
        assertTrue(results.any { it.contains("deleted") })
    }
}
```

Create `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/memory/Fact.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.memory

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Whether a fact names something (a contact, a chat, a place, an app) or is any other fact (design D22). */
@Serializable
enum class FactKind { ALIAS, FACT }

/**
 * A fact that the owner saved (design D22; spec 11.9), such as "home = Main Street 1" or "Ana = the Telegram chat 'Saved
 * Messages'". It is stored encrypted in `SettingKey` `MEMORY_FACTS`; [created] is the time in epoch milliseconds.
 * toString prints only lengths (D25).
 */
@Serializable
data class Fact(val key: String, val value: String, val kind: FactKind = FactKind.FACT, val created: Long = 0) {
    override fun toString(): String = "Fact(keyLength=${key.length}, valueLength=${value.length}, kind=$kind)"
}
```

```kotlin
        )

    /** Where the agent never acts and no link may lead: Kestrel, the agent-free apps and Play services (D16, D32 item 12). */
    fun closed(packageName: String?): Boolean = agentFree.isAgentFree(packageName) || packageName == AgentFreeApps.PLAY_SERVICES

    override fun toString(): String =
        "AgentSettings(safety=$safety, agentFree=${agentFree.effective.size}, phonePackages=${phonePackages.size}, " +
            "selfChatAliases=${selfChatAliases.size})"
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent

import dev.kestrel.providers.http.ProviderError
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException

/** Why a task ended (design D7, D13, D16, D18, D21 and D24). `:app`'s `AgentTexts` turns it into the spoken sentence. */
enum class EndReason {
    FINISHED,
    UNVERIFIED,
    FAILED_BY_MODEL,
    CANCELLED,
    DECLINED,
    HAND_OVER_EXPIRED,
    STEPS,
    TIME,
    COST,
    STUCK,
    INVALID_CALLS,
    PROVIDER,
    NO_PROFILE,
    NO_SCREEN,
    AGENT_FREE,
    PAUSED_TOO_LONG,

    /** Test mode blocked a send, a call or `compose_sms` (D18). */
    TEST_MODE,

    /** A local Ollama model cannot hold the fixed part and two observations (D32 item 10). */
    CONTEXT_TOO_SMALL,

    /** The profile check refused the model that the task needs (D32 items 36 and 37); [TaskReport.detail] says why. */
    MODEL_UNUSABLE,

    /** An unexpected failure inside the agent; it is reported through `graph.errors` by its class (D32 item 48). */
    KESTREL_ERROR,
}

/**
 * How `:app` cancels a task's job with a reason (design D2): a touch, "stop" or a new task after "stop" give
 * [EndReason.CANCELLED], and the end of a 30-minute pause gives [EndReason.PAUSED_TOO_LONG]. Any other
 * CancellationException counts as [EndReason.CANCELLED].
 */
class TaskCancellation(val reason: EndReason) : CancellationException("The task was cancelled: $reason")

/**
 * The end of one task (design D24 and D28), which `Agent.run` hands to its caller once on every path. [summary] is the
 * model's `finish` summary or the task's last words, already in their spoken form (placeholders as their kind's words, at
 * most 600 characters); it is null after a declined confirmation. [detail] is Kestrel's own part of the sentence: the
 * agent-free app's label, a block's reason, the model's `fail` reason or the profile check's sentence. [sends] are
 * Kestrel's lines for the confirmed sends ("Sent to My Notes on Viber."), [recipients] the confirmed recipients, and the
 * counts are those that the debug hook `agent-task -Result` reports (D28). toString prints only kinds and counts (D25).
 */
data class TaskReport(
    val end: EndReason,
    val detail: String? = null,
    val summary: String? = null,
    val error: ProviderError? = null,
    val ledger: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val sends: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val recipients: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val steps: Int = 0,
    val workMillis: Long = 0,
    val credits: Double = 0.0,
    val inputTokens: Long = 0,
    val outputTokens: Long = 0,
    val cacheRead: Long = 0,
    val cacheWrite: Long = 0,
    val confirmed: Int = 0,
    val unconfirmed: Int = 0,
    val beforeTestMode: Int = 0,
    val shareItems: Int = 0,
    val modelId: String? = null,
) {
    override fun toString(): String =
        "TaskReport(end=$end, error=$error, detail=${detail?.length}, summary=${summary?.length}, ledger=${ledger.size}, " +
            "sends=${sends.size}, recipients=${recipients.size}, steps=$steps, workMillis=$workMillis, credits=$credits, " +
            "tokens=${inputTokens + outputTokens}, cacheRead=$cacheRead, confirmed=$confirmed, unconfirmed=$unconfirmed, " +
            "beforeTestMode=$beforeTestMode, shareItems=$shareItems)"
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent

/**
 * What a task did that the owner can see, in Kestrel's words, written by code from each step's data and never by the
 * model (design D24): "opened Viber", "typed the message", "sent the message", "turned on "Wi-Fi hotspot"". A cancelled,
 * declined or failed task's report names these lines (spec 14.5). The lines hold labels from the screen, which the
 * observation redacted, so toString prints only the count (D25).
 */
class Ledger {
    private val entries = mutableListOf<String>()

    val lines: List<String> get() = entries.toList()

    val isEmpty: Boolean get() = entries.isEmpty()

    fun add(line: String) {
        if (entries.lastOrNull() != line) entries += line
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "Ledger(lines=${entries.size})"
}
```

Create `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/Limits.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AgentClock

/**
 * A task's working time and credits (design D7): the time spent waiting for the owner and a paused task do not count as
 * work, and every model answer's credits add up.
 */
class Limits(private val clock: AgentClock) {
    private val started = clock.elapsedMillis()
    private var waited = 0L

    var credits = 0.0
        private set

    val workMillis: Long get() = clock.elapsedMillis() - started - waited

    /** Runs [block], a wait for the owner or a pause, whose time does not count as work. */
    suspend fun <T> waiting(block: suspend () -> T): T {
        val start = clock.elapsedMillis()
        try {
            return block()
        } finally {
            waited += clock.elapsedMillis() - start
        }
    }

    fun spent(credits: Double) {
        this.credits += credits
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "Limits(workMillis=$workMillis, credits=$credits)"
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.AgentPorts
import dev.kestrel.agent.AgentSettings
import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason
import dev.kestrel.agent.Ledger
import dev.kestrel.agent.TaskReport
import dev.kestrel.agent.TaskRequest
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.Fact
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.FactKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.Observation
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ObservationBuilder
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ObservationInput
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ScreenText
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.TableEntry
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Answer
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AnswerKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ConfirmEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Gate
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.GlobalKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.HandOverEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.OcrLine
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.RoleModel
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ScreenAction
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.TaskLog
import dev.kestrel.agent.prompt.SystemPrompt
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.AgentCall
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.Tools
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.AssistantPart
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ChatMessage
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.Part
import dev.kestrel.providers.client.PricedResponse
import dev.kestrel.providers.http.ProviderError
import dev.kestrel.providers.http.ProviderException
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.ModelRole
import dev.kestrel.safety.ActionKind
import dev.kestrel.safety.Assessment
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import dev.kestrel.safety.Confirmation
import dev.kestrel.safety.Decision
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOver
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOverKind
import dev.kestrel.safety.PlayServices
import dev.kestrel.safety.Proposal
import dev.kestrel.safety.Redactor
import dev.kestrel.safety.SafetyCheck
import dev.kestrel.safety.TaskAllowance
import dev.kestrel.safety.TaskSafety
import dev.kestrel.safety.Vault
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.Locale

/** Ends a task from anywhere in its loop with its reason; it carries no stack trace and no text of the screen. */
internal class Ended(
    val reason: EndReason,
    val detail: String? = null,
    val error: ProviderError? = null,
    val summary: String? = null,
) : Exception(null, null, false, false)

/**
 * What one executed call did (design D6): its [outcome] on its [target] (for `StepResult`), or Kestrel's own result
 * [text] with its [summary] and [last] line; the snapshot [after] it, from which the next observation is built; a data
 * tool's [data] lines; an [extra] text below the result line; a [screenshot]; the [ocr] lines that `look_closer` read; and
 * whether it made progress when the step decides that itself ([progress]).
 */
internal class Done(
    val tool: String,
    val outcome: Outcome? = null,
    val target: TableEntry? = null,
    val detail: String? = null,
    val after: ScreenSnapshot? = null,
    val data: Redacted? = null,
    val extra: Redacted? = null,
    val text: String? = null,
    val summary: String? = null,
    val last: String? = null,
    val screenshot: Part.Image? = null,
    val ocr: List<OcrLine> = emptyList(),
    val progress: Boolean? = null,
)

/** A send that the owner confirmed (design D14), kept in memory for the completion check; never logged. */
internal data class ConfirmedSend(val recipients: List<String>, val content: String?, val share: Boolean) {
    override fun toString(): String = "ConfirmedSend(recipients=${recipients.size}, content=${content?.length}, share=$share)"
}
/** What the safety check lets a step do (design D13 and D14). */
internal sealed interface Clearance {
    /** Go ahead; [confirmation] is the owner's yes when one was asked. */
    data class Go(val category: Category, val confirmation: Confirmation?) : Clearance

    /** The step ends with [done] (a refusal or a hand-over that the owner finished). */
    data class Stop(val done: Done) : Clearance

    /** A pause withdrew the question: observe again and decide again (D2). */
    data object Again : Clearance
}

/**
 * One task's run (design D1 to D7, D13 to D16, D21 and D24): the loop of observation, model call, tool-call rules, safety
 * check, action and result, with the pause gates of D2, the limits and the escalation of D7, and the report of D24.
 */
internal class TaskRun(val ports: AgentPorts, val settings: AgentSettings, val task: TaskRequest) {
    val vault = Vault()
    val redactor = Redactor(vault)
    val ledger = Ledger()
    val limits = Limits(ports.clock)
    private val builder = ObservationBuilder(redactor, settings.agentFree)
    private val choices = ToolChoices()
    private val screenSteps = ScreenSteps(this)

    var safety = TaskSafety(TaskAllowance.NONE)
    lateinit var conversation: Conversation
    lateinit var observation: Observation
    lateinit var snapshot: ScreenSnapshot
    var replies = 0
        private set

    // What the report and the completion check need.
    val sends = mutableListOf<String>()
    val recipients = mutableListOf<String>()
    val confirmedSends = mutableListOf<ConfirmedSend>()
    val lastChecked = mutableMapOf<String, Boolean>()
    var confirmed = 0
    var unconfirmed = 0
    var beforeTestMode = 0
    var shareItems = 0
    private var appStopped = false
    private var declined = false
    private var inputTokens = 0L
    private var outputTokens = 0L
    private var cacheRead = 0L
    private var cacheWrite = 0L
    private var pendingPrompt = ""

    suspend fun run(): TaskReport = try {
        start()
        while (true) turn()
        @Suppress("UNREACHABLE_CODE")
        throw IllegalStateException()
    } catch (e: Ended) {
        report(e.reason, e.detail, e.error, e.summary)
    }

    /** The report of a task that was cancelled with [reason], from what it had done so far (D24, D32 item 4). */
    fun cancelled(reason: EndReason): TaskReport = report(reason, null, null, null)

    private suspend fun start() {
        log(TaskLog.Kind.START, "request: ${redactor.redact(task.text)}")
        val first = checkFront(fresh())
        safety = TaskSafety(
            allowance = TaskAllowance.from(task.text, task.knownNames),
            ownerWords = Normalizer.words(task.text).toSet(),
        )
        observation = observe(first, last = null, targetKey = null)
        val model = ports.model.model
        conversation = Conversation(
            system = SystemPrompt.TEXT,
            tools = Tools.ALL,
            context = contextText(),
            task = taskMessage(),
            first = observation,
            taskId = task.id,
            signedThinking = model.lightweight.signedThinking || model.versatile.signedThinking,
            budget = Conversation.budget(model.localOllama, model.lightweight.contextWindow),
        )
        pendingPrompt = observation.text
    }

    // The task message (D3): the owner's words, the local date and time, and what the task may do; it never changes.
    private fun taskMessage(): Redacted {
        val now = ports.clock.now()
        val date = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("EEEE, d MMMM yyyy, HH:mm", Locale.ENGLISH).format(now)
        // Only the owner's words are redacted, so that the year is never read as a code.
        val owner = Redacted.of(redactor, "The owner's task: ${task.text}").text
        val lines = listOf(owner, "Today is $date.", safety.allowance.describe())
        return Redacted.kestrel(lines.joinToString("\n"))
    }

    // The per-task context (D3): the test-mode note; it never names the owner's agent-free apps (review B M6).
    private fun contextText(): Redacted? = TEST_MODE_NOTE.takeIf { settings.safety.testMode }?.let { Redacted.of(redactor, it) }

    private suspend fun turn() {
        if (gate()) resumed()
        val priced = callModel()
        replies++
        account(priced)
        val message = priced.response.message
        when (val reply = ToolCalls.read(priced.response, observation.table, vault)) {
            is Reply.Invalid -> {
                conversation.add(Step(replies, message, reply.results, reprompt = reply.reprompt))
                pendingPrompt = (reply.results.map { it.text.text } + listOfNotNull(reply.reprompt?.text)).joinToString("\n")
            }
            is Reply.Act -> act(message, reply)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun act(message: ChatMessage.Assistant, reply: Reply.Act) {
        val started = ports.clock.elapsedMillis()
        val done = execute(reply.call)
        val first = StepResult(replies, done.tool, done.outcome ?: Outcome.Answered, done.target, observation.appLabel, done.detail)
        val next = done.after?.let { observe(it, done.last ?: first.lastLine(), done.target?.key, done.ocr) }
        // `Changes` leaves another screen's title to the loop, which takes it from the new observation, redacted there.
        val outcome = if (done.outcome is Outcome.AnotherScreen) Outcome.AnotherScreen(next?.title) else done.outcome
        val result = first.copy(outcome = outcome ?: Outcome.Answered)
        var line = done.text ?: result.resultLine()
        // A data tool that opened an app (navigate, share_media) brings both: its lines go with the result line.
        val data = done.data?.takeIf { next == null }
        if (next != null) done.data?.let { line += "\n" + it.text }
        done.extra?.let { line += "\n" + it.text }
        if (appStopped) {
            line += "\n" + APP_STOPPED
            appStopped = false
        }
        val failed = done.outcome is Outcome.Failed || done.outcome is Outcome.Refused || done.outcome is Outcome.CheckFailed
        conversation.add(Step(
            number = replies,
            reply = message,
            results = listOf(ResultText(reply.callId, reply.name, Redacted.kestrel(line), failed)) + reply.notRun,
            observedCall = if (next != null || data != null) reply.callId else null,
            observation = next,
            data = data,
            summary = Redacted.kestrel(done.summary ?: result.summary()),
            screenshot = done.screenshot,
        ))
        pendingPrompt = listOfNotNull(line, next?.text, data?.text).joinToString("\n")
        log(TaskLog.Kind.ACTION, "${done.tool}: $line (${ports.clock.elapsedMillis() - started} ms)")
        ledger(done, outcome)
    }

    internal suspend fun execute(call: AgentCall): Done = when (call) {
        is AgentCall.Tap, is AgentCall.LongPress, is AgentCall.TypeText, is AgentCall.Scroll, is AgentCall.Swipe,
        is AgentCall.Back, is AgentCall.Home -> screenSteps.element(call)
        is AgentCall.OpenApp -> screenSteps.openApp(call)
        is AgentCall.Wait -> screenSteps.wait(call)
        is AgentCall.AskUser -> askUser(call)
        is AgentCall.Say -> say(call)
        is AgentCall.Finish -> finish(call)
        is AgentCall.Fail -> throw Ended(EndReason.FAILED_BY_MODEL, detail = spoken(call.reason))
        is AgentCall.Remember -> remember(call)
        is AgentCall.Forget -> forget(call)
        else -> Done(call.tool, Outcome.Refused(NOT_YET))
    }

    // --- The model ---

    private suspend fun callModel(): PricedResponse {
        val current = currentModel
        val choice = choices.choice(current.id, null)
        val request = conversation.request(choice, null, replies + 1) ?: throw Ended(EndReason.CONTEXT_TOO_SMALL)
        log(TaskLog.Kind.PROMPT, "model=${current.id} role=${ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT} new: $pendingPrompt")
        try {
            return ports.model.call(ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT, request, replies + 1)
        } catch (e: ProviderException) {
            log(TaskLog.Kind.ERROR, "provider: ${e.error}")
            throw Ended(EndReason.PROVIDER, error = e.error)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun account(priced: PricedResponse) {
        val usage = priced.response.usage
        limits.spent(priced.cost.credits)
        inputTokens += usage.input
        outputTokens += usage.output
        cacheRead += usage.cacheRead
        cacheWrite += usage.cacheWrite
        val parts = priced.response.message.parts.joinToString("; ") { part ->
            when (part) {
                is AssistantPart.ToolCall -> "${part.name} ${redactor.redact(part.arguments.toString())}"
                is AssistantPart.Text -> "text ${redactor.redact(part.text)}"
                is AssistantPart.Reasoning -> "reasoning"
            }
        }
        log(
            TaskLog.Kind.REPLY,
            "$parts; in=${usage.input} out=${usage.output} cacheRead=${usage.cacheRead} cacheWrite=${usage.cacheWrite} credits=${priced.cost.credits}",
        )
    }

    // --- The screen ---

    suspend fun fresh(): ScreenSnapshot = ports.screen.snapshot() ?: throw Ended(EndReason.NO_SCREEN)

    /** The front app's launcher label, which the observation and the safety check name (D8, D13). */
    suspend fun label(packageName: String?): String? = packageName?.let { ports.apps.label(it) }

    /** The model that the task uses. */
    val currentModel: RoleModel get() = ports.model.model.lightweight

    /**
     * Checks the app in front of [snapshot] before it is observed (D16, D24): an agent-free app or Kestrel ends the task;
     * a Play services screen is handed over; a crashed app is closed with back. Returns the snapshot to observe.
     */
    suspend fun checkFront(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot): ScreenSnapshot {
        var current = snapshot
        repeat(FRONT_CHECKS) {
            val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(current)?.packageName
            if (settings.agentFree.isAgentFree(front)) throw Ended(EndReason.AGENT_FREE, detail = label(front) ?: front)
            when {
                PlayServices.handsOver(current) -> handOverOnly(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.PLAY_SERVICES))
                crashed(current) -> {
                    ports.screen.act(ScreenAction.Global(GlobalKind.BACK))
                    appStopped = true
                }
                else -> return current
            }
            current = fresh()
        }
        // The screen after the last round is checked too: it is never observed while it shows one of these.
        val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(current)?.packageName
        if (settings.agentFree.isAgentFree(front)) throw Ended(EndReason.AGENT_FREE, detail = label(front) ?: front)
        if (PlayServices.handsOver(current) || crashed(current)) throw Ended(EndReason.STUCK)
        return current
    }

    private fun crashed(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot): Boolean {
        val system = snapshot.windows.filter { it.packageName == ANDROID }.map { it.id }.toSet()
        val texts = snapshot.windows.filter { it.id in system }.mapNotNull { it.title } +
            snapshot.elements.filter { it.windowId in system }.mapNotNull { it.label }
        return texts.any { CRASHED.containsMatchIn(it) }
    }

    /** The observation of [after], which becomes the newest (D8). */
    suspend fun observe(after: ScreenSnapshot, last: String?, targetKey: String?, ocr: List<OcrLine> = emptyList()): Observation {
        val checked = checkFront(after)
        val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(checked)?.packageName
        val previous = if (::observation.isInitialized) observation else null
        val next = builder.build(ObservationInput(replies + 1, checked, label(front), last, previous, targetKey, ocr))
        snapshot = checked
        observation = next
        return next
    }

    /** After a resume (D2): the agent observes the screen again before it acts, because the owner may have changed it. */
    private suspend fun resumed() {
        appStopped = false
        val next = observe(fresh(), last = null, targetKey = null)
        conversation.addObservation(replies, Redacted.kestrel(RESUMED), next)
        pendingPrompt = RESUMED + "\n" + next.text
    }

    // --- The owner ---

    /** The pause gate before a model call, an action or a question (D2); true when the task was paused and resumed. */
    suspend fun gate(): Boolean = (limits.waiting { ports.owner.gate() } == Gate.RESUMED).also { if (it) interruptions = 0 }

    // A question that a touch or the wake word interrupted is asked again after the pause gate; the third interruption in
    // a row without a pause counts as no answer, so that the loop never asks forever.
    private var interruptions = 0

    private fun interrupted(): Boolean = ++interruptions >= MAX_INTERRUPTIONS

    suspend fun askYesNo(question: String): Boolean {
        while (true) {
            gate()
            when (limits.waiting { ports.owner.ask(question, AnswerKind.YES_NO) }) {
                Answer.Yes -> return true.also { interruptions = 0 }
                Answer.Interrupted -> if (interrupted()) return false else continue
                else -> return false.also { interruptions = 0 }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Asks [confirmation] (D14); the time waiting for the owner does not count as work. */
    suspend fun confirm(confirmation: Confirmation): ConfirmEnd {
        val end = limits.waiting { ports.owner.confirm(confirmation) }
        log(TaskLog.Kind.SAFETY, "question: ${redactor.redact(confirmation.question)} answer: $end")
        if (end == ConfirmEnd.NO || end == ConfirmEnd.TIMEOUT) {
            declined = true
            throw Ended(EndReason.DECLINED)
        }
        return end
    }

    /** A hand-over (D15): the owner does the step and says "Kestrel, continue", or it ends the task. */
    suspend fun handOver(handOver: HandOver, tool: String): Done {
        handOverOnly(handOver)
        return Done(tool, text = OWNER_DID_IT_RESULT, summary = "Step $replies: $OWNER_DID_IT.", last = OWNER_DID_IT, after = fresh(), progress = true)
    }

    private suspend fun handOverOnly(handOver: HandOver) {
        gate()
        when (limits.waiting { ports.owner.handOver(handOver) }) {
            HandOverEnd.CONTINUED -> Unit
            HandOverEnd.DONE_BY_ITSELF -> if (handOver.kind == HandOverKind.CALL) {
                // D15 names the person, by the title of the screen that the owner called from.
                throw Ended(EndReason.FINISHED, summary = observation.title?.let { spoken("You placed the call to $it.") } ?: CALL_PLACED)
            }
            HandOverEnd.CANCELLED -> throw Ended(EndReason.CANCELLED)
            HandOverEnd.EXPIRED -> throw Ended(EndReason.HAND_OVER_EXPIRED)
        }
    }

    /** The safety check of one proposal (D13), logged with the decision before test mode and the final one (D25, D27). */
    suspend fun assess(proposal: Proposal, screen: ScreenSnapshot): Assessment {
        val assessment = SafetyCheck.assess(proposal, screen, safety, settings.safety, settings.environment)
        val before = assessment.beforeTestMode
        if (before == Decision.Run && assessment.category in WATCHED) beforeTestMode++
        log(
            TaskLog.Kind.SAFETY,
            "${proposal.tool}: category=${assessment.category.wire} sources=${assessment.sources.sorted()} " +
                "beforeTestMode=${kind(before)} decision=${kind(assessment.decision)}",
        )
        return assessment
    }

    // The Cc and Bcc expanders that the task tapped, each only once (D14).
    private val expanded = mutableSetOf<String>()

    /** The safety check and its question or hand-over; a confirmation that the owner declines ends the task (D13, D14). */
    suspend fun decide(proposal: Proposal, screen: ScreenSnapshot, tool: String, target: TableEntry?): Clearance {
        val assessment = assess(proposal, screen)
        return when (val decision = assessment.decision) {
            Decision.Run -> Clearance.Go(assessment.category, null)
            is Decision.Block -> Clearance.Stop(blocked(assessment, decision.reason, tool, target, screen))
            is Decision.HandOver -> Clearance.Stop(handOver(decision.handOver, tool))
            is Decision.Confirm -> {
                if (decision.confirmation.category == Category.SENDING && expandCopies(screen)) return Clearance.Again
                if (gate()) return Clearance.Again
                if (confirm(decision.confirmation) != ConfirmEnd.YES) {
                    if (!interrupted()) return Clearance.Again
                    declined = true
                    throw Ended(EndReason.DECLINED)
                }
                interruptions = 0
                confirmed++
                Clearance.Go(assessment.category, decision.confirmation)
            }
        }
    }

    // D14: an e-mail's collapsed Cc and Bcc are opened once before its question, so that the question is built on the
    // screen that names every recipient. The tap passes the safety check as a tap that only reads.
    private suspend fun expandCopies(screen: ScreenSnapshot): Boolean {
        val tap = EmailCopies.expand(screen)?.takeIf { it.key !in expanded } ?: return false
        expanded += tap.key
        val proposal = Proposal(Tools.TAP, ActionKind.TAP, Category.READING, targetKey = tap.key, frontAppLabel = observation.appLabel)
        if (assess(proposal, screen).decision != Decision.Run) return false
        val outcome = ports.screen.act(tap)
        log(TaskLog.Kind.ACTION, "tap: opened Cc and Bcc before the question (${if (outcome.done) "done" else "failed"})")
        return outcome.done
    }

    /** A blocked action: test mode's block ends the task (D18); any other block is the model's to read. */
    fun blocked(assessment: Assessment, reason: String, tool: String, target: TableEntry?, after: ScreenSnapshot): Done {
        if (assessment.beforeTestMode !is Decision.Block) throw Ended(EndReason.TEST_MODE, detail = reason)
        return Done(tool, Outcome.Refused(reason), target, after = after)
    }

    /** A send that the owner confirmed and Kestrel pressed (D14, D24). */
    fun sent(confirmation: Confirmation, share: Boolean, items: Int) {
        if (confirmation.category == Category.DELETING) ledger.add("deleted ${deleted(confirmation.content)}")
        if (confirmation.category != Category.SENDING) return
        confirmedSends += ConfirmedSend(confirmation.recipients, confirmation.content, share)
        recipients += confirmation.recipients
        val to = confirmation.recipients.joinToString(" and ")
        val app = confirmation.appLabel?.let { " on $it" }.orEmpty()
        sends += "Sent to $to$app."
        if (share) {
            shareItems += items
            ledger.add("shared $items ${if (items == 1) "item" else "items"} with $to")
        } else {
            ledger.add("sent the message to $to")
        }
    }

    // A delete's content is a count for a selection ("3") or the title of what it deletes.
    private fun deleted(content: String?): String = when {
        content == null -> "an item"
        content.all(Char::isDigit) -> if (content == "1") "1 item" else "$content items"
        else -> content
    }

    // --- Dialogue ---

    private suspend fun askUser(call: AgentCall.AskUser): Done {
        while (true) {
            gate()
            val answer = limits.waiting { ports.owner.ask(spoken(call.question), AnswerKind.FREE) }
            val text = when (answer) {
                is Answer.Text -> answer.text
                is Answer.Number -> answer.n.toString()
                Answer.Yes -> "yes"
                Answer.Interrupted -> if (interrupted()) null else continue
                Answer.No, Answer.Silence -> null
            }
            interruptions = 0
            if (text == null) return Done(call.tool, Outcome.NoAnswer)
            safety = safety.withOwnerWords(text)
            val said = Redacted.of(redactor, text)
            return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Answered, extra = Redacted.kestrel("The owner said: " + ScreenText.quote(said.text, ScreenText.VALUE_LIMIT)))
        }
    }

    private suspend fun say(call: AgentCall.Say): Done {
        gate()
        limits.waiting { ports.owner.say(spoken(call.text)) }
        return Done(call.tool, text = "Result: said.", summary = "Step $replies: said something to the owner.", last = "said", progress = false)
    }

    // `finish` ends the task with the model's summary.
    private fun finish(call: AgentCall.Finish): Done = throw Ended(EndReason.FINISHED, summary = spoken(call.summary))

    // The `remember` and `forget` tools always ask the owner first (spec 11.4; D22).
    private suspend fun remember(call: AgentCall.Remember): Done {
        val stored = askYesNo("Remember that ${spoken(call.key)} is ${spoken(call.value)}?")
        if (stored) ports.memory.saveFact(Fact(call.key.trim(), call.value.trim(), FactKind.FACT, ports.clock.now().toInstant().toEpochMilli()))
        val words = if (stored) "stored" else "the owner said no"
        return Done(call.tool, text = "Result: $words.", summary = "Step $replies: remember → $words.", last = "remember → $words", progress = stored)
    }

    private suspend fun forget(call: AgentCall.Forget): Done {
        val fact = ports.memory.facts().firstOrNull { Normalizer.normalize(it.key) == Normalizer.normalize(call.key) }
        val words = when {
            fact == null -> "no such fact"
            askYesNo("Forget ${spoken(fact.key)}?") -> if (ports.memory.deleteFact(fact.key)) "deleted" else "no such fact"
            else -> "the owner said no"
        }
        return Done(call.tool, text = "Result: $words.", summary = "Step $replies: forget → $words.", last = "forget → $words", progress = words == "deleted")
    }

    /** Model text that Kestrel speaks (D24): placeholders as their kind's words, at most 600 characters. */
    fun spoken(text: String): String = vault.spoken(text).let { if (it.length > SPOKEN_LIMIT) it.take(SPOKEN_LIMIT - 1) + "…" else it }

    // --- The ledger and the report ---

    private suspend fun ledger(done: Done, outcome: Outcome?) {
        val label = done.target?.shownLabel
        val line = when {
            done.tool == Tools.OPEN_APP && outcome !is Outcome.Failed && outcome !is Outcome.Refused && done.detail != null -> "opened ${done.detail}"
            outcome == Outcome.TargetChanged && done.target?.checkable == true -> {
                val checked = done.target.key?.let { snapshot.element(it)?.checked }
                checked?.let { now ->
                    done.target.key?.let { lastChecked[it] = now }
                    "turned ${if (now) "on" else "off"} $label"
                }
            }
            outcome == Outcome.TargetChanged && done.tool == Tools.TYPE_TEXT -> "typed into $label"
            outcome is Outcome.AnotherScreen && done.tool == Tools.TAP -> outcome.title?.let { "opened ${ScreenText.quote(it, 40)}" } ?: "opened another screen"
            else -> null
        }
        line?.let(ledger::add)
    }

    private fun report(reason: EndReason, detail: String?, error: ProviderError?, summary: String?): TaskReport = TaskReport(
        end = reason,
        detail = detail?.let(vault::spoken),
        summary = if (declined) null else summary,
        error = error,
        ledger = ledger.lines.map(vault::spoken),
        sends = sends.toList(),
        recipients = recipients.toList(),
        steps = replies,
        workMillis = limits.workMillis,
        credits = limits.credits,
        inputTokens = inputTokens,
        outputTokens = outputTokens,
        cacheRead = cacheRead,
        cacheWrite = cacheWrite,
        confirmed = confirmed,
        unconfirmed = unconfirmed,
        beforeTestMode = beforeTestMode,
        shareItems = shareItems,
        modelId = ports.model.model.lightweight.id,
    )

    /** Writes [text] to the activity log; a failure of the log never ends the task. */
    suspend fun log(kind: TaskLog.Kind, text: String) {
        try {
            ports.log.write(kind, text)
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            // The log is advisory for the task; its own store reports its failure.
        }
    }

    suspend fun logEnd(report: TaskReport) {
        log(
            TaskLog.Kind.END,
            "end=${report.end} steps=${report.steps} workMs=${report.workMillis} credits=${report.credits} " +
                "in=${report.inputTokens} out=${report.outputTokens} cacheRead=${report.cacheRead} cacheWrite=${report.cacheWrite} " +
                "summary: ${report.summary?.let(redactor::redact).orEmpty()} ledger: ${report.ledger.joinToString("; ") { redactor.redact(it) }}",
        )
    }

    fun close() {
        vault.clear()
        ports.data.forgetTask()
    }

    private fun kind(decision: Decision): String = when (decision) {
        Decision.Run -> "Run"
        is Decision.Confirm -> "Confirm"
        is Decision.HandOver -> "HandOver(${decision.handOver.kind})"
        is Decision.Block -> "Block"
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "TaskRun(replies=$replies)"

    companion object {
        const val SPOKEN_LIMIT = 600
        const val TEST_MODE_NOTE = "Test mode is on: Kestrel sends only to the owner's own chats, and it never calls anyone."
        const val TEST_MODE_BLOCK = "Test mode: Kestrel only sends to your own chats."
        const val RESUMED = "The task was paused and has resumed; this is the screen now. Check it before you act."
        const val APP_STOPPED = "The app stopped; Kestrel went back."
        const val OWNER_DID_IT = "the owner did this step by hand"
        const val OWNER_DID_IT_RESULT = "Result: The owner did this step by hand."
        const val CALL_PLACED = "You placed the call."

        // The data tools, links, settings pages and look_closer come with the next task.
        private const val NOT_YET = "Kestrel cannot run this tool yet"
        private const val ANDROID = "android"
        private const val FRONT_CHECKS = 3
        private const val MAX_INTERRUPTIONS = 3
        private val CRASHED = Regex("""(isn't responding|keeps stopping)$""")
        private val WATCHED = setOf(Category.SENDING, Category.CALLS, Category.DELETING)
    }
}
```
