```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ScreenText
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.TableEntry
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ScreenAction
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.ActionMapper
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.AgentCall
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.NamePick
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Pick
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import dev.kestrel.safety.Confirmation
import dev.kestrel.safety.ConfirmationBuilder
import dev.kestrel.safety.Decision
import dev.kestrel.safety.Placeholders
import dev.kestrel.safety.Proposal
import dev.kestrel.safety.SafetyCheck
import dev.kestrel.safety.SendCheck
import dev.kestrel.safety.SendCheckResult
import dev.kestrel.safety.Vault
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay

/**
 * The screen tools (design D3, D10, D11, D13 and D14; D32 items 27 and 29): every action on an element reads a fresh
 * snapshot, checks the element against what the observation showed, passes the safety check, and after the owner's yes
 * reads the screen again and presses only when the confirmation and test mode's check still hold.
 */
internal class ScreenSteps(private val run: TaskRun) {
    suspend fun element(call: AgentCall): Done {
        val table = run.observation.table
        val entry = when (call) {
            is AgentCall.Tap -> table.entry(call.target)
            is AgentCall.LongPress -> table.entry(call.target)
            is AgentCall.TypeText -> table.entry(call.target)
            is AgentCall.Scroll -> call.target?.let(table::entry)
            is AgentCall.Swipe -> call.target?.let(table::entry)
            else -> null
        }
        while (true) {
            if (run.gate()) return paused(call.tool, entry)
            val before = run.fresh()
            if (entry != null && !entry.ocr && !fits(entry, before)) return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed(CHANGED_BEFORE), entry, after = before)
            if (call is AgentCall.Swipe) {
                ActionMapper.swipeRefusal(call, table, before)?.let { return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Refused(it), entry, after = before) }
            }
            val proposal = ActionMapper.proposal(call, table, run.observation.appLabel)
            sendCheck(proposal, before, call.tool, entry)?.let { return it }
            when (val clearance = run.decide(proposal, before, call.tool, entry)) {
                Clearance.Again -> continue
                is Clearance.Stop -> return clearance.done
                is Clearance.Go -> {
                    val yes = clearance.confirmation ?: return perform(call, entry, proposal, before, clearance.category, confirmed = false)
                    return afterYes(call, entry, proposal, yes, clearance.category)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // After the yes (D14): the card has gone; the screen is read again and the confirmation built again on it.
    private suspend fun afterYes(call: AgentCall, entry: TableEntry?, proposal: Proposal, yes: Confirmation, category: Category): Done {
        val fresh = run.fresh()
        if (!SafetyCheck.testModeAllows(proposal, fresh, run.safety, run.settings.safety, run.settings.environment)) {
            throw Ended(EndReason.TEST_MODE, detail = TaskRun.TEST_MODE_BLOCK)
        }
        val again = ConfirmationBuilder.build(proposal, fresh, category, run.safety)
        if (again !is Decision.Confirm || !again.confirmation.sameAs(yes) || (entry != null && !entry.ocr && !fits(entry, fresh))) {
            return Done(call.tool, Outcome.CheckFailed(CHANGED_AFTER), entry, after = fresh)
        }
        sendCheck(proposal, fresh, call.tool, entry)?.let { return it }
        val flow = run.safety.shareFlow
        val done = perform(call, entry, proposal, fresh, category, confirmed = true)
        if (done.outcome !is Outcome.Failed) {
            val items = flow?.count?.let { it.photos + it.videos } ?: 0
            run.sent(yes, share = flow != null, items = items)
        }
        return done
    }

    // The check before a send, save, submit or confirm (D14; r61): the typed values must still be in their fields.
    private fun sendCheck(proposal: Proposal, screen: ScreenSnapshot, tool: String, entry: TableEntry?): Done? {
        if (!SendCheck.applies(proposal, screen)) return null
        val result = SendCheck.check(proposal, screen, run.safety) as? SendCheckResult.Failed ?: return null
        val what = if (result.wrongApp) {
            "the share is no longer in the app that it opened"
        } else {
            "the message field shows ${ScreenText.quote(run.redactor.redact(result.fieldText), ScreenText.VALUE_LIMIT)}, not the text that I typed"
        }
        return Done(tool, Outcome.CheckFailed(what), entry, after = screen)
    }

    private suspend fun perform(
        call: AgentCall,
        entry: TableEntry?,
        proposal: Proposal,
        before: ScreenSnapshot,
        category: Category,
        confirmed: Boolean,
    ): Done {
        val revealed = (call as? AgentCall.TypeText)?.let { typed ->
            // A value of the vault that Kestrel types is named by its kind in every later question (D14, D17).
            Vault.PLACEHOLDER.findAll(typed.text).map { it.value }.distinct().forEach { placeholder ->
                run.vault.valueOf(placeholder)?.let { run.safety = run.safety.withSecret(it, Placeholders.forConfirmation(placeholder)) }
            }
            run.vault.reveal(typed.text)
        }
        val press = ActionMapper.press(category, confirmed)
        val action = ActionMapper.screenAction(call, run.observation.table, revealed, press)
            ?: return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed(NOTHING_TO_ACT_ON), entry, after = before)
        val outcome = run.ports.screen.act(action)
        if (!confirmed && category in WATCHED) run.unconfirmed++
        val after = run.fresh()
        run.safety = SafetyCheck.afterAction(proposal.copy(text = revealed ?: proposal.text), before, after, run.safety)
        val key = entry?.key ?: (action as? ScreenAction.Scroll)?.key ?: (action as? ScreenAction.Swipe)?.key
        val changed = Changes.outcome(before, after, key, run.settings::closed)
        val result = when {
            !outcome.done -> Outcome.Failed(outcome.reason ?: ACTION_FAILED)
            outcome.uncertain && changed == Outcome.NothingChanged -> Outcome.Uncertain
            else -> changed
        }
        val extra = if (result == Outcome.Uncertain) Redacted.kestrel(UNCERTAIN) else null
        return Done(call.tool, result, entry, detail = direction(call), after = after, extra = extra)
    }

    private fun direction(call: AgentCall): String? = when (call) {
        is AgentCall.Scroll -> call.direction.name.lowercase()
        is AgentCall.Swipe -> call.direction.name.lowercase()
        else -> null
    }

    suspend fun openApp(call: AgentCall.OpenApp): Done {
        val apps = run.ports.apps.launcherApps()
        val app = when (val pick = NamePick.pick(call.name, apps, { it.label }, { false })) {
            Pick.None -> return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed("no app named ${quoted(call.name)}"))
            is Pick.Several -> return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed("several apps match: " + pick.items.take(NamePick.MAX_CHOICES).joinToString(", ") { quoted(it.label) }))
            is Pick.One -> pick.item
        }
        if (run.settings.closed(app.packageName)) return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Refused("${quoted(app.label)} is agent-free"))
        return open(call, ScreenAction.OpenApp(app.packageName), app.packageName, app.label)
    }

    // Opens something, then waits up to 5 s until its app is in front (D11; review A M15, A2-N7).
    private suspend fun open(call: AgentCall, action: ScreenAction, target: String?, detail: String?): Done {
        while (true) {
            if (run.gate()) return paused(call.tool, null)
            val before = run.fresh()
            val proposal = ActionMapper.proposal(call, run.observation.table, run.observation.appLabel)
            when (val clearance = run.decide(proposal, before, call.tool, null)) {
                Clearance.Again -> continue
                is Clearance.Stop -> return clearance.done
                is Clearance.Go -> {
                    val outcome = run.ports.screen.act(action)
                    if (!outcome.done) return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed(outcome.reason ?: ACTION_FAILED), after = run.fresh())
                    run.ports.screen.waitForFront(target, FRONT_WAIT_MILLIS, before = ScreenTree.frontWindow(before)?.packageName)
                    val after = run.fresh()
                    run.safety = SafetyCheck.afterAction(proposal, before, after, run.safety)
                    return Done(call.tool, Changes.outcome(before, after, null, run.settings::closed), detail = detail, after = after)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun wait(call: AgentCall.Wait): Done {
        val before = run.fresh()
        var now = before
        for (poll in 1..call.seconds * 2) {
            delay(POLL_MILLIS)
            now = run.fresh()
            if (Changes.outcome(before, now, null, run.settings::closed) != Outcome.NothingChanged) break
        }
        return Done(call.tool, Changes.outcome(before, now, null, run.settings::closed), after = now)
    }

    private suspend fun paused(tool: String, entry: TableEntry?): Done =
        Done(tool, text = "Result: $PAUSED", summary = "Step ${run.replies}: the task was paused; nothing was done.", last = "paused; nothing was done", target = entry, after = run.fresh(), progress = false)

    // The element still shows what the observation showed (D32 item 27).
    private fun fits(entry: TableEntry, screen: ScreenSnapshot): Boolean {
        val element = entry.key?.let(screen::element) ?: return false
        return element.label == entry.label && element.className == entry.className && element.packageName == entry.packageName &&
            element.editable == entry.editable && element.password == entry.password && element.checkable == entry.checkable
    }

    private fun quoted(text: String): String = ScreenText.quote(run.redactor.redact(text), ScreenText.LABEL_LIMIT)

    override fun toString(): String = "ScreenSteps"

    companion object {
        const val CHANGED_BEFORE = "the screen changed before the action; nothing was done"
        const val CHANGED_AFTER = "the screen changed after the confirmation; nothing was sent"
        const val UNCERTAIN = "The tap may not have worked; check the screen before trying again."
        const val PAUSED = "The task was paused before this action, so nothing was done."
        const val ACTION_FAILED = "the action failed"
        const val NOTHING_TO_ACT_ON = "there is nothing to act on"
        const val FRONT_WAIT_MILLIS = 5_000L
        const val POLL_MILLIS = 500L
        private val WATCHED = setOf(Category.SENDING, Category.CALLS, Category.DELETING)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Expect
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Press
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ScreenAction
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenElement
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree

/**
 * An e-mail's collapsed Cc and Bcc (design D14): before Kestrel asks about an e-mail, it opens them, so that the question
 * names every recipient. `ConfirmationBuilder` reads only what the screen shows, so the loop taps the expander, after the
 * safety check, like every other tap.
 */
internal object EmailCopies {
    /** The e-mail apps whose expander Kestrel knows; plan 5B adds the packages that it records. */
    val EMAIL_APPS = setOf("com.google.android.gm")

    private val COPY_FIELDS = setOf("cc", "bcc")
    private val EXPANDER_WORDS = setOf("cc", "bcc", "show", "add")

    /**
     * The tap that opens Cc and Bcc, or null: the front window of an e-mail app shows a To field and no Cc or Bcc field,
     * and exactly one clickable element that is no field has a name made only of Cc and Bcc words ("Show Cc/Bcc").
     */
    fun expand(screen: ScreenSnapshot): ScreenAction.Tap? {
        val window = ScreenTree.frontWindow(screen)?.takeIf { it.packageName in EMAIL_APPS } ?: return null
        val shown = screen.elements.filter { it.windowId == window.id }
        if (shown.none { it.editable && field(it) == "to" } || shown.any { it.editable && field(it) in COPY_FIELDS }) return null
        val expander = shown.singleOrNull { it.clickable && !it.editable && expands(ScreenTree.name(it)) } ?: return null
        val expect = Expect(expander.label, expander.className, expander.packageName, editable = false, password = false, checkable = expander.checkable)
        return ScreenAction.Tap(expander.key, expect, Press.VERIFIED)
    }

    private fun expands(name: String?): Boolean {
        val words = Normalizer.words(name.orEmpty())
        return words.isNotEmpty() && words.all { it in EXPANDER_WORDS } && words.any { it in COPY_FIELDS }
    }

    private fun field(element: ScreenElement): String? = (ScreenTree.idName(element.viewId) ?: element.hint ?: element.label)?.trim()?.lowercase()
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.loop.TaskRun
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/**
 * Kestrel's agent (design D1; spec 11): [run] carries out one task to its end and hands its report to `report` exactly
 * once on every path (review A M14). A cancellation (a touch, "stop", a new task after "stop", the end of a long pause)
 * arrives as a CancellationException: the agent then builds its report from what it had done inside NonCancellable,
 * hides the numbers that it may have shown, calls `report`, and rethrows (D24, D32 items 1 and 4). The task's vault is
 * cleared in every case (spec 12.6).
 */
class Agent(private val ports: AgentPorts, private val settings: AgentSettings) {
    suspend fun run(task: TaskRequest, report: (TaskReport) -> Unit) {
        val run = TaskRun(ports, settings, task)
        var reported = false
        val once: (TaskReport) -> Unit = {
            if (!reported) {
                reported = true
                report(it)
            }
        }
        try {
            val result = run.run()
            withContext(NonCancellable) { end(run, result, once) }
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            withContext(NonCancellable) { end(run, run.cancelled((e as? TaskCancellation)?.reason ?: EndReason.CANCELLED), once) }
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            withContext(NonCancellable) { end(run, run.cancelled(EndReason.KESTREL_ERROR), once) }
            throw e
        } finally {
            run.close()
        }
    }

    private suspend fun end(run: TaskRun, result: TaskReport, report: (TaskReport) -> Unit) {
        try {
            ports.screen.hideBadges()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            // The report matters more than the numbers' overlay, which the screen layer removes with the task anyway.
        }
        run.logEnd(result)
        report(result)
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "Agent"
}
```

### Task 11: The data tools, links, settings pages, `look_closer` and the share flow's one yes

**Files:**
- Create: `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/DataSteps.kt`, `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/LookCloser.kt`
- Modify: `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/TaskRun.kt`, `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/ScreenSteps.kt`
- Test: `core/agent/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/AgentToolsTest.kt`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 10 whole; Task 3's `ShareFlow` (with `serial`), `ShareCount`, `LinkCheck`, `LinkVerdict`; Task 6's `EyesPort`, `Capture`, `OcrLine`, `Badge`, `DataPort`, `DataResult` (with `Ok.note` and `Ok.opened`), `IntentSpec`, `AnswerKind.SCREENSHOT`, `ObservationTable` with `redactedBounds`; Task 7's `ActionMapper.runData`, `SharePackages.of` (a list), `Browser`, `SettingsPage`, `Tools`; Task 1's `ScreenSignature`.
- Produces (package `dev.kestrel.agent.loop`, internal): `DataSteps` (with `MAX_SILENT_SHARE` and `NAME_FIELD`), `LookCloser` (with `MIN_SCORE`, `WHICH`, `SECURE`, `NO_SCREENSHOT`, `CHANGED`), `TaskRun.table(snapshot, ocr)`, `Clearance.Go.covered` and `TaskRun.forgetConfirmedFlow()`. For plan 5B's `AndroidDataPort`: `share_media` and `compose_sms` should name the package that they opened in `DataResult.Ok.opened`, although the loop waits for the front app and starts the share flow without it; `find_media`'s lines are "<id> · photo · …" or "<id> · video · …"; `find_contact`'s lines carry a field `name`; `find_media`'s `note` is spoken to the owner before a share uses its items.

Design D11, D12, D14's share flow and D20's agent side, and D32 item 12. The data tools run through `DataPort` after the safety check; a missing permission is asked once with Kestrel's reason and the tool runs again, and notification access is an `ACCESS` hand-over (D12). `share_media` resolves its app with `SharePackages.of` (the first installed of its packages, such as Telegram's two builds) or `NamePick`, refuses an agent-free app, asks before more than 10 items, and speaks `find_media`'s note on partial photo access before the share (D12). After `share_media` or `compose_sms`, the loop always waits for the front app (`DataResult.Ok.opened`, or the share's package) and calls `SafetyCheck.afterAction`, so that the share flow starts even when `DataPort` names no package and a picker row is never sent without the owner (review 4 I1); another data tool that opens an app (`navigate`) puts its lines below its result line, above the new observation. One yes covers the following taps of the same share flow (a row, then the app's own Send) while they name the same recipients: the loop compares the flow's `serial` and the confirmation's recipients, never whole flows, so a second share, also of other photos to the same chat, asks again, and a covered tap is counted as the same send (D14; review 4 C2). Links pass `LinkCheck` with the target that `ScreenPort.resolve` names, whose launcher label goes into the proposal as `receivingAppLabel` so that the question names the app; a link is the owner's when its host's words are a whole run of the request's words (D32 item 12; review 4 m4); Firefox's empty page is retried once (D11); and `open_settings` names the page that opened, which can be a fallback of the page asked for (D11; review 4 m11). `look_closer` runs D20's three steps, one per call on the same screen. OCR reads the regions without tree text. The screenshot is asked with `AnswerKind.SCREENSHOT`, and only "always", "always for this app" and "yes always" approve for good, while an answer with a word of refusal ("No, always ask me first.") is a no (review 4 I3, m7). After the answer the loop passes the pause gate and reads the screen again, and it captures only when the same app shows the same screen and the screen may be captured; a changed screen gives the new observation and no picture (spec 12.5; review 4 I5). The masks cover password and data-sensitive elements, every line of that screen's observation whose text the redactor changed (`ObservationTable.redactedBounds`, so a code inside a row without its own label too, and a line that the token cap left out), and every OCR box whose text the redactor changes when the other boxes are its neighbours (D20; review 4 I4). The screenshot and the numbers steps keep the observation with step 1's OCR lines as the newest, because the picture's numbers and the owner's pick are its numbers (review 4 m1).

Create `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/DataSteps.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.DataResultText
import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason
import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ScreenText
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.DataResult
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.HandOverEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.PermissionEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ScreenAction
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.ActionMapper
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.AgentCall
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.SharePackages
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.Tools
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.NamePick
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Pick
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOver
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOverKind
import dev.kestrel.safety.SafetyCheck
import dev.kestrel.safety.ShareCount
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * The data tools (design D12): each runs through `DataPort` after the safety check; a missing permission is asked at
 * first use with Kestrel's reason and the tool runs again (spec 11.5, 13.6); notification access is a hand-over of kind
 * `ACCESS` (D9); a tool that opens an app's screen waits until that app is in front (D11). The result's values are
 * redacted with their neighbours and quoted by `DataResultText` (review A3-I1).
 */
internal class DataSteps(private val run: TaskRun) {
    // find_media's items: true for a video. 5B writes each item's fixed text as "<id> · photo · …" or "<id> · video · …".
    private val videos = mutableMapOf<String, Boolean>()

    // find_media's note on partial photo access, which the owner hears once before a share uses the items (D12).
    private var mediaNote: String? = null

    suspend fun run(call: AgentCall): Done {
        var sharePackage: String? = null
        var receivingLabel: String? = null
        if (call is AgentCall.ShareMedia) {
            sharePackage = sharePackage(call) ?: return unknownApp(call)
            if (run.settings.closed(sharePackage)) return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Refused("${quoted(run.label(sharePackage) ?: call.app)} is agent-free"))
            receivingLabel = run.label(sharePackage)
            mediaNote?.let { note ->
                mediaNote = null
                run.gate()
                run.limits.waiting { run.ports.owner.say(note) }
            }
            if (call.items.size > MAX_SILENT_SHARE && !run.askYesNo("Share ${call.items.size} items?")) throw Ended(EndReason.DECLINED)
        }
        while (true) {
            if (run.gate()) return Done(call.tool, text = "Result: ${ScreenSteps.PAUSED}", summary = "Step ${run.replies}: the task was paused; nothing was done.", last = "paused; nothing was done", after = run.fresh(), progress = false)
            val before = run.fresh()
            var proposal = ActionMapper.proposal(call, run.observation.table, run.observation.appLabel, receivingPackage = sharePackage, receivingAppLabel = receivingLabel)
            if (call is AgentCall.ShareMedia) proposal = proposal.copy(shareCount = count(call.items))
            when (val clearance = run.decide(proposal, before, call.tool, null)) {
                Clearance.Again -> continue
                is Clearance.Stop -> return clearance.done
                is Clearance.Go -> Unit
            }
            val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(before)?.packageName
            val result = runAllowed(call, sharePackage, front) ?: return Done(call.tool, Outcome.PermissionRefused)
            if (result is DataResult.Failed) return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed(result.reason), detail = detail(call))
            val ok = result as DataResult.Ok
            remember(call, ok)
            // A share or a new SMS always starts the share flow, also when `DataPort` names no package (D14).
            val opens = call is AgentCall.ShareMedia || call is AgentCall.ComposeSms
            val after = if (opens || ok.opened != null) {
                run.ports.screen.waitForFront(ok.opened ?: sharePackage, ScreenSteps.FRONT_WAIT_MILLIS, before = front)
                run.fresh().also { run.safety = SafetyCheck.afterAction(proposal, before, it, run.safety) }
            } else {
                null
            }
            val outcome = if (ok.lines.isEmpty()) Outcome.DataEmpty else Outcome.DataOk(ok.lines.size)
            return Done(call.tool, outcome, detail = detail(call), data = DataResultText.of(ok, run.redactor), after = after)
        }
    }

    // Runs the tool; asks for a missing permission or access once and runs it again. Null: the owner refused (D12).
    private suspend fun runAllowed(call: AgentCall, sharePackage: String?, front: String?): DataResult? {
        val today = run.ports.clock.now().toLocalDate()
        val first = ActionMapper.runData(call, run.ports.data, today, sharePackage) ?: return DataResult.Failed(NOT_DATA)
        when (first) {
            is DataResult.NeedsPermission -> {
                val end = run.limits.waiting { run.ports.owner.askPermission(first.permissions, why(call)) }
                if (end == PermissionEnd.REFUSED) return null
            }
            is DataResult.NeedsAccess -> {
                when (run.limits.waiting { run.ports.owner.handOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.ACCESS)) }) {
                    HandOverEnd.CANCELLED -> throw Ended(EndReason.CANCELLED)
                    HandOverEnd.EXPIRED -> throw Ended(EndReason.HAND_OVER_EXPIRED)
                    else -> Unit
                }
            }
            else -> return first
        }
        // Back to the task's app before the tool runs again (D12, D15).
        if (front != null && !run.ports.screen.waitForFront(front, ScreenSteps.FRONT_WAIT_MILLIS)) {
            run.ports.screen.act(ScreenAction.OpenApp(front))
            run.ports.screen.waitForFront(front, ScreenSteps.FRONT_WAIT_MILLIS)
        }
        val again = ActionMapper.runData(call, run.ports.data, today, sharePackage) ?: return DataResult.Failed(NOT_DATA)
        return when (again) {
            is DataResult.NeedsPermission -> null
            is DataResult.NeedsAccess -> DataResult.Failed(NO_ACCESS)
            else -> again
        }
    }

    private suspend fun sharePackage(call: AgentCall.ShareMedia): String? {
        val known = SharePackages.of(call.app)
        if (known.isNotEmpty()) {
            val installed = run.ports.apps.launcherApps().map { it.packageName }.toSet()
            return known.firstOrNull { it in installed }
        }
        val pick = NamePick.pick(call.app, run.ports.apps.launcherApps(), { it.label }, { false })
        return (pick as? Pick.One)?.item?.packageName
    }

    private fun unknownApp(call: AgentCall.ShareMedia): Done =
        Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed("no single installed app named ${quoted(call.app)}"))

    // What the task learns from a result: find_media's kinds per item (for the share's question).
    private fun remember(call: AgentCall, ok: DataResult.Ok) {
        if (call is AgentCall.FindMedia) {
            mediaNote = ok.note
            for (line in ok.lines) {
                val id = line.fixed.substringBefore(' ').trim()
                videos[id] = "video" in Normalizer.words(line.fixed)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun count(items: List<String>): ShareCount {
        val video = items.count { videos[it] == true }
        return ShareCount(photos = items.size - video, videos = video)
    }

    /** The short argument text of a data step, which its result line and summary name (D6); already redacted. */
    private fun detail(call: AgentCall): String? = when (call) {
        is AgentCall.FindContact -> run.redactor.redact(call.name)
        is AgentCall.FindMedia -> listOfNotNull(call.day, call.until?.let { "to $it" }).joinToString(" ") + ", " + call.kinds.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        is AgentCall.ShareMedia -> "${call.items.size} items"
        is AgentCall.ListEvents -> "${call.from} to ${call.to}"
        is AgentCall.CreateEvent -> run.redactor.redact(call.title)
        is AgentCall.SetAlarm -> "%02d:%02d".format(Locale.ROOT, call.hour, call.minute)
        is AgentCall.SetTimer -> "${call.seconds} s"
        is AgentCall.ListSms -> call.from?.let { run.redactor.redact(it) }
        is AgentCall.MediaControl -> call.action.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        is AgentCall.Navigate -> call.app.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        else -> null
    }

    /** The ledger's line for a data step that changed something the owner can see (D24). */
    fun ledgerLine(done: Done): String? {
        if (done.outcome !is Outcome.DataOk && done.outcome != Outcome.DataEmpty) return null
        return when (done.tool) {
            Tools.SHARE_MEDIA -> "opened the share screen with ${done.detail}"
            Tools.COMPOSE_SMS -> "opened a new SMS"
            Tools.NAVIGATE -> "opened the route in ${if (done.detail == "waze") "Waze" else "Google Maps"}"
            Tools.CREATE_EVENT -> "opened a new calendar event"
            Tools.SET_ALARM -> "set an alarm for ${done.detail}"
            Tools.SET_TIMER -> "set a timer"
            Tools.MEDIA_CONTROL -> "pressed ${done.detail}"
            else -> null
        }
    }

    private fun why(call: AgentCall): String = when (call) {
        is AgentCall.FindContact -> "To find a contact, Kestrel needs access to your contacts."
        is AgentCall.FindMedia, is AgentCall.ShareMedia -> "To find your photos and videos, Kestrel needs access to them."
        is AgentCall.ListEvents -> "To read your calendar, Kestrel needs access to it."
        is AgentCall.ListSms -> "To read your messages, Kestrel needs access to your SMS."
        is AgentCall.ListCalls -> "To read your call history, Kestrel needs access to it."
        is AgentCall.GetLocation -> "To find where you are, Kestrel needs access to your location."
        else -> "Kestrel needs a permission for this step."
    }

    private fun quoted(text: String): String = ScreenText.quote(run.redactor.redact(text), ScreenText.LABEL_LIMIT)

    override fun toString(): String = "DataSteps(items=${videos.size})"

    companion object {
        const val MAX_SILENT_SHARE = 10
        private const val NOT_DATA = "this is not a data tool"
        private const val NO_ACCESS = "Kestrel still has no notification access"
    }
}
```

Create `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/LookCloser.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.TableEntry
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Answer
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AnswerKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Badge
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Capture
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.OcrLine
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.AgentCall
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.safety.AgentFreeApps
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSignature
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenTree
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.Signature

/**
 * `look_closer`'s three steps (design D20; spec 11.6), one per call on the same screen: OCR where the tree has no text,
 * then a screenshot for the model after the owner's yes, then the numbers for the owner to pick from. A call with a
 * target limits OCR and the screenshot to that element. When a step cannot run here (no OCR files, a model without
 * images, the owner's no), the next one runs in the same call. Captures stay in memory and are closed at once.
 */
internal class LookCloser(private val run: TaskRun) {
    private val calls = mutableMapOf<Signature, Int>()
    private var ocrMissing = false

    /** Why a capture gave no picture: a secure window, or Kestrel's fixed sentence of `Capture.NotNow`. */
    private class NoCapture(val secure: Boolean, val reason: String) : Exception(null, null, false, false)

    suspend fun step(call: AgentCall.LookCloser): Done {
        val target = call.target?.let(run.observation.table::entry)
        val signature = run.observation.signature
        val count = calls.getOrDefault(signature, 0)
        calls[signature] = count + 1
        return try {
            when (count) {
                0 -> ocr(call, target) ?: screenshot(call, target) ?: numbers(call)
                1 -> screenshot(call, target) ?: numbers(call)
                else -> numbers(call)
            }
        } catch (e: NoCapture) {
            // A secure screen goes on with the numbers next time; anything else may be tried again.
            calls[signature] = if (e.secure) 2 else count
            Done(call.tool, text = "Result: ${e.reason}", summary = "Step ${run.replies}: look_closer could not capture the screen.",
                last = "look_closer could not capture the screen", after = run.fresh(), progress = false)
        }
    }

    // Step 1 (D20; r61): OCR on the regions without tree text, never on password or data-sensitive elements; lines that
    // overlap tree text are dropped, and only lines with a mean score of at least 0.8 are kept. Null: no OCR files.
    private suspend fun ocr(call: AgentCall.LookCloser, target: TableEntry?): Done? {
        val snapshot = run.fresh()
        if (!capturable(snapshot)) return null
        val lines = withCapture { capture -> read(capture, snapshot, target) } ?: return null
        val kept = lines.filter { it.score >= MIN_SCORE && !overlapsText(it, snapshot) }
        return Done(
            call.tool, target = target, after = snapshot, ocr = kept, progress = kept.isNotEmpty(),
            text = "Result: look_closer read ${kept.size} lines of text.",
            summary = "Step ${run.replies}: look_closer read ${kept.size} lines.",
            last = "look_closer read ${kept.size} lines",
        )
    }

    // Step 2 (D20): a screenshot for a model that takes images, after the owner's yes, with every secret masked. The
    // observation with step 1's OCR lines stays the newest, because the picture's numbers are its numbers.
    private suspend fun screenshot(call: AgentCall.LookCloser, target: TableEntry?): Done? {
        val asked = run.fresh()
        val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(asked)?.packageName ?: return null
        if (!run.currentModel.takesImages || !capturable(asked)) return null
        val provider = run.ports.model.model
        if (!run.ports.memory.screenshotApproved(front, provider.providerId)) {
            val app = run.label(front) ?: front.substringAfterLast('.')
            val warning = if (ocrMissing) " I can't hide numbers that only the picture shows." else ""
            run.gate()
            val answer = run.limits.waiting { run.ports.owner.ask("May I send a screenshot of $app to ${provider.providerName}?$warning", AnswerKind.SCREENSHOT) }
            when (approval(answer)) {
                Approval.ALWAYS -> run.ports.memory.approveScreenshots(front, provider.providerId)
                Approval.ONCE -> Unit
                Approval.NO -> return null
            }
        }
        // The owner may take a while to answer: a screen that changed since the question is never captured (spec 12.5).
        run.gate()
        val now = run.fresh()
        val same = ScreenTree.frontWindow(now)?.packageName == front && ScreenSignature.of(now).sameScreen(ScreenSignature.of(asked))
        if (!same || !capturable(now)) {
            return Done(call.tool, text = "Result: $CHANGED", summary = "Step ${run.replies}: look_closer took no screenshot; the screen changed.",
                last = "look_closer took no screenshot; the screen changed", after = now, progress = false)
        }
        val image = withCapture { capture ->
            val lines = read(capture, now, target).orEmpty()
            run.ports.eyes.encode(capture, masks(now, lines), badges())
        } ?: return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed(NO_SCREENSHOT), target)
        return Done(
            call.tool, target = target, screenshot = image, progress = false,
            text = "Result: the screenshot follows.",
            summary = "Step ${run.replies}: look_closer sent a screenshot.",
            last = "look_closer sent a screenshot",
        )
    }

    // Step 3 (D20): the owner picks a number on the screen.
    private suspend fun numbers(call: AgentCall.LookCloser): Done {
        run.ports.screen.showBadges(badges())
        try {
            run.gate()
            val answer = run.limits.waiting { run.ports.owner.ask(WHICH, AnswerKind.PICK_NUMBER) }
            val picked = (answer as? Answer.Number)?.n?.takeIf { run.observation.table.entry(it) != null }
                ?: return Done(call.tool, Outcome.NoAnswer)
            return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Answered, extra = Redacted.kestrel("The owner picked [$picked]."))
        } finally {
            run.ports.screen.hideBadges()
        }
    }

    private suspend fun <T> withCapture(block: suspend (Capture.Captured) -> T?): T? =
        when (val capture = run.ports.eyes.capture()) {
            is Capture.Captured -> capture.image.use { block(capture) }
            Capture.Secure -> throw NoCapture(secure = true, reason = SECURE)
            is Capture.NotNow -> throw NoCapture(secure = false, reason = capture.reason)
        }

    private suspend fun read(capture: Capture.Captured, snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, target: TableEntry?): List<OcrLine>? {
        val window = ScreenTree.frontWindow(snapshot) ?: return emptyList()
        val regions = if (target != null) listOf(target.bounds) else textless(snapshot, window.id, window.bounds)
        val exclude = snapshot.elements.filter { it.password || it.dataSensitive }.map { it.bounds }
        val lines = run.ports.eyes.read(capture, regions, exclude)
        if (lines == null) ocrMissing = true
        return lines
    }

    // Actionable elements without a label, and large elements (1/16 of the window) whose subtree has no text (D20).
    private fun textless(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, windowId: Int, area: IntRect): List<IntRect> {
        val elements = snapshot.elements
        val large = area.width.toLong() * area.height / LARGE_SHARE
        return elements.indices.filter { index ->
            val element = elements[index]
            if (element.windowId != windowId || element.password || element.dataSensitive) return@filter false
            val subtreeText = elements.indices.any { other ->
                !elements[other].label.isNullOrBlank() && (other == index || index in ScreenTree.ancestors(snapshot, other))
            }
            (element.isActionable && element.label.isNullOrBlank()) || (element.bounds.width.toLong() * element.bounds.height >= large && !subtreeText)
        }.map { elements[it].bounds }
    }

    // A line whose centre lies in an element with text, or that covers more than half of its area with it, is dropped.
    private fun overlapsText(line: OcrLine, snapshot: ScreenSnapshot): Boolean = snapshot.elements.any { element ->
        if (element.label.isNullOrBlank()) return@any false
        val overlap = element.bounds.intersect(line.bounds) ?: return@any false
        val centre = IntRect(line.bounds.centerX, line.bounds.centerY, line.bounds.centerX + 1, line.bounds.centerY + 1)
        element.bounds.contains(centre) || overlap.width.toLong() * overlap.height * 2 > line.bounds.width.toLong() * line.bounds.height
    }

    // Password fields, data-sensitive elements, every line of the screen's observation whose text the redactor changed
    // (merged rows and the lines that the cap left out included), and OCR boxes whose text it changes with the other boxes as neighbours, whatever their
    // score (D20; review B I12, B2-M8).
    private suspend fun masks(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, lines: List<OcrLine>): List<IntRect> {
        val secret = snapshot.elements.filter { it.password || it.dataSensitive }.map { it.bounds }
        val kept = lines.filter { it.score >= MIN_SCORE && !overlapsText(it, snapshot) }
        val redacted = run.table(snapshot, kept).redactedBounds
        val texts = lines.map { it.text }
        val ocr = lines.filterIndexed { index, line ->
            run.redactor.redact(line.text, texts.filterIndexed { other, _ -> other != index }) != line.text
        }.map { it.bounds }
        return secret + redacted + ocr
    }

    private enum class Approval { ALWAYS, ONCE, NO }

    // D20: only "always" and "always for this app" approve for good, and only the yes words send once; an answer with a
    // word of refusal is a no ("No, always ask me first.").
    private fun approval(answer: Answer): Approval {
        val text = when (answer) {
            is Answer.Text -> Normalizer.normalize(answer.text)
            Answer.Yes -> "yes"
            else -> return Approval.NO
        }
        return when {
            Normalizer.words(text).any { it in REFUSALS } -> Approval.NO
            text in ALWAYS -> Approval.ALWAYS
            text in YES -> Approval.ONCE
            else -> Approval.NO
        }
    }

    private fun badges(): List<Badge> = run.observation.table.entries.map { Badge(it.number, it.bounds) }

    // Never an agent-free app or a Play services window (D16, D20); the eyes refuse the recent-apps and home screens.
    private fun capturable(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot): Boolean {
        if (snapshot.windows.any { it.packageName == AgentFreeApps.PLAY_SERVICES }) return false
        val front = ScreenTree.frontWindow(snapshot)?.packageName ?: return false
        return !run.settings.agentFree.isAgentFree(front)
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "LookCloser(screens=${calls.size})"

    companion object {
        const val MIN_SCORE = 0.8
        const val WHICH = "Which number should I use?"
        const val SECURE = "This screen cannot be captured (the app blocks screenshots)."
        const val NO_SCREENSHOT = "the screenshot failed"
        const val CHANGED = "The screen changed while the owner answered, so Kestrel took no screenshot."
        private const val LARGE_SHARE = 16
        private val YES = setOf("yes", "yes send it", "ok", "yes please", "sure")
        private val ALWAYS = setOf("always", "always for this app", "yes always")
        private val REFUSALS = setOf("no", "not", "never", "dont", "ne")
    }
}
```

```kotlin
    suspend fun openLink(call: AgentCall): Done {
        val link = when (call) {
            is AgentCall.OpenUrl -> call.url
            is AgentCall.OpenDeepLink -> call.uri
            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Not a link")
        }
        val kind = if (call is AgentCall.OpenUrl) ActionKind.OPEN_URL else ActionKind.OPEN_DEEP_LINK
        val browser = (call as? AgentCall.OpenUrl)?.browser ?: Browser.DEFAULT
        val installed = run.ports.apps.launcherApps().map { it.packageName }.toSet()
        val browserPackage = browser.packages.firstOrNull { it in installed }
        if (browser != Browser.DEFAULT && browserPackage == null) return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed(if (browser == Browser.FIREFOX) "Firefox is not installed" else "Chrome is not installed"))
        val target = run.ports.screen.resolve(IntentSpec(VIEW, link, browserPackage, browsable = true))
        val verdict = LinkCheck.check(link, kind, fromOwner(link), target, run.settings::closed, run.settings.emergency)
        if (verdict is LinkVerdict.Refused) return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Refused(verdict.reason))
        val done = open(call, ScreenAction.OpenUri(link, browserPackage, browsable = true), target, null, linkTarget = target)
        if (browser != Browser.FIREFOX || browserPackage == null || done.after == null) return done
        return firefox(call, done, link, browserPackage)
    }

    // Firefox's web area can stay empty (r57's bug 2023734): wait for it, send the intent once more, then say so (D11).
    private suspend fun firefox(call: AgentCall, done: Done, link: String, browserPackage: String): Done {
        for (attempt in 0..1) {
            repeat(WAIT_POLLS) {
                val now = run.fresh()
                if (webAreaFilled(now, browserPackage)) return Done(call.tool, done.outcome, after = now, detail = done.detail)
                delay(POLL_MILLIS)
            }
            if (attempt == 0) run.ports.screen.act(ScreenAction.OpenUri(link, browserPackage, browsable = true))
        }
        return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed(EMPTY_PAGE), after = run.fresh())
    }

    private fun webAreaFilled(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, browserPackage: String): Boolean {
        val areas = snapshot.elements.indices.filter {
            snapshot.elements[it].className == WEB_VIEW && snapshot.elements[it].packageName == browserPackage
        }
        return areas.any { area -> snapshot.elements.any { it.parent == area } }
    }

    suspend fun openSettings(call: AgentCall.OpenSettings): Done {
        for (action in call.page.actions) {
            val spec = IntentSpec(action)
            val target = run.ports.screen.resolve(spec) ?: continue
            // The result names the page that opened, which can be a fallback of the page asked for (D11).
            val page = if (action == call.page.actions.first()) call.page.wire else pageName(action)
            return open(call, ScreenAction.OpenIntent(spec), target, page)
        }
        return Done(call.tool, Outcome.Failed("this phone has no such settings page"))
    }
```

```kotlin
    }

    private fun linkOf(call: AgentCall): String? = when (call) {
        is AgentCall.OpenUrl -> call.url
        is AgentCall.OpenDeepLink -> call.uri
        else -> null
    }

    // A link came from the owner when its host (or for a deep link, the whole link) is in his request (D32 item 12): its
    // words as a whole run of the request's words, or the host as one spoken word ("wikipedia.org" said "wikipedia org").
    private fun fromOwner(link: String): Boolean {
        val host = try {
            URI(link).host
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        } ?: link
        val words = Normalizer.words(host)
        val request = Normalizer.words(run.task.text)
        if (words.isEmpty()) return false
        val joined = words.joinToString("")
        return request.windowed(words.size).any { it == words } || request.any { it == joined }
    }

    // "android.settings.WIRELESS_SETTINGS" is the page "wireless".
    private fun pageName(action: String): String =
        action.substringAfterLast('.').removeSuffix("_SETTINGS").lowercase().replace('_', ' ')

    private fun quoted(text: String): String = ScreenText.quote(run.redactor.redact(text), ScreenText.LABEL_LIMIT)
```

### Task 12: Progress, escalation, the limits, the provider errors and the completion check

**Files:**
- Modify: `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/Limits.kt` (whole), `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/TaskRun.kt`
- Create: `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/Progress.kt`, `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/CompletionCheck.kt`
- Test: `core/agent/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/ProgressTest.kt`, `LimitsTest.kt`, `ProviderErrorsTest.kt`, `CompletionCheckTest.kt` (all in `core/agent/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Tasks 10 and 11 whole; Task 1's `ScreenSignature`, `Signature`, `ScreenTitle`, `ScreenTree`; Task 2's `ProviderError` (with `BadRequest.toolChoice`); Task 6's `ObservationTable`, `RoleModel.unusable` and `signedThinking`; Task 7's `AgentCall.Finish`, `Evidence`, `Outcome` and `Changes`; Task 8's `Conversation.growOnly`; Task 9's `ToolChoices.fallBack`.
- Produces (package `dev.kestrel.agent.loop`): `class Progress` (`withoutProgress`, `record(tool, outcome, targetKey, signature, dataText, added, ownerDidIt): Boolean`, `reset()`); `class Limits(clock: AgentClock, countsCredits: Boolean)` (`waiting`, `spent`, `credits`, `workMillis`, `repliesUsed`, `timeUsed`, `creditQuestion`, `allowMoreCredits`, `MAX_REPLIES = 30`, `MAX_WORK_MILLIS = 300_000`, `CREDIT_STEP = 10.0`, `STUCK_QUESTION`); `enum class Escalate { NOTHING, SWITCHED, ASK_STUCK, END_INVALID, END_STUCK }`; `class Escalation(model: ModelInfo)` (`role`, `current`, `invalid`, `afterStep`, `switchesFor`, `keepTrying`); `sealed interface Verdict { Passed; Unverifiable; Missing(what) }`; `internal object CompletionCheck { fun check(finish, table, fresh, appLabel, steps, sends, lastChecked): Verdict }`; `Done.invalid`.

Design D6's progress, D7 and D21, and D32 items 11, 36, 37 and 39. A step makes progress when its result is another screen or a changed target, a change elsewhere the first time on its tool, target and screen signature, a data result that differs from every earlier result of the same tool, an answer to `ask_user`, elements that `look_closer` added, or the owner's finished hand-over; steps without progress count in a row and any progress resets the count, while invalid calls (Task 9's `Reply.Invalid`, a `Malformed` reply, a failed `finish`) count apart (D6). The task starts on the lightweight model without a reasoning level; 3 steps without progress or 2 invalid calls switch it to the versatile model with `ReasoningLevel.LOW` and `ToolChoice.AUTO` (D3, D4) and reset both counts; on the versatile model 3 steps without progress ask "I'm not getting anywhere. Should I keep trying?" and 3 invalid calls end the task (D7; D32 item 11). Before each model call the agent ends the task at 30 replies, at 5 minutes of its own working time (the owner's waits and pauses excluded), and asks "This task has used N credits. Continue?" with the floor of the real total each time 10 more credits are used, for a profile that counts credits. The provider errors after `ProfileClient`'s own retries: a `BadRequest` whose `toolChoice` is set goes once more with `AUTO`; another `BadRequest` for a model with signed thinking switches the conversation to "grow only" and repeats the step once (D32 item 9's fallback); `Malformed` is an invalid call; a `Timeout`, `RateLimited` or `ServerError` on the lightweight model repeats the step on the versatile model; every other error ends the task with `PROVIDER` and its error, which `AgentTexts` speaks with `ProviderTexts` (plan 5B). The profile checks of D32 items 36 and 37 come from `AppModelPort` (plan 5B) as `RoleModel.unusable`: a refused lightweight model ends the task at once as `MODEL_UNUSABLE` with its sentence, and a refused versatile model is never used, so a task that would switch ends as `STUCK` with that sentence; D32 item 36 could also be read as "go on with the lightweight model", but a task that needs the switch is stuck on that model already. The agent runs one task and one model call at a time, so it never reaches OkHttp's limits of calls at once (D32 item 39: no change). `finish` first passes the pause gate: a pause (a lock, a call) while the model answered ends the task as `UNVERIFIED`, because the screen that the model saw cannot be checked (review 5 M3). It is checked on a fresh snapshot (D21): the cited elements of the newest observation must still be there with their label and class; a cited switch must show the state that its evidence or the task's last action on it gave, and one of the two must exist (review 5 M4); cited steps must be data steps with a result or steps that the owner did by hand after a hand-over; and every confirmed send needs its own evidence, also after a hand-over, because a confirmed send is always Kestrel's own press (review 5 I4): an element that holds the sent text, or after a share, the chat of the confirmed recipient with a cited element of the shared items, an image, a video or a label with a word for them (review 5 M1). OCR lines cannot be checked, so evidence made only of them ends the task as `UNVERIFIED` instead of costing invalid calls (review 5 M2). A failed check goes back to the model as "finish failed: …" with the new observation, names an element as `(n)` because the new observation numbers the screen anew (review 5 N2), is marked as a failed result, and counts as an invalid call (review 5 N1); a check that cannot run ends the task as `UNVERIFIED`.

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.Screens
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.ScreenBuilder
import dev.kestrel.agent.tools.Tools
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSignature
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ProgressTest {
    private val signature = ScreenSignature.of(Screens.chats())

    @Test
    fun aChangeOfScreenOrTargetIsProgressAndResetsTheCount() {
        val progress = Progress()
        assertFalse(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.NothingChanged))
        assertFalse(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.Failed("the element is gone")))
        assertEquals(2, progress.withoutProgress)

        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.AnotherScreen("Ana")))
        assertEquals(0, progress.withoutProgress)
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.SCROLL, Outcome.TargetChanged))
    }

    @Test
    fun aChangeElsewhereCountsOnlyTheFirstTimeOnItsToolTargetAndScreen() {
        val progress = Progress()
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.ChangedElsewhere, "plus", signature))
        assertFalse(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.ChangedElsewhere, "plus", signature))
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.ChangedElsewhere, "minus", signature))
    }

    @Test
    fun aDataResultCountsOnlyWhenItDiffersFromEveryEarlierResultOfTheSameTool() {
        val progress = Progress()
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.LIST_SMS, Outcome.DataOk(2), dataText = "a\nb"))
        assertFalse(progress.record(Tools.LIST_SMS, Outcome.DataOk(2), dataText = "a\nb"))
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.LIST_CALLS, Outcome.DataOk(2), dataText = "a\nb"))
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.LIST_SMS, Outcome.DataEmpty, dataText = "No items."))
    }

    @Test
    fun answersAddedElementsAndTheOwnersStepAreProgressAndRefusalsAreNot() {
        val progress = Progress()
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.ASK_USER, Outcome.Answered))
        assertFalse(progress.record(Tools.ASK_USER, Outcome.NoAnswer))
        assertFalse(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.Refused("blocked")))
        assertFalse(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.CheckFailed("the field changed")))
        assertFalse(progress.record(Tools.TAP, Outcome.Uncertain))
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.LOOK_CLOSER, null, added = true))
        assertTrue(progress.record(Tools.TAP, null, ownerDidIt = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun aScrollWithoutAToolbarTitleChangesTheTargetNotTheScreen() {
        // Review A3-M1: on a screen without a toolbar title, rule 3 would pick the first visible row, which a scroll
        // changes; D6 compares titles without rule 3, so the scroll is progress on the target.
        fun page(vararg rows: String) = ScreenBuilder.screen("com.example.list") {
            val list = list(null, 0, 2400, viewId = "list")
            rows.forEachIndexed { index, row -> text(row, 10 + index * 130, parent = list) }
        }
        val outcome = Changes.outcome(page("Row 1", "Row 2", "Row 3"), page("Row 4", "Row 5", "Row 6"), page("Row 1").elements[0].key)

        assertEquals(Outcome.TargetChanged, outcome)
        assertTrue(Progress().record(Tools.SCROLL, outcome))
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason
import dev.kestrel.agent.Harness
import dev.kestrel.agent.Screens
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Answer
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeClock
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.ScreenBuilder
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.ScriptedModel
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.ScriptedModel.Companion.call
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ReasoningLevel
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ToolChoice
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.ModelRole
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.put
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class LimitsTest {
    private fun twoScreens(): Pair<dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot, dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot> {
        val a = ScreenBuilder.screen("com.example.app") { text("Page A", 100, viewId = "toolbar_title"); button("Go to B", 600) }
        val b = ScreenBuilder.screen("com.example.app") { text("Page B", 100, viewId = "toolbar_title"); button("Go to A", 900) }
        return a to b
    }

    @Test
    fun theThirtyFirstReplyIsNeverRequested() = runTest {
        val (a, b) = twoScreens()
        val taps = (1..40).map { if (it % 2 == 1) call("tap", "Go to B", null, null, "reason" to "on", "category" to "reading") else call("tap", "Go to A", null, null, "reason" to "back", "category" to "reading") }
        val harness = Harness(a, taps)
        harness.screen.onTap("Go to B", b)
        harness.screen.onTap("Go to A", a)

        val report = harness.run("Keep going")

        assertEquals(EndReason.STEPS, report.end)
        assertEquals(Limits.MAX_REPLIES, harness.model.requests.size)
        assertEquals(30, report.steps)
    }

    @Test
    fun workingTimeLeavesOutTheOwnersWaits() = runTest {
        val clock = FakeClock()
        val limits = Limits(clock, countsCredits = true)
        clock.elapsed = 60_000
        limits.waiting { clock.elapsed += 120_000 }
        clock.elapsed += 30_000

        assertEquals(90_000, limits.workMillis)
        clock.elapsed += 210_000
        assertTrue(limits.timeUsed())
    }

    @Test
    fun theCostQuestionComesAtEachTenCreditsWithTheRealTotal() {
        val limits = Limits(FakeClock(), countsCredits = true)
        limits.spent(9.5)
        assertNull(limits.creditQuestion())
        limits.spent(3.2)
        assertEquals("This task has used 12 credits. Continue?", limits.creditQuestion())
        limits.allowMoreCredits()
        assertNull(limits.creditQuestion())
        limits.spent(10.0)
        assertEquals("This task has used 22 credits. Continue?", limits.creditQuestion())
        val plan = Limits(FakeClock(), countsCredits = false).apply { spent(50.0) }
        assertNull(plan.creditQuestion())
    }

    @Test
    fun aNoToTheCostQuestionEndsTheTask() = runTest {
        val (a, b) = twoScreens()
        val harness = Harness(a, listOf(
            call("tap", "Go to B", null, 6.0, "reason" to "on", "category" to "reading"),
            call("tap", "Go to A", null, 6.0, "reason" to "back", "category" to "reading"),
            call("tap", "Go to B", null, 6.0, "reason" to "on", "category" to "reading"),
        ))
        harness.screen.onTap("Go to B", b)
        harness.screen.onTap("Go to A", a)
        harness.owner.answers += Answer.No

        val report = harness.run("Keep going")

        assertEquals(EndReason.COST, report.end)
        assertEquals("This task has used 12 credits. Continue?", harness.owner.asked.single().first)
        assertEquals(2, harness.model.requests.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun twoInvalidCallsMoveTheTaskToTheVersatileModelWithItsReasoningLevel() = runTest {
        val text = buildJsonObject { put("text", "I will tap it.") }
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chats(), listOf(text, text, call("fail", null, null, null, "reason" to "Stop.")))

        harness.run("Open Ana's chat")

        assertEquals(listOf(ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT, ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT, ModelRole.VERSATILE), harness.model.roles)
        val versatile = harness.model.requests[2]
        assertEquals(ReasoningLevel.LOW, versatile.reasoning)
        assertEquals(ToolChoice.AUTO, versatile.toolChoice)
        assertNull(harness.model.requests[0].reasoning)
        assertEquals(ToolChoice.REQUIRED, harness.model.requests[0].toolChoice)
    }

    @Test
    fun threeStepsWithoutProgressSwitchModelsAndThenAskTheOwner() = runTest {
        val stay = call("tap", "Hi", null, null, "reason" to "look", "category" to "reading")
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi"), List(6) { stay })
        harness.owner.answers += Answer.No

        val report = harness.run("Do something")

        assertEquals(EndReason.STUCK, report.end)
        assertEquals(List(3) { ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT } + List(3) { ModelRole.VERSATILE }, harness.model.roles)
        assertEquals(Limits.STUCK_QUESTION, harness.owner.asked.single().first)
    }

    @Test
    fun threeInvalidCallsOnTheVersatileModelEndTheTask() = runTest {
        val text = buildJsonObject { put("text", "Hmm.") }
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chats(), List(5) { text })

        assertEquals(EndReason.INVALID_CALLS, harness.run("Open Ana's chat").end)
        assertEquals(5, harness.model.requests.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun escalationResetsItsCountsAndStaysWhenTheVersatileModelIsRefused() {
        val progress = Progress()
        val escalation = Escalation(ScriptedModel.INFO)
        assertEquals(Escalate.NOTHING, escalation.invalid(progress))
        assertEquals(Escalate.SWITCHED, escalation.invalid(progress))
        assertEquals(ModelRole.VERSATILE, escalation.role)

        val refused = ScriptedModel.INFO.copy(versatile = ScriptedModel.INFO.versatile.copy(unusable = "Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 work on Vertex only in the global, us and eu locations. Change the profile's location or model."))
        val stays = Escalation(refused)
        repeat(3) { progress.record("tap", Outcome.NothingChanged) }
        assertEquals(Escalate.END_STUCK, stays.afterStep(progress))
        assertEquals(ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT, stays.role)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        assertEquals(EndReason.FAILED_BY_MODEL, report.end)

        val harness = Harness(Screens.chats(), listOf(error("RateLimited"), error("ServerError")))

        val report = harness.run("Open Ana's chat")

        assertEquals(EndReason.PROVIDER, report.end)
        assertEquals(ProviderError.ServerError(500), report.error)

    @Test

        val unreachable = Harness(Screens.chats(), listOf(error("Unreachable")))
        assertEquals(ProviderError.Unreachable, unreachable.run("Open Ana's chat").error)

        assertEquals(EndReason.PROVIDER, quota.run("Open Ana's chat").end)

    @Test

        ))

    }

    @Test

        val vertex = "Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 work on Vertex only in the global, us and eu locations. Change the profile's location or model."
        val light = ScriptedModel.INFO.copy(lightweight = ScriptedModel.INFO.lightweight.copy(unusable = vertex))

        val report = refused.run("Open Ana's chat")
        assertEquals(EndReason.MODEL_UNUSABLE, report.end)
        assertEquals(vertex, report.detail)
        assertTrue(refused.model.requests.isEmpty())

        val bedrock = "Kestrel can't use Bedrock application inference profiles yet. Choose the model by its own ID."
        val versatile = ScriptedModel.INFO.copy(versatile = ScriptedModel.INFO.versatile.copy(unusable = bedrock))
        val text = buildJsonObject { put("text", "Hmm.") }
        val stuck = Harness(Screens.chats(), listOf(text, text), model = versatile)
        val end = stuck.run("Open Ana's chat")
        assertEquals(EndReason.STUCK, end.end)
        assertEquals(bedrock, end.detail)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason

import dev.kestrel.agent.observe.ObservationBuilder

import dev.kestrel.safety.Redactor
import dev.kestrel.safety.Vault
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CompletionCheckTest {
    private val builder = ObservationBuilder(Redactor(Vault()), AgentFreeApps())

    private fun table(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot) = builder.build(ObservationInput(1, snapshot, "Kestrel fixtures")).table

    private fun number(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, label: String) = table(snapshot).entries.first { it.label == label }.number

    private fun finish(vararg evidence: Evidence) = AgentCall.Finish("Done.", evidence.toList(), null, emptyList())

    private fun check(
        finish: AgentCall.Finish,
        shown: ScreenSnapshot,
        fresh: ScreenSnapshot = shown,
        dataSteps: Set<Int> = emptySet(),
        sends: List<ConfirmedSend> = emptyList(),
        lastChecked: Map<String, Boolean> = emptyMap(),
    ) = CompletionCheck.check(finish, table(shown), fresh, "Kestrel fixtures", dataSteps, sends, lastChecked)

    @Test
    fun aFinishWithoutEvidenceOrWithAGoneElementFails() {
        val chat = Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "See you")

        assertEquals(Verdict.Missing("no evidence was cited"), check(finish(), chat))
        assertEquals(Verdict.Passed, check(finish(Evidence(number(chat, "See you"), null, null)), chat))
        assertTrue(check(finish(Evidence(number(chat, "See you"), null, null)), chat, fresh = Screens.chats()) is Verdict.Missing)
    }

    @Test
    fun aSwitchMustShowTheStateThatItsEvidenceOrTheTasksLastActionNames() {
        val off = Screens.settingsPage("Hotspot", "Wi-Fi hotspot", checked = false)
        val on = Screens.settingsPage("Hotspot", "Wi-Fi hotspot", checked = true)
        val switch = number(on, "Wi-Fi hotspot")
        val key = table(on).entry(switch)!!.key!!

        assertTrue(check(finish(Evidence(switch, null, checked = true)), on, fresh = off) is Verdict.Missing)
        assertEquals(Verdict.Passed, check(finish(Evidence(switch, null, checked = true)), on))
        assertTrue(check(finish(Evidence(switch, null, null)), on, fresh = off, lastChecked = mapOf(key to true)) is Verdict.Missing)
        assertEquals(Verdict.Missing("say which state ($switch) should show"), check(finish(Evidence(switch, null, null)), on))
    }

    @Test
    fun aCitedStepMustBeADataStepWithAResult() {
        val chat = Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "See you")

        assertTrue(check(finish(Evidence(null, 3, null)), chat, dataSteps = setOf(2)) is Verdict.Missing)
        assertEquals(Verdict.Passed, check(finish(Evidence(null, 2, null)), chat, dataSteps = setOf(2)))
    }

    @Test
    fun everyConfirmedSendNeedsItsOwnEvidence() {
        val sent = Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi", "I'm late")
        val send = ConfirmedSend(listOf("Ana Petrović"), "I'm late", share = false)

        assertTrue(check(finish(Evidence(number(sent, "Hi"), null, null)), sent, sends = listOf(send)) is Verdict.Missing)
        assertEquals(Verdict.Passed, check(finish(Evidence(number(sent, "I'm late"), null, null)), sent, sends = listOf(send)))
        // The owner's step after a hand-over may be cited as a step, but a confirmed send still needs its own evidence.
        assertTrue(check(finish(Evidence(null, 4, null)), sent, dataSteps = setOf(4), sends = listOf(send)) is Verdict.Missing)

        val shared = ConfirmedSend(listOf("Ana Petrović"), null, share = true)
        val photos = Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi", "3 photos")
        assertEquals(Verdict.Passed, check(finish(Evidence(number(photos, "3 photos"), null, null)), photos, sends = listOf(shared)))
        assertTrue(check(finish(Evidence(number(photos, "Hi"), null, null)), photos, sends = listOf(shared)) is Verdict.Missing)
        val other = Screens.chat("Marko Marković", "3 photos")
        assertTrue(check(finish(Evidence(number(other, "3 photos"), null, null)), other, sends = listOf(shared)) is Verdict.Missing)
    }

    @Test
    fun evidenceOfOnlyOcrLinesCannotBeChecked() {
        val chat = Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi")
        val withOcr = builder.build(ObservationInput(1, chat, "Kestrel fixtures", ocr = listOf(OcrLine("Paid", IntRect(40, 1500, 1040, 1600), 0.95)))).table
        val ocr = withOcr.entries.first { it.ocr }.number

        assertEquals(Verdict.Unverifiable, CompletionCheck.check(finish(Evidence(ocr, null, null)), withOcr, chat, "Kestrel fixtures", emptySet(), emptyList(), emptyMap()))
    }

    @Test
    fun aFailedFinishGoesBackToTheModelAndAnUncheckableOneIsUnverified() = runTest {
        val harness = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi"), listOf(
            call("finish", null, null, null, "summary" to "Sent.", "evidence" to emptyList<Any>()),
            call("finish", null, null, null, "summary" to "Sent.", "evidence" to listOf(mapOf("target" to mapOf("label" to "Hi")))),
        ))
        assertEquals(EndReason.FINISHED, harness.run("Read Ana's chat").end)
        assertTrue(harness.lastRequestText().contains("finish failed: no evidence was cited"))

        val gone = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi"), listOf(
            call("say", null, null, null, "text" to "Almost done."),
            call("finish", null, null, null, "summary" to "Read it.", "evidence" to listOf(mapOf("target" to mapOf("label" to "Hi")))),
        ))
        gone.owner.onSay = { gone.screen.current = null }
        val report = gone.run("Read Ana's chat")
        assertEquals(EndReason.UNVERIFIED, report.end)
        assertEquals("Read it.", report.summary)

        // A pause while the model answered (a lock, a call): the screen that it saw cannot be checked.
        val paused = Harness(Screens.chat("Ana Petrović", "Hi"), listOf(
            call("finish", null, null, null, "summary" to "Read it.", "evidence" to listOf(mapOf("target" to mapOf("label" to "Hi")))),
        ))
        paused.owner.gates += listOf(Gate.GO, Gate.RESUMED)
        assertEquals(EndReason.UNVERIFIED, paused.run("Read Ana's chat").end)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.screen.model.Signature

/**
 * Spec 11.7's progress, made exact (design D6; r61's rule that any success resets the count). A step makes progress when
 * its action's result is `another screen` or `the target changed`, or `the screen changed elsewhere` the first time on its
 * tool, target and screen; when a data tool returns a result that differs from every earlier result of the same tool; when
 * `ask_user` got an answer; when `look_closer` added elements; and when the owner finished a hand-over. Every other step
 * makes none, and [withoutProgress] counts those in a row. Invalid tool calls are counted apart (D7).
 */
class Progress {
    private val elsewhere = mutableSetOf<Triple<String, String?, Signature?>>()
    private val results = mutableMapOf<String, MutableSet<String>>()

    var withoutProgress = 0
        private set

    /**
     * Whether a step with [outcome] made progress, and counts it. [dataText] is a data tool's result text, [added] says
     * that `look_closer` added elements, and [ownerDidIt] that the owner finished a hand-over.
     */
    fun record(
        tool: String,
        outcome: Outcome?,
        targetKey: String? = null,
        signature: Signature? = null,
        dataText: String? = null,
        added: Boolean = false,
        ownerDidIt: Boolean = false,
    ): Boolean {
        val made = ownerDidIt || added || when (outcome) {
            is Outcome.AnotherScreen, Outcome.TargetChanged, Outcome.Answered -> true
            Outcome.ChangedElsewhere -> elsewhere.add(Triple(tool, targetKey, signature))
            is Outcome.DataOk, Outcome.DataEmpty -> dataText != null && results.getOrPut(tool) { mutableSetOf() }.add(dataText)
            else -> false
        }
        withoutProgress = if (made) 0 else withoutProgress + 1
        return made
    }

    /** After a switch of models or the owner's "keep trying", the count starts again (D7). */
    fun reset() {
        withoutProgress = 0
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "Progress(withoutProgress=$withoutProgress)"
}
```

Replace the whole `core/agent/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/agent/loop/Limits.kt` with:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.agent.loop

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AgentClock
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelInfo
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.RoleModel
import dev.kestrel.providers.http.ProviderError
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.ModelRole
import kotlin.math.floor

/**
 * Spec 11.7's limits (design D7): at most [MAX_REPLIES] model replies per task, invalid ones included; at most
 * [MAX_WORK_MILLIS] of Kestrel's own working time, where the time spent waiting for the owner and a paused task do not
 * count; and for a profile whose spending counts credits, a question each time the task has used [CREDIT_STEP] more
 * credits since its start or the owner's last yes.
 */
class Limits(private val clock: AgentClock, private val countsCredits: Boolean) {
    private val started = clock.elapsedMillis()
    private var waited = 0L
    private var allowedCredits = CREDIT_STEP

    var credits = 0.0
        private set

    val workMillis: Long get() = clock.elapsedMillis() - started - waited

    /** Runs [block], a wait for the owner or a pause, whose time does not count as work. */
    suspend fun <T> waiting(block: suspend () -> T): T {
        val start = clock.elapsedMillis()
        try {
            return block()
        } finally {
            waited += clock.elapsedMillis() - start
        }
    }

    fun spent(credits: Double) {
        this.credits += credits
    }

    fun repliesUsed(replies: Int): Boolean = replies >= MAX_REPLIES

    fun timeUsed(): Boolean = workMillis >= MAX_WORK_MILLIS

    /** The cost question's text when the task has reached its allowance of credits, or null (review A N2). */
    fun creditQuestion(): String? =
        if (countsCredits && credits >= allowedCredits) "This task has used ${floor(credits).toLong()} credits. Continue?" else null

    /** The owner said yes to the cost question: 10 more credits. */
    fun allowMoreCredits() {
        allowedCredits = credits + CREDIT_STEP
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "Limits(workMillis=$workMillis, credits=$credits)"

    companion object {
        const val MAX_REPLIES = 30
        const val MAX_WORK_MILLIS = 5 * 60_000L
        const val CREDIT_STEP = 10.0
        const val STUCK_QUESTION = "I'm not getting anywhere. Should I keep trying?"
    }
}

/** What the escalation rules ask the loop to do after a step (design D7). */
enum class Escalate { NOTHING, SWITCHED, ASK_STUCK, END_INVALID, END_STUCK }

/**
 * Spec 11.7's escalation (design D7): every task starts with the lightweight model; after 3 steps in a row without
 * progress or 2 invalid tool calls on it, the task switches to the versatile model and both counts start again. On the
 * versatile model, 3 steps without progress ask the owner whether to keep trying, and 3 invalid tool calls end the task.
 * When both roles name the same model, the switch only resets the counts; when the profile check refused the versatile
 * model ([RoleModel.unusable]), the task does not switch and ends as stuck instead (D32 item 36).
 */
class Escalation(private val model: ModelInfo) {
    var role: ModelRole = ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT
        private set
    private var invalid = 0

    val current: RoleModel get() = if (role == ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT) model.lightweight else model.versatile

    /** After an invalid tool call (D4), which [progress] does not count. */
    fun invalid(progress: Progress): Escalate {
        invalid++
        return when {
            role == ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT && invalid >= LIGHT_INVALID -> switch(progress)
            role == ModelRole.VERSATILE && invalid >= VERSATILE_INVALID -> Escalate.END_INVALID
            else -> Escalate.NOTHING
        }
    }

    /** After a step that [progress] has counted. */
    fun afterStep(progress: Progress): Escalate = when {
        progress.withoutProgress < STUCK_STEPS -> Escalate.NOTHING
        role == ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT -> switch(progress)
        else -> Escalate.ASK_STUCK
    }

    /**
     * Whether [error] on the lightweight model moves the task to the versatile model, which repeats the step (spec 14.2:
     * "two retries with backoff, then a switch"); `ProfileClient` has already retried.
     */
    fun switchesFor(error: ProviderError, progress: Progress): Boolean {
        val passing = error == ProviderError.Timeout || error is ProviderError.RateLimited || error is ProviderError.ServerError
        return passing && role == ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT && model.versatile.unusable == null &&
            model.versatile.id != model.lightweight.id && switch(progress) == Escalate.SWITCHED
    }

    /** The owner said yes to "Should I keep trying?". */
    fun keepTrying(progress: Progress) {
        progress.reset()
    }

    private fun switch(progress: Progress): Escalate {
        progress.reset()
        invalid = 0
        if (model.versatile.unusable != null) return Escalate.END_STUCK
        role = ModelRole.VERSATILE
        return Escalate.SWITCHED
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "Escalation(role=$role, invalid=$invalid)"

    companion object {
        const val STUCK_STEPS = 3
        const val LIGHT_INVALID = 2
        const val VERSATILE_INVALID = 3
    }
}
```
